pūrvoktā vidhim anyaṃ ca yathāvad bruvataḥ śṛṇu||179||
śirogate viṣe nastaḥ kuryān mūlāni buddhimān|
upadheyam adhodaṣṭasyordhvadaṣṭasya ‘mūrdhni deya...’ iti pā. pādayoḥ||182||
mañjiṣṭhāṃ ca samaṃ piṣṭvā gopittena naraḥ pibet||185||
raktaṃ māṃsaṃ ca godhāyāḥ śuṣkaṃ cūrṇīkṛtaṃ hitam|
kaṭabhyāś ca pibed raktagate, māṃsagate pibet||187||
sarveṣu ca bale dve tu madhūkaṃ madhukaṃ natam||188||

ab.seg: śvā tridoṣety ādi saviṣakukkurādilakṣaṇam| yatraiva ca śunas tridoṣakopo bhavati daivād alarkagrahāveśāt tatraiva saviṣaśirobhitāpitvādi bhavatīti jñeyam| kecit tu śirobhitāpādi yathoktaṃ kukkure tathā taddaṣṭe ca bhavatīti vadanti| vistaraś cāsya suśruta eva| anye 'py evaṃvidhā iti anye 'pi śṛgālatarakṣvādaya evaṃvidhāḥ santaḥ kṛcchraśirorogādikarā bhavantīty arthaḥ| uktaṃ hi suśrute- “śvaśṛgālatarakṣvarkṣavyāghrādīnāṃ yadā'nilaḥ| śleṣmapraduṣṭo muṣṇāti sañjñāṃ sañjñāvahāśritaḥ” (su.ka.a.7) iti| kaṇḍūnistoda ity ādinā sāmānyena saviṣakīṭādidaṃśaliṅgam aviṣaprāṇidaṃśaliṅgaṃ cocyate| karṇikā māṃsakandī| sarve iti caturviṃśatir api yathoktopakramāḥ| pūrvoktam ity atra vakṣyamāṇacikitsitaṃ pūrvoktavidhāv api ‘pūrvokto vidhirapi’ iti pā. avasthāviśeṣavidheyatayā kartavyam ity arthaḥ; yadā ‘pūrvoktā’ iti pāṭhaḥ, tadā upakramā ity asya viśeṣaṇam etat| ūrdhvaṃ daṣṭasya pādayor ity atrāpi kṣatayor eva pādayor viṣasaṅkramaṇārthaṃ māṃsāsṛgdānaṃ jñeyam| tābhyām iti sitākṣaudrābhyām| nataṃ tagaram| śeluḥ śleṣmātakaḥ| māṃsagate ity uttareṇa sambadhyate| khadiraś cāriṣṭaś ceti khadirāriṣṭaḥ, kiṃ vā khadirakṛto 'riṣṭaḥ| samadhukaṃ natam iti cchedaḥ||175-188||

lg.l: pippalīṃ nāgaraṃ ‘maricaṃ’ iti pā. kṣāraṃ navanītena mūrcchitam|
kaphe bhiṣag udīrṇe tu vidadhyāt pratisāraṇam||189||
candanaṃ tagaraṃ kuṣṭhaṃ haridre dve tvag eva ca||191||
manaḥśilā tamālaś ca rasaḥ kaiśara eva ca|
sindhuvārasya mūlaṃ ca śvetā ca girikarṇikā||195||
pānaṃ darvīkarair daṣṭe nasyaṃ samadhu pākalam|
tagaraṃ kaṭukā kṣaudraṃ hanti rājīmatāṃ viṣam|
api vāsukinā daṣṭaḥ piben madhughṛtāplutam ‘dadhighṛtāplutam’ iti pā.|199|

div.ab: pippalīty ādipratisāraṇaṃ daṃśe eva| maricaṃ sitam iti śobhāñjanakabījam| śvetā ceti girikarṇikāviśeṣaṇaṃ, tena śvetā'parājitā gṛhyate| kecid girikarṇikāṃ syandanām āhuḥ| pākalaṃ kuṣṭham||189-198||-

lg.l: tvacaṃ ca nāgaraṃ caiva samāṃśaṃ ślakṣṇapeṣitam|
samāno hy amṛtenāyaṃ garājīrṇaṃ ca nāśayet||207||
śaṅkhiny ārkaṃ payaḥ śuṇṭhī karañjo madhu vārścike|
mūlāni śvetabhaṇḍīnāṃ vyoṣaṃ sarpiś ca matsyaje|
vārściko hy ucciṭiṅgasya kaṇabhasyaunduro 'gadaḥ ‘śalabhasyau...’ iti pā.||211||

ab.seg: muktā mauktikam| kṣīraśuklā vidārī| karṇikāpatanaṃ tayor iti anantaroktakīṭalūtādaṃśayor yā karṇikā tasyāḥ pātanam ity arthaḥ| jālamālinī devatāḍakaḥ| tiktekṣvākuḥ kaṭukālābūḥ| vārścike iti vṛścikaviṣe| durduraḥ bhekaḥ| śvetabhaṇḍī aparājitā| vārścike ity ādi ucciṭiṅgasya viṣe vārścike yo yoga uktaḥ sa kartavyaḥ| evaṃ kaṇabhasyāpi viṣe aundure yo yoga uktaḥ sa kartavyaḥ||199-211||

div.ab:
vacāṃ vaṃśatvacaṃ pāṭhāṃ nataṃ surasamañjarīm|
dve bale nākulīṃ kuṣṭhaṃ śirīṣaṃ rajanīdvayam||212||
guhām atiguhāṃ śvetām ajagandhāṃ śilājatu|
kattṛṇaṃ kaṭabhīṃ kṣāraṃ gṛhadhūmaṃ manaḥśilām||213||
rohītakasya pittena piṣṭvā tu paramo 'gadaḥ|
nasyāñjanādilepeṣu hito viśvambharādiṣu||214||
svarjikā'jaśakṛtkṣāraḥ surasā'thākṣipīḍakaḥ ‘akṣipīḍakaḥ pīḍayitvā yadraso'kṣṇi dīyate so'vapīḍo'kṣipīḍakaḥ’ iti gaṅgādharaḥ|
madirāmaṇḍasaṃyukto hitaḥ śatapadīviṣe||215||
kapittham akṣipīḍo 'rkabījaṃ trikaṭukaṃ tathā|
karañjo dve haridre ca gṛhagodhāviṣaṃ ‘galagoḍyā viṣaṃ’ iti pā. jayet||216||
kākāṇḍarasasaṃyukto ‘kākāṇḍayuktaḥ sarveṣāṃ’ iti pā. viṣāṇāṃ taṇḍulīyakaḥ|
pradhāno barhipittena tadvad vāyasapīlukaḥ||217||
śirīṣaphalamūlatvakpuṣpapatraiḥ samair dhṛtaiḥ|
śreṣṭhaḥ pañcaśirīṣo 'yaṃ viṣāṇāṃ pravaro vadhe||218|| iti pañcaśirīṣo 'gadaḥ|

ab.seg: nākulī rāsnā| guhā pṛśniparṇī, atiguhā śālaparṇī| ajagandhā phophāndheti khyātā| pitteneti gopittena| viśvambharādayaḥ kīṭā eva śleṣmakopanāḥ suśrutoktāḥ| akṣapīḍakaḥ śvetapītaśimbībhedaḥ| vāyasī kākamācī| śreṣṭhaḥ pañcaśirīṣo 'yam iti padaṃ triśirīṣādyapekṣayā pañcaśirīṣasya śreṣṭhatvaṃ brūte, pravara iti padaṃ viṣaharayogāntareṣu śreṣṭhatām āha, tena na punaruktiḥ; kiṃ vā śreṣṭha iti śreṣṭhaśirīṣaphalādikṛtaḥ||212-218||

lg.l: catuṣpadbhir dvipadbhir vā nakhadantakṣataṃ tu yat|
śūyate pacyate cāpi sravati jvarayaty api||219||

ab.seg: dvipadā vanamānuṣamarkaṭādayaḥ| aśvakarṇaḥ sarjabhedaḥ||219-220||

lg.l: durandhakāre viddhasya ‘daṣṭasya’ iti pā. kenacid viṣaśaṅkayā|
viṣodvegāj jvaraśachardir mūrcchā dāho 'pi vā bhavet||221||
glānir moho 'tisāraś cāpy etac chaṅkāviṣaṃ matam|
cikitsitam idaṃ tasya kuryād āśvāsayan budhaḥ||222||
sitā vaigandhiko drākṣā payasyā madhukaṃ madhu|

ab.seg: durandhakāre ity ādinā śaṅkāviṣam āha| kenacid iti nirviṣeṇāpi| viṣaśaṅkayā viṣodvegād iti viṣaśaṅkayaiva viṣaprādurbhāvād ity arthaḥ; śaṅkā ceyaṃ prabhāvād eva viṣajanikā| vaigandhikaḥ gandhaka eva śodhitaḥ||221-223||

lg.l: cuccūr maṇḍūkaparṇī ca śākaṃ ca kulakaṃ hitam||225||

ab.seg: koradūṣaḥ kodravaḥ| kulakaṃ kāravellakam; anye paṭolabhedam āhuḥ||224-228||

lg.l: muhur muhuḥ śironyāsaḥ śothaḥ srastauṣṭhakarṇātā ‘śuṣkauṣṭhakaṇṭhatā’ iti pā.|
catuṣpadāṃ bhavaty etad daṣṭānām iha lakṣaṇam||230||
devadāru haridre dve saralaṃ ‘surasaṃ’ iti pā. candanāguru|
taiḥ syāt pāṇḍuḥ kṛśo 'lpāgnir garaś cāsyopajāyate|
jaṭharaṃ grahaṇīdoṣo yakṣmā gulmaḥ kṣayo jvaraḥ ‘jaṭharaṃ grahaṇīrogaṃ yakṣmāṇaṃ viṣamajvaram’ iti pā.|
prāyaḥ paśyati nadyādīñ chuṣkāṃś ca savanaspatīn||236||
kālaś ca gauram ātmānaṃ svapne gauraś ca kālakam|
vikarṇanāsikaṃ vā'pi prapaśyed vihatendriyaḥ ‘prapaśyedahatendriyaḥ’ iti pā.||237||
tam avekṣya bhiṣak prājñāḥ pṛcchet kiṃ kaiḥ kadā saha|
jagdham ity avagamyāśu pradadyād vamanaṃ bhiṣak||238||
śuddhe hṛdi tataḥ śāṇaṃ hemacūrṇasya dāpayet||239||
hema sarvaviṣāṇy āśu garāṃś ca viniyacchati|

div.ab: annamiśritān iti bhakṣyamiśritān| garaś cāsyopajāyata iti vakṣyamāṇamarmapradhamānādilakṣaṇo vyādhir jāyate| vihatendriya iti rogopahatendriyaḥ| pṛcched ity ādau pṛcchāyāṃ garāvadhāraṇam eva phalam avagamyate| avagamyeti garakāraṇam avagamya| sūkṣmam ity ādau amṛtatāmracūrṇaṃ māṣamānaṃ yāvad deyam, amṛtenaiva vamanaṃ bhavati| hemapa iti hema yaḥ pibatīti sa hemapaḥ| nāgadantī dantībhedaḥ| phalaṃ madanaphalaṃ, na tu ‘palaiḥ’ iti pāṭhaḥ| ayaṃ yogo jatukarṇe paṭhyate- “nāgadantīsnukkṣīraphalair gomūtrasiddhaṃ māhiṣaṃ ghṛtaṃ pāyayet” iti||229-241||-

śirīṣatvak trikaṭukaṃ triphalāṃ candanotpale||242||
dve bale sārivāsphotāsurabhīnimbapāṭalāḥ|
bandhujīvāḍhakīmūrvāvāsāsurasavatsakān||243||
pāṭhāṅkolāśvagandhārkamūlayaṣṭyāhvapadmakān|
viśālāṃ bṛhatīṃ lākṣāṃ kovidāraṃ śatāvarīm||244||
kaṭabhīdantyapāmārgān pṛśniparṇīṃ rasāñjanam|
śvetabhaṇḍāśvakhurakau kuṣṭhadārupriyaṅgukān||245||
vidārīṃ madhukāt sāraṃ karañjasya phalatvacau|
rajanyau lodhram akṣāṃśaṃ piṣṭvā sādhyaṃ ghṛtāḍhakam||246||
tulyāmbucchāgagomūtratryāḍhake tad viṣāpaham|
apasmārakṣayonmādabhūtagrahagarodaram||247||
pāṇḍurogakrimīgulmaplīhorustambhakāmalāḥ|
hanuskandhagrahādīṃś ca pānābhyañjananāvanaiḥ||248||
hanyāt sañjīvayec cāpi vibodbandhamṛtān narān|
nāmnedam amṛtaṃ sarvaviṣāṇāṃ syād dhṛtottamam||249|| ity amṛtaghṛtam|

ab.seg: śirīṣatvag ity ādau āsphotā aparamallikā| surabhī parṇāsabhedaḥ| bandhujīvaḥ putrajīvakaḥ| aśvakhurakaḥ syandanaḥ; kiṃ vā kokilākṣaḥ||242-249||

bhavanti cātra-
chatrī jharjharapāṇiś ca cared rātrau tathā divā|
tacchāyāśabdavitrastāḥ praṇaśyanty āśu pannagāḥ||250||

lg.l: daṣṭamātro daśed āśu taṃ sarpaṃ loṣṭam eva vā|
upary ariṣṭāṃ badhnīyād daṃśaṃ chindyād dahet tathā||251||
dhāryaṃ garamaṇir yāś ca varauṣadhyo viṣāpahāḥ|

ab.seg: chatrīty ādau chatrī divā, rātrau jharjharapāṇiś cared iti vadanti; anye tūbhayatrāpy ubhayaṃ bruvate| jharjharakaḥ ‘khurkhuraka’ iti khyātaḥ| chāyāśabdau yathāsaṅkhyaṃ chatrajharjharayoḥ| tābhyāṃ tadātve vitrastāḥ| daṃśakāle kartavyam āha- daṣṭamātra ity ādi| dhāraṇād eva viṣāpaham āha- vajram ity ādi| sāra iti sarajūviśeṣaṇam(?)| picuko maṇir uttarāpathe prasiddhaḥ| viṣamūṣikā viṣamaṇiḥ| karketanamaṇiḥ padmarāgaḥ| garamaṇiśabdena nānāmaṇīnāṃ grahaṇam| varauṣadhya iti tantrāntaroktāḥ akṣīvajātapippalājaruhākāyoṣī (?) prabhṛtayaḥ; uktaṃ ca- “akṣīvajātasya pippalasya maṇiḥ sarvaviṣāpahaḥ” ity ādi||250-253||

tatra ślokaḥ-
itīdam uktaṃ dvividhasya vistarair bahuprakāraṃ viṣarogabheṣajam|
adhītya vijñāya tathā prayojayan vrajed viṣāṇām aviṣahyatāṃ budhaḥ||254||
itīdam ity ādisaṅgrahaḥ| vrajed viṣāṇām aviṣahyatām iti viṣāṇi taṃ soḍhuṃ na pārayantīti bhāvaḥ||254||
ity agniveśakṛte tantre carakapratisaṃskṛte cikitsāsthāne viṣacikitsitaṃ nāma trayoviṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ||23||
iti śrīcakrapāṇidattaviracitāyāṃ carakatātparyaṭīkāyām āyurvedadīpikāyāṃ cikitsāsthāne viṣacikitsitaṃ nāma trayoviṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ||23||

div.head: madātyayacikitsitam

ab.seg: athāto madātyayacikitsitaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ||1||
iti ha smāha bhagavān ātreyaḥ||2||
mohajanakatvasāmānyāt tathā viṣasamānaguṇajanyatvāc ca viṣacikitsitam anu madātyayasya cikitsitam ucyate||1-2||

lg.l: suraiḥ sureśasahitair yā purā ‘surā’ iti pā. paripūjitā|
sautrāmaṇyāṃ hūyate yā karmibhir yā pratiṣṭhitā||3||
yajñauhī yā yayā śakraḥ somātipatito bhṛśam|
dṛśyā spṛśyā prakalpyā ca yajñīyā yajñasiddhaye||5||

ab.seg: surair ity ādinā madirāstutyā tathā vakṣyamāṇanindayā vidhinā pīyamānasurāyāḥ śubhaphalam avidhipānāc cātyarthaninditaphalavattvaṃ darśayati| yā purā paripūjitety anena prathamaṃ devair eveyaṃ paripūjitā, tataḥ surayogāt sureti copadiṣṭeti darśayati| sautrāmaṇiḥ surāhavir yajñāntarniviṣṭo yajñaviśeṣaḥ; tasyāṃ hūyate surā| karmibhir yā pratiṣṭhiteti yājñikair abhiṣavaṇādibhiḥ pratiṣṭhitā pratiṣṭhāṃ prāpitā| yajñaṃ vahatīti yajñauhī; anena ca laukikayajñāntarāṇy api surayā kriyanta ity ucyate; sautrāmaṇihome tu tasyā eva pradhānāṅgatocyate| śakraś ca somātipatita iti ‘śakro 'tipītena somena kṣapitabalo nirojasko nirvīryībhūtaḥ sa kila punar āpyāyya nijaṃ vīryam āpāditaḥ’ ity eṣā śrutiḥ; atipānena patitaḥ atipatitaḥ ‘atiyogena parito'tiparitaḥ’ iti pā.| prakalpyā iti abhiṣotavyā sandhānāyeti yāvat| yajñīyā yajñasiddhaya iti yajñavidhau kānicit kratvarthāni yūpabarhyādīni, kānicit tu puruṣārthāni vāsagarbhādīni, kānicid yajñārthāni puruṣārthāni ca yathā sarpiriṣṭakādīni, tad iha surā ‘yajñīyā’ ity anena vāsanādivat ‘puruṣārthā’ ity ucyate, yajñasiddhaye bhavatīty anena yūpādivad yajñārthatvaṃ surāyā ucyate||3-5||

yonīty ādau viśeṣaśabdaḥ pratyekam abhisambadhyate| yoniḥ kāraṇaṃ, tadviśeṣāḥ- dhānyaphalamūlasārapuṣpapatrakāṇḍatvacaḥ śarkarānavamāḥ sūtrasthānoktāḥ| saṃskāro 'pi bahuprakārasaṃskārayogaḥ| nāmaviśeṣāḥ surāmadhumaireyādayaḥ| ādigrahaṇāt prabhāvaguṇādīnāṃ grahaṇam| mado lakṣaṇaṃ yasya tasmān madalakṣaṇāt sāmānyāt madyasvarūpāt||6||

lg.l: yā devān amṛtaṃ bhūtvā svadhā bhūtvā pittṝṃś ca yā|
somo bhūtvā dvijātīn yā yuṅkte śreyobhir uttamaiḥ||7||

ab.seg: amṛtaṃ bhūtvety ādau surādhiṣṭhātrī devatā amṛtādirūpeṇa devādīn tarpayatīti darśayati| śreyobhir iti mahatkalyāṇaiḥ||7||

lg.l: āśvinaṃ yā mahat tejo balaṃ sārasvataṃ ca yā|
vīryam aindraṃ ca yā siddhā somaḥ sautrāmaṇau ca yā||8||
yā prītir yā ratir yā vāg yā puṣṭir yā ca nirvṛtiḥ||9||
ratiḥ surety abhihitā tāṃ surāṃ vidhinā pibet||10||

ab.seg: āśvinaṃ yā mahat teja ity ādāv api surādhiṣṭhātṛdevatāyā eva tejovīryādikāraṇatvāt tādrūpyaṃ jñeyam| tejaḥ sarvadevatādigaṃ, tathā sārasvataṃ balaṃ mantrabalam| somaḥ sautrāmaṇau ca yety anena somarūpatocyate, pūrvaṃ sautrāmaṇyāṃ hūyata ity uktam iti na paunaruktyam| yā prītir ity ādau prītyādikāraṇatvena prītyādirūpatayā nirdeśo jñeyaḥ||8-10||

lg.l: sauvarṇai rājataiś cāpi tathā maṇimayair api|
bhājanair vimalaiś cānyaiḥ sukṛtaiś ca pibet sadā||15||
saṃvāhyamāna iṣṭābhiḥ ‘sañcāryamāṇamiṣṭābhiḥ’ iti pā. piben madyam anuttamam||17||
pūjayitvā ‘pibet sampūjya vibudhānāśiṣaḥ samprayujya ca| pradāya yajanaṃ cāgre tvarthibhyaḥ pṛthivītale’ iti pā. surān pūrvam āśiṣaḥ prāk prayujya ca|

ab.seg: vidhinā pibed ity atroktavidhim āha- śarīrety ādi| śarīre snānavasrādibhir bāhya ābhyantaraś ca prakṛtyādyapekṣayā snigdhoṣṇānnādibhiḥ kṛtaḥ saṃskāro yena sa śarīrakṛtasaṃskāraḥ| śucir iti manaḥśuciḥ| yathartūddāmagandhibhir iti ṛtvavasthānuguṇatayā vihitaiḥ| yathartuke sarvartusukhe| kusumaprakarīkṛte visṛjatkusume| sarasāḥ priyāḥ, tāsāṃ sammate| svaśarīrasukhe sthita iti yathāśarīrasukhaṃ sthitaḥ| sukṛtair iti saṃskṛtaiḥ| śikṣitābhir iti abhyastopacārābhiḥ| gandhapiśunair iti gandhāḍhyaiḥ| ambaracāriṇaḥ śyenādayaḥ| paurogavargā iti sūdaśāstrābhijñāḥ| arthibhya iti arthino baladeva-caṇḍī-yakṣādayaḥ, tebhyaḥ||11-20||

lg.l: snigdhoṣṇair bhāvitaś cānnair vātiko madyam ācaret||21||
paittiko bhāvitaś cānnaiḥ piban madyaṃ na sīdati||22||
ślaiṣmiko dhanvajair māṃsair madyaṃ māricakaiḥ saha||23||
vidhir vasumatām eṣa bhaviṣyadvibhavāś ca ye|
yathopapatti tair madyaṃ pātavyaṃ mātrayā hitam||24||
kaphapittādhikebhyas tu mārdvīkaṃ mādhavaṃ ca yat||25||

ab.seg: sāmānyaṃ vidhim uktvā vātikādīnāṃ pānavidhim āha- abhyaṅgety ādi| māricakair iti maricasaṃskṛtaiḥ| vasumatām iti dhanavatām| bhaviṣyadvibhavā utpadyamānadhanāḥ| yathopapatti yathāparicchadopapatti| kaphapittādhikebhya ity ādau viparyayatantrayuktyā kaphādhikebhyo mādhavaṃ, pittādhikebhyas tu mārdvīkaṃ; mārdvīkaṃ mṛdvīkākṛtaṃ, madhukṛtaṃ tu mādhavam||21-25||

lg.l: guṇair doṣaiś ca tan madyam ubhayaṃ copalakṣyate||26||
vidhinā mātrayā kāle hitair annair yathābalam|
prahṛṣṭo yaḥ piben madyaṃ tasya syād amṛtaṃ yathā||27||
yathopetaṃ punar madyaṃ prasaṅgād yena pīyate|

ab.seg: bahudravyam iti nānāvidhadravyasampāditam| bahuguṇam iti bhūrivakṣyamāṇalaghvādiguṇam| bahukarmeti lekhanadīpanādibahukarmakaram| madātmakam iti madasvabhāvam| yasmād evaṃ svabhāvaṃ tasmād guṇadoṣe ca taṃ madyam apekṣete; kiñcit puruṣam apekṣya yaugikatvād guṇakaraṃ, kiñcit tv ayaugikatvād doṣakaraṃ; yathā- prathame made guṇakaraṃ, doṣakaraṃ ca dvitīyamade iti bhāvaḥ| vidhineti yathoktavidhinā| kāle iti yasya madyasya ya ucito viparītaguṇaḥ kālas tasmin| hitair annair iti madyahitair annaiḥ| yathopetam iti yad eva madyam ahitam apy upagatam| prasaṅgād iti atiyogena| viṣavad iti mohādikartṛtvāt||26-28||

lg.l: madyaṃ hṛdayam āviśya svaguṇair ojaso guṇān|
daśabhir daśa saṅkṣobhya ceto nayati vikriyām||29||
rūkṣaṃ vikāśi viśadaṃ madyaṃ daśaguṇaṃ smṛtam||30||
guru śītaṃ mṛdu ślakṣṇaṃ bahalaṃ madhuraṃ sthiram|
prasannaṃ picchilaṃ snigdham ojo daśaguṇaṃ smṛtam||31||
raukṣyāt snehaṃ vyavāyitvāt sthiratvaṃ ślakṣṇatām api|
saukṣmyān madyaṃ nihanty evam ojasaḥ svaguṇair guṇān|
sattvaṃ tadāśrayaṃ cāśu saṅkṣobhya janayen madam||34||
hṛdayaṃ yāti vikṛtiṃ tatrasthā ye ca dhātavaḥ||36||

ab.seg: madyaṃ yathā madayati tathā prāha- madyam ity ādi| daśabhir iti laghvādibhir guṇaiḥ, daśāpi gurvādīn ojoguṇān saṅkṣobhya, na dvitrādikaiḥ, ceto vikriyāṃ nayati vikṛtaṃ karoti| yena guṇena madyasya ojoguṇakṣobho bhavati tad āha- gurutvaṃ lāghavād ity ādi| prasādaṃ cāśubhāvanād iti prasādākhyaguṇam āśugatvād dhanti; āśugatvaṃ ca yady api prasādaviruddhaṃ na bhavati, tathā'pi madyam eva pratikūlatayā ojaḥprasādaṃ ‘ojaḥ pratyāhanti’ iti pā. hanti, tatrāśuguṇa āhanane vyāpriyata iti jñeyam| vyavāyitvāt sthiratvam iti vyavāyitvaṃ vyāpakatvaṃ, tac ca sthiratvaṃ tadviparītatvād eva hanti; āśugatvavyavāyitvayoś cāyaṃ viśeṣaḥ- yad āśugaṃ śīghraṃ gacchati, vyavāyi tu sarvavyāpakam| vikāsitvaṃ vikasanaśīlatvaṃ saratvam iti yāvat; tac ca ślakṣṇaviparītatvād eva ślakṣṇatāṃ hanti| sāndratā ghanatā| ete vikāsitvāśugatvādayo guṇā yady api viṃśatiguṇagaṇanāyāṃ na paṭhitās tathā'py asaṅkhyeyatvād guṇānām eṣām api guṇatvaṃ siddhaṃ; ye tu tatra paṭhitās te tāvad āviṣkṛtatamā jñeyāḥ| āśrayopaghātād āśritopaghāto bhavatīti darśayann āha- sattvam ity ādi| sattvasya ca oja āśrayaḥ, oja upakāryam; yathā- rājāśritaḥ puruṣaḥ| rasavātety ādi| rasavātādivahānāṃ daśadhamanīnāṃ hṛdayaṃ sthānaṃ, rasavahā eva yā daśa dhamanyo hṛdayāśrayā uktās tā eva vātādivahāḥ| yad uktaṃ “vātapittaśleṣmaṇāṃ sarvaśarīracarāṇāṃ sarvāṇi srotāṃsy ayanabhūtāni” (vi.a.5) iti; raktādīnāṃ tu sarvaśarīracarāṇām api viśeṣeṇa hṛdayaṃ sthānam uktaṃ- “ṣaḍaṅgam aṅgaṃ vijñānam indriyāṇy arthapañcakam| ātmā ca saguṇaś cetaś cintyaṃ ca hṛdi saṃśritam” (sū.a.30) iti| dhātava iti sattvabuddhīndriyādayaḥ||29-36||

lg.l: ojasy avihate pūrvo hṛdi ca pratibodhite|
madhyamo vihate 'lpe ca vihate tūttamo madaḥ||37||
naivaṃ vighātaṃ janayen madyaṃ paiṣṭikam ojasaḥ|

ab.seg: madyaṃ ceto vikriyāṃ nayatīty utsargavidheḥ prathamamade 'pavādam āha- ojasy avihate ity ādi| hṛdayāśritabuddhyādau pratibodhite, hṛdayaśabdeneha tatsthopacārād dhṛdayāśritā buddhyādayo 'bhidhīyante, yathā- mañcāḥ krośantīti; buddhyādibodhanaṃ prathamamadakāryaṃ madyasya prabhāvāt| madhyamottamamadopapattisāmagrīm āha- madhyama ity ādi| vihate iti vighāte; ojasaḥ alpe vighāte madhyamo mado bhavati| vihate iti viśeṣeṇa atyarthaṃ hate, uttama iti tṛtīyaḥ||37-38||

lg.l: hṛdi madyaguṇāviṣṭe harṣas tarṣo ratiḥ sukham|

ab.seg: hṛdīty ādinā sāmānyena madalakṣaṇam āha| tarṣaḥ abhilāṣaḥ| yathāsattvam iti prakṛtyā rājase sattve rājasāḥ, tāmase ca tāmasāḥ| citrā iti nānāprakārāḥ| mohanidrāntā iti mohanidrāvasānāḥ||39-40||

lg.l: prathamo madhyamo 'ntyaś ca lakṣaṇais tān pracakṣmahe||41||
na ca buddhismṛtiharo viṣayeṣu na cākṣamaḥ|
muhuḥ smṛtir muhur moho(')vyaktā ‘vyaktā'vyaktā ca’ iti pā. sajjati vāṅ muhuḥ|
liṅgāny etāni jānīyād āviṣṭe madhyame made||45||
madhyamaṃ madam utkramya madam āprāpya ‘madamaprāpya’ iti pā. cottamam|
na kiñcin nāśubhaṃ kuryur narā rājasatāmasāḥ||46||
ko madaṃ tādṛśaṃ vidvān unmādam iva dāruṇam|
tṛtīyaṃ tu madaṃ prāpya bhagnadārviva niṣkriyaḥ|
ramaṇīyān sa viṣayān na vetti na suhṛjjanam|
yadarthaṃ pīyate madyaṃ ratiṃ tāṃ ca na vindati||49||
kāryākāryaṃ sukhaṃ duḥkhaṃ loke yac ca hitāhitam|
yadavastho na jānāti ko 'vasthāṃ tāṃ vrajed budhaḥ||50||
sa dūṣyaḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ nindyaś cāgrāhya eva ca|
vyasanitvād udarke ca sa duḥkhaṃ vyādhim aśnute||51||

ab.seg: prathamādimadānāṃ lakṣaṇam āha- praharṣaṇa ity ādi| pānānnaguṇadarśaka iti pānānnaguṇān samyag bodhayatīty arthaḥ| viṣayeṣv iti viṣayasevāsu, na cākṣama iti nākṣamatākara ity arthaḥ| yuktāyuktapralāpa iti sambaddhāsambaddhavacanaḥ| pracalāyanaṃ ghūrṇanam| yojanā saviparyayeti sthānādīnāṃ samyagyojanā kadācid bhavati, kadācic ca sthānādiyojanāviparyayo 'samyagyojanārūpo bhavatīty arthaḥ| madhyamaṃ madam utkramyety ādi| yady api trividho mada uktaḥ, tathā'pi dvitīyamadāvasāne tṛtīyamadāprāptyavasthāyā eva atyarthanindyatāṃ darśayan tṛtīyamadasyātyantanindyatāṃ darśayati; yena tasya tṛtīyamadasya pūrvarūpāvasthaiva sarvāśubhakaraṇādihetutayā nitāntaṃ nindyeti bhāvaḥ| iyaṃ ca madhyamadātikramatṛtīyamadāprāptiśabdābhidheyā'py avasthā madhyamamadāntatṛtīyamadādyarūpāvasthābhidhāyikaiva; yathā- “kumbhamīnayor madhye yadā carati candramā” ity atra madhyepadena kumbhāntamīnādir evocyate, paramārthatas tayor madhyasyābhāvāt; tathehāpi ‘tenehāpi’ iti pā. paramārthato 'nyamadakālābhāvād dvitīyāntatṛtīyamadādyabhidhānam evātra tṛtīyamadātyarthanindārthaṃ, na caturthamadopadarśanam| asvantam iti aśobhanāntam| bhagnadārviveti bhagnavṛkṣa iva patitas tiṣṭhati| udarkam uttarakālam| sa duḥkhaṃ vyādhim iti madātyayam||41-51||

lg.l: pretya ceha ca yac chreyaḥ śreyo mokṣe ca yat param|
madyena manasaś cāsya saṅkṣobhaḥ kriyate mahān|
madye moho bhayaṃ śokaḥ krodho mṛtyuś ca saṃśritaḥ|
ity evaṃ madyadoṣajñā madyaṃ garhanti yatnataḥ||57||
satyam ete mahādoṣā madyasyoktā na saṃśayaḥ|
kintu madyaṃ svabhāvena yathaivānnaṃ tathā smṛtam|
prāṇāḥ prāṇabhṛtām annaṃ tad ayuktyā nihanty asūn|
viṣaṃ prāṇaharaṃ tac ca yuktiyuktaṃ rasāyanam||60||

ab.seg: pretya cehety ādinā ekīyamataṃ madyanindakaṃ darśayati| pretyeti janmāntare| taṭasthasyeti vacanena vātākṣobhyatāṃ darśayati| satyam ity ādinā svamatam āha| ete doṣāḥ madyasyaikīyamatoktā ahitādidharmayuktasyaiva bhavanti, na hitālpamātravidhipītasyeti bhāvaḥ| vidhivarjitam iti kriyāviśeṣaṇam| madyasyānnasārūpyadarśanena vidhivadupayoge guṇavattām avidhyupayoge ca doṣavattām āha- kintv ity ādi| yuktyā deśakālamātrādyapekṣayā yojanayā yuktaṃ śubham, aśubhaṃ cāyuktiyuktam| yukter anvayavyatirekābhyāṃ kāryam āha- prāṇā ity ādi| prāṇahetutvāt prāṇāḥ| ayuktiyuktam iti avidhiprayuktam| yuktiyuktaṃ rasāyanam iti yathā “viṣasya tu tilaṃ dadyāt” (ci.a.1) ity ādiprayoge tilamānasya rasāyanatvaṃ, tathā jñeyam||52-60||

lg.l: harṣam ūrjaṃ mudaṃ puṣṭim ārogyaṃ pauruṣaṃ param ‘balam’ iti pā.|
yuktyā pītaṃ karoty āśu madyaṃ sukhamadapradam||61||

ab.seg: vidhipītamadyaguṇān āha- harṣam ity ādi| harṣam utsāhaṃ kāyikam| mudam iti manaḥsantoṣam| pauruṣam iti śukram| āśv iti vacanena śīghraṃ harṣādīni karoti na pariṇāmaṃ yāvad apekṣate| sukhamadapradam iti sukhapradamadaṃ, prathamaṃ madam iti yāvat| anye tu ‘madasukhapradam’ iti paṭhanti; tatrāpi madasukhaṃ prathamamadārambha eva||61||

lg.l: madyotthānāṃ ca rogāṇāṃ madyam eva prabādhakam||64||
pañcasv artheṣu kānteṣu yā ratiḥ prathame made|
yūnāṃ vā sthavirāṇāṃ vā tasya nāsty upamā bhuvi||66||

ab.seg: rocanam ity ādinā madyaguṇān āha| svāpanaṃ naṣṭanidrāṇāṃ tathā bodhanaṃ cātinidrāṇām iti kāryadvayakaraṇam ucitanidrākaratvaprabhāvād eva; kiṃ vā naṣṭanidrāṇāṃ nidrābhighātahetvaticintanādivismārakatayā nidrākaraṃ bhavati, atinidrāṇāṃ nidrāhetumanovahasrotorodhādihantṛtayā prabodhakaṃ bhavatīti jñeyam| madyotthānāṃ ca rogāṇāṃ madyam eva prabādhakam iti hetuviparītārthakāritāprabhāvād ity arthaḥ| ratir iti ratikārakam ity arthaḥ| viṣayasaṃyoge prītisaṃyogavardhanam iti viṣayāṇāṃ śabdādīnāṃ saṃyoge prītiṃ saṃyogaṃ ca vardhayati; pītamadyo yadā viṣayaiḥ śabdādibhiḥ saṃyujyate tadā teṣv api prītimān bhavati, prītaś ca sukhākāṅkṣī san punas teṣu saṃyujyate| pravayasām iti vṛddhānām| utsavaḥ autsukyaṃ viṣayābhilāṣa iti yāvat, āmodo harṣaḥ| nanu viṣaye svabhāvād eva prītir bhavati, tat kiṃ madyena kriyate? ity āśaṅkya prathamamadasya viśiṣṭaratikartṛtvam āha- pañcasv ity ādi| ratiś ceha atyarthasukhajanakatvād evopādeyeti vijñeyam| viśrāma iti duḥkhārtaviśrāmahetuḥ| jīvaloka iti jīvamānalokaḥ ‘jīvavān lokaḥ’ iti pā.||62-67||

lg.l: trīn doṣāṃs trividhaṃ sattvaṃ jñātvā madyaṃ pibet sadā||68||
teṣāṃ trikāṇām aṣṭānāṃ yojanā yuktir ucyate|
yayā yuktyā piban madyaṃ madyadoṣair na yujyate||69||
madyasya ca guṇān sarvān yathoktān sa samaśnute|
sattvāni tu prabudhyante prāyaśaḥ prathame made|

ab.seg: yuktyā niṣevitam ity atroktāṃ madyapānayuktim āha- annapānety ādi| tatrānnaṃ trividhaṃ vātapittakaphakaram, evaṃ pānam api trividhaṃ, bālyādibhedād vayo 'pi trividhaṃ, vyādhir api mṛdumadhyatīvrabhedena trividhaḥ, kiṃ vā saumyāgneyavāyavyabhedena trividhaḥ, balaṃ pravarāvaramadhyabhedāt trividhaṃ, kālas tu śītoṣṇavarṣālakṣaṇas trividhaḥ, trividhaṃ sattvaṃ śuddhaṃ rājasaṃ tāmasaṃ ca| yojaneti samyagyojanārūpā| yuktiṃ phalenāvadhārayati- yayā yuktyety ādinā| sattvaguṇocchrito madyaguṇān samaśnute iti yojyam| tatrānnāpekṣayā yuktir yathā- vātakaram annam upayujya vātaharaṃ madyaṃ peyam, evaṃ pittakarakaphakaratve 'pi pittakaphaharānnopayogaḥ| evaṃ pānādyapekṣayā'pi yojanā vyākhyātā bhavati| vayastrike 'pi bālye sthavire ca tīkṣṇaṃ madyaṃ na peyaṃ, yauvane tu tīkṣṇam apīti| vyādhyapekṣayā'pi yojanā yathā- mṛduvyādhau tīkṣṇoṣṇaṃ, uṣṇe ca śītamadhuraṃ, varṣākāle tu snigdhaṃ dīpanaṃ ca madyam| doṣabhedena tu madyaṃ vāte snigdhoṣṇaṃ gauḍikādi, pitte śītamadhuraṃ śārkarādi, kaphe rūkṣatīkṣṇaṃ mādhavādi| uktaṃ hi- “vātikebhyo hitaṃ madyaṃ prāyo gauḍikapaiṣṭikam| kaphapittādhikebhyas tu phālamādhavaśārkaram” iti| doṣagrahaṇenaiva vātalādiprakṛtir api gṛhītā| sattvabhedenāpi sāttvikena tu bahv api madyaṃ pātavyaṃ, rājasatāmasais tu svalpam eva| sattvānīti manāṃsi| avyaktatām īṣadvyaktatāṃ, madhye cāvyaktatāṃ yāntīty arthaḥ, uttame tu sarvathā'py avyaktaṃ bhavatīti bhāvaḥ| kecit tu ‘sasyasambodhakaṃ varṣaṃ’ ity ādi ślokaṃ paṭhanti| tatra hemaprakṛtidarśako hutāśo yathā suvarṇasya śuddhāśuddhatāṃ darśayati, tathā madyaṃ tūbhayakārakam iti manaḥprabodhakaṃ manoguṇadarśakaṃ ca| rūpāṇām iti hemarūpāṇāṃ; kiṃ vā ‘rukmāṇāṃ’ iti pāṭhaḥ| vyaktidarśaka iti ākāradarśakaḥ||68-73||

lg.l: vaiguṇyaṃ sahasā yānti madyadoṣair na sāttvikāḥ|
madyaṃ hi balavat sattvaṃ gṛhṇāti sahasā na tu ‘sahasā nāvagṛhṇāti madyaṃ sattvabalādhikam’ iti pā.||76||

ab.seg: sāttvikādibhedena pānaṃ trividham āha- sugandhīty ādi| śobhano gandho yasya tat sugandhi, gandharvaḥ gānam| śobhano 'nto yasya tat svantam| sumadam iti samamadam| na cottamamadapradam iti nottamamadakaraṃ, kadācid api madyapānāt tṛtīyamadāśaṅkā na bhavati; uttamamadaḥ sāttvike na bhavatīty arthaḥ| uttamamadāprāptau hetum āha- vaiguṇyam ity ādi| sattvasaṃyogād iti sattvākhyaguṇayogāt; sattvākhyo hi guṇaḥ prakāśakatayā na madena mohakenābhibhūyata iti bhāvaḥ| etad evāha- sahasety ādi| rājasapānam āha- saumyāsaumyety ādi| saumyakathā saumyasambandhā, tadviparītā asaumyā| viśadāviśadam iti prasannāprasannam| citram iti sambaddhāsambaddhavākyādiyogān nānāprakārakam| tathety ādinā tāmasam āha| sammohaḥ krodho nidrā ca ante yasya tat sammohakrodhanidrāntam||74-78||

lg.l: jahyāt sahāyān yaiḥ pītvā madyadoṣān upāśnute||79||

ab.seg: yair ity anena rājasatāmasāḥ pratyavamṛśyante, taiḥ samaṃ piban tatprasaktyā svayam apy atipiban madyadoṣān dvitīyatṛtīyamadadoṣān prāpnoti||79||

lg.l: kalāsv abāhyā viśadā viṣayapravaṇāś ca ye||80||
te sahāyāḥ sukhāḥ pāne taiḥ piban saha modate||82||
pibanti susahāyā ye te vai sukṛtibhiḥ samāḥ||83||
pañcabhir viṣayair iṣṭair upetair manasaḥ ‘...riṣṭairupeto manasaḥ’ iti pā. priyaiḥ|
bahumadyocitā ye ca mādyanti sahasā na te||85||
kṣutpipāsāparītāś ca ‘prāṅmadyāḥ kṣutpipāsārtā’ iti pā. durbalā vātapaittikāḥ|
svalpenāpi madaṃ śīghraṃ yānti madyena mānavāḥ||87||

ab.seg: upādeyān sāttvikān āha- sukhaśīlā ity ādi| sumukhā iti priyākārāḥ| viśadā iti avāmāḥ| āpānaṃ vardhayantīti āpāne prasādaṃ vardhayanti na pānaprasaktiṃ vardhayantīty arthaḥ, tasyā ninditatvāt| manoramair ity atra ‘sādhīyāṃsaiḥ’ iti śeṣaḥ| sukṛtibhiḥ samā iti evambhūtapānasya sukṛtilabhyatvāt| sthirasattvety ādau pūrvānnā iti madyapānāt pūrvam upayuktānnāḥ| madyapānvayā iti madyapavaṃśajāḥ, teṣāṃ madyapānaṃ madyasātmyatvād eva na vikārakaraṃ bhavati, viṣakanyāyā viṣam iva||80-87||

lg.l: rūkṣaṃ pariṇataṃ madyaṃ niśi nidrāṃ vihatya ca|
karoti tasya tac chīghraṃ vātaprāyaṃ madātyayam||90||
tīkṣṇoṣṇaṃ madyam amlaṃ ca yo 'timātraṃ niṣevate|
sa ‘lakṣaṇāni bhavantyasya yāni tāni nibodha me’ iti pā. tu vātolbaṇasyāśu praśamaṃ yāti hanti vā||93||
taruṇaṃ madhuraprāyaṃ gauḍaṃ paiṣṭikam eva vā|

ab.seg: madyapānadoṣaguṇān abhidhāya madātyayān hetvādibhir āha- ūrdhvam ity ādi| sambhavam iti kāraṇam| vātaprāyam ity ādau prāyaḥśabdenādhikavācinā vakṣyamāṇānāṃ sarvamadātyayānāṃ tridoṣajanyatvaṃ darśayati| sa tu vātety ādau sa tv iti paittikaḥ; vātolbaṇasya paitto madātyayo vātapittasaṃyogakṛtatayā bāhya ivāgnir vāyuyuktaḥ śīghrakārī bhavati| tatreyaṃ vyavasthā- yatra sadyaḥphalā kriyā tatra śīghram eva śāmyati, akriyāyāṃ ca śīghraṃ hanti, śaṅkhakarohiṇyādivat||88-97||

lg.l: ta eva madye dṛśyante viṣe tu balavattarāḥ||98||
hanty āśu hi viṣaṃ kiñcit kiñcid rogāya kalpate|
yathā viṣaṃ tathaivāntyo jñeyo madyakṛto madaḥ||99||
dṛśyate rūpavaiśeṣyāt pṛthaktvaṃ cāsya ‘cāpi’ iti pā. lakṣyate||100||

ab.seg: madyasya tridoṣakaratve hetum āha- viṣasyety ādi| yady api madyam amlaṃ, viṣaṃ tv avyaktamadhuraṃ, tathā'pi bahuguṇasāmānyāt ta eva madye dṛśyanta ity uktam| tathaivāntyo mada iti prāṇaharo rogakaraś cety arthaḥ| pṛthaktvam iti vātikatvādinā pārthakyam||98-100||

lg.l: śarīraduḥkhaṃ balavat sammoho ‘santataṃ’ iti pā. hṛdayavyathā|
aruciḥ pratatā ‘pramohaḥ’ iti pā. tṛṣṇā jvaraḥ śītoṣṇalakṣaṇaḥ||101||
śiraḥpārśvāsthisandhīnāṃ vidyuttulyā ‘vedanā vikṣate yathā’ iti pā. ca vedanā|
urovibandhaḥ kāsaś ca hikkā śvāsaḥ prajāgaraḥ|
bhramaḥ pralāpo rūpāṇām asatāṃ caiva darśanam||104||
pradharṣaṇaṃ vihaṅgaiś ca bhrāntacetāḥ sa manyate||105||

ab.seg: śarīraduḥkham ity ādinā sarvamadātyayasya sāmānyaṃ lakṣaṇaṃ brūte, kiṃ vā tridoṣamadātyayasyaiva lakṣaṇaṃ; yato rogasaṅgrahe vātapittakaphasannipātaiś catvāro madā uktāḥ| “yaś ca madyamadaḥ prokto viṣajo raudhiraś ca yaḥ| sarva ete madā narte vātapittakaphatrayāt” (sū.a.24) ity anena madasya vātādijatvena cāturvidhyam uktam| tena madātyayasya cāturvidhyaṃ madacāturvidhyāt; yato mada eva ātyayiko madātyaya iti nirucyate| vidyuttulyeti vidyudvatkṣaṇasthāyinī| sphuraṇaṃ kiñcitkampanaṃ, vepanam ekadeśe vyaktakampanam||101-106||

lg.l: sarvaṃ madātyayaṃ vidyāt tridoṣam adhikaṃ tu yam|
prakāṅkṣālāghave jāte yad yad asmai hitaṃ bhavet||110||

ab.seg: utkleśaviśeṣeṇa cikitsām āha- sarvam ity ādi| samasarvadoṣe cikitsām āha- kaphasthānety ādi| kaphasthānānupūrvyā cātra cikitsā kaphasthānodbhūtatayā prathamaṃ kaphasambandhāt sannipātajvara iva jñeyā| ādau kaphaprabalatām evāha- pittamārutaparyanta iti; anena cārthāt kaphāditvaṃ lambhayati| samapītena tenaiveti yajjātīyena madyena madātyayo janitaḥ nitarāṃ tajjātīyenaiva śāmyati| yathā viṣaṃ maulaṃ daṃṣṭrīyeṇa śāmyati, tathā madyam api vijātīyena madyena śāmyatīty eke; kintu tenaivety anena tām eva madyajātiṃ pratyavamṛśati, tenāvaśyaṃ tajjātīyam eva madyaṃ jñeyam| yato 'nantaraṃ vakṣyati- ‘yac ca yasmai hitaṃ bhavet’ iti| tathā ‘dadyāt salavaṇaṃ madyaṃ paiṣṭikaṃ vātaśāntaye’ ity anena yena kenacin madyenodbhūte vātamadātyaye paiṣṭikam uktaṃ, tathā ‘saśarkaraṃ śārkaraṃ vā’ ity ādi viśeṣavidhānaṃ bahu kariṣyati; tena tajjātīyam anyajātīyaṃ ca madyaṃ madātyaye deyam||107-111||

lg.l: antardāhaṃ jvaraṃ tṛṣṇāṃ pramohaṃ vibhramaṃ madam|
janayaty āśu tacchāntyai madyam eva pradāpayet||113||
kṣāro hi yāti mādhuryaṃ śīghram amlopasaṃhitaḥ|
śreṣṭham amleṣu madyaṃ ca yair guṇais tān paraṃ śṛṇu||114||
madhuraś ca kaṣāyaś ca tiktaḥ kaṭuka eva ca||115||
guṇāś ca daśa pūrvoktās taiś caturdaśabhir guṇaiḥ|
sarveṣāṃ madyam amlānām upary upari tiṣṭhati||116||

ab.seg: annarasotkleda ity atra ‘amlarasakledaḥ’ iti kecit paṭhanti| kṣāramādhuryāya yadā'mlamadyadānaṃ, tadā kim iti anyad amlaṃ na dīyate ity āha- kṣāro hīty ādi| upary uparīti upariṣṭād apy upari atyarthaṃ śreṣṭham ity arthaḥ||112-116||

lg.l: madyotkliṣṭena doṣeṇa ruddhaḥ ‘kruddhaḥ’ iti pā. srotaḥsu mārutaḥ|
karoti vedanāṃ tīvrāṃ śirasy asthiṣu sandhiṣu||117||
doṣaviṣyandanārthaṃ hi tasmai ‘viṣyandanārthaṃ doṣasya tasya’ iti pā. madyaṃ viśeṣataḥ|
rocanaṃ dīpanaṃ cāgner abhyāsāt sātmyam eva ca||119||
rujaḥ ‘uraḥsrotaḥsu śuddheṣu’ iti pā. srotaḥsv aruddheṣu mārute cānulomite|
nivartante vikārāś ca śāmyanty asya madodayāḥ||120||
sasnehaiḥ śaktubhir yuktam avadaṃśair virocitam ‘...ścirotthitam’ iti pā.|
dṛṣṭvā vātolbaṇaṃ liṅgaṃ rasaiś cainam upācaret|
citrair gaudhūmikaiś cānnair vāruṇīmaṇḍasaṃyutaiḥ ‘snigdhai...’ iti pā.||125||
medyaṃ prāg uditaṃ māṃsaṃ dāḍimasvarasena vā||127||
rasapralepi ‘rasapralehayūṣaiśca’ iti pā. sampūpaiḥ sukhoṣṇaiḥ sampradāpayet||128||
bhukte ‘bhukte na’ iti pā. tu vāruṇīmaṇḍaṃ dadyāt pātuṃ pipāsave|
dāḍimasya rasaṃ vā'pi jalaṃ vā pāñcamūlikam||129||
ghanair agurupaṅkaiś ca dhūpaiś cāgurujair ghanaiḥ||133||

ab.seg: madodayā iti madanimittās tarṣādayaḥ ‘madanimittā antardāhādayaḥ’ iti pā.; kecit tu ‘jvarādayaḥ’ iti paṭhanti, tatra jvarapradhānās tarṣādaya ity artha unneyaḥ| avadaṃśo yam upayujya madyaṃ pīyate| dakṣaḥ kukkuṭaḥ| veśavāraḥ khāniṣkaḥ, sa coktalakṣaṇo 'sakṛt| pūpavartiḥ vartyākārā pūpalikā| rasapralepīti rasapralepanarūpatayā nirvṛttaṃ ‘rasapraleha’ iti yāvat| agurupaṅkair iti agurulepaiḥ| ghanair iti bahalaiḥ| saṃrodhoṣṇasukhāvahair iti saṃrodhajanitoṣmaṇā sukhakārakaiḥ||117-135||

lg.l: kalpayet tarpaṇān yūṣān rasāṃś ca vividhātmakān||140||
vijñāya bahudoṣasya dahyamānasya ‘tṛḍvidāhānvitasya ca’ iti pā. tṛṣyataḥ||141||
madyaṃ drākṣārasaṃ toyaṃ dattvā tarpaṇam eva vā|
niḥśeṣaṃ vāmayec chīghram evaṃ rogād vimucyate||142||
kāle punas tarpaṇādyaṃ kramaṃ kuryāt prakāṅkṣite|
rasaṃ sanāgaraṃ dadyāt tittiripratibhojanam ‘taittiraiḥ pratibhojanam’ iti pā.||145||
bhojanaṃ bhojayen madyam anutarṣaṃ ca pāyayet||147||
anutarṣasya mātrā sā yayā no dūṣyate ‘no hanyate’ iti, ‘nodvasyate’ iti ca pā. manaḥ|
tṛṣyate madyam alpālpaṃ pradeyaṃ syād bahūdakam||148||
tṛṣṇā yenopaśāmyeta madaṃ yena ca nāpnuyāt|
parūṣakāṇāṃ pīlūnāṃ rasaṃ śītam athāpi ‘śītamathāmbu vā’ iti pā. vā||149||
parṇinīnāṃ catasṝṇāṃ pibed vā śiśiraṃ jalam|
mustadāḍimalājānāṃ ‘mudgadāḍimalājānāṃ’ iti pā. tṛṣṇāghnaṃ vā pibed rasam||150||
śītalāny annapānāni śītaśayyāsanāni ‘śītāni sadanāni ca’ iti pā. ca|
candanānāṃ ca mukhyānāṃ śastāḥ pittamadātyaye ‘saṃsparśāścandanārdrāṇāṃ strīṇāṃ pittamadātyaye’ iti pā.||155||
śītavīryaṃ yad anyac ca tat sarvaṃ viniyojayet|
kathāś ca vividhāḥ śastāḥ ‘citrāḥ’ iti pā. śabdāś ca śikhināṃ śivāḥ||157||
toyadānāṃ ca śabdā hi śamayanti madātyayam|
phenilāyāś ca yaḥ phenas tair dāhe lepanaṃ śubham|
mātrākālaprayuktena karmaṇā'nena śāmyati ‘karmaṇā'nena siddhena vikāra upaśāmyati’ iti pā.||163||

div.ab: bhavyety ādinā paittike vidhim āha| bhavyam auttarāpathikam, anye karmaraṅgam āhuḥ| mārdvīkam iti mṛdvīkārasakṛtam| satīnaḥ vartulakalāyaḥ| rogād vimucyata iti prakṛtapittamadātyayād vimucyata ity arthaḥ| kramam iti vamanānantaroktam annasaṃsarjanakramam| doṣaśeṣaḥ koṣṭhopalapako 'tra jñeyaḥ| guḍūcīty ādau rasam iti kvātham| tittiriḥ pratibhojanaṃ paścāj jīrṇe bhojanaṃ yasmin rase taṃ tittiripratibhojanam| anutarṣaṃ ca pāyayed iti bhojanasamaye tṛṣāṃ lakṣīkṛtya pāyayet; anupānaṃ dāpayed iti yāvat| etad anupānasya mātrām āha- anutarṣasyety ādi| anutarṣasyeti muhur muhur dīyamānānupānasya| yayā'sya mano na dūṣyata iti na vikṛtiṃ yāti; etena tṛṣāyāṃ manodainyamātrahantṛ yan madyaṃ bhavati tad anutarṣasañjñaṃ bhavati, na tu madaparyantaṃ madyaṃ deyam ity arthaḥ| tṛṣṇāghnam iti śītakaṣāyarūpaṃ rasam| cukrīkā cāṅgerī| badarīty ādau badaryādipatrāṇi mathitvā tajjaḥ pheno grāhyaḥ| ariṣṭakaḥ nimbaḥ||136-163||-

lg.l: jalaṃ mustaiḥ śṛtaṃ vā'pi dadyād doṣavipācanam|
etad eva ca pānīyaṃ sarvatrāpi madātyaye||167||
nirāmaṃ kāṅkṣitaṃ kāle sakṣaudraṃ ‘pāyayedbahumākṣikam’ iti pā. pāyayet tu tam||168||
śārkaraṃ madhu vā jīrṇam ariṣṭaṃ sīdhum eva vā|
rūkṣatarpaṇasaṃyuktaṃ ‘rūkṣaṃ tarpaṇasaṃyuktaṃ yavānnaṃ vā pradāpayet’ iti pā. yavānīnāgarānvitam||169||
paṭolayūṣam amlaṃ vā yūṣam āmalakasya vā||171||
vyoṣayūṣam athāmlaṃ vā yūṣaṃ vā sāmlavetasam||172||
chāgamāṃsarasaṃ rūkṣam amlaṃ vā jāṅgalaṃ rasam|
sthālyāṃ vā'tha kapāle vā bhṛṣṭaṃ nirdravavartitam ‘nīrasavartitam’ iti pā.||173||
pibec ca nigadaṃ madyaṃ kaphaprāye madātyaye||176||
etad eva punar yuktyā madhurāmlair dravīkṛtam|
sa rāgaḥ kṣaudrasaṃyuktaḥ śreṣṭho rocanadīpanaḥ ‘rocanadīpanam’ iti pā.||181||
guḍena ‘guḍena madhuśuktena vyaktāmlamadhurīkṛtān’ iti pā. madhuyuktena vyaktāmlalavaṇīkṛtān|
tair annaṃ rocate digdhaṃ samyag bhuktaṃ ca jīryati||184||
prāṇavarṇakarāṇāṃ ca ‘snānavarṇakavāsānāṃ’ iti pā. pragharṣāṇāṃ ca sevayā||186||
sevayā vasanānāṃ ca gurūṇām aguror api|

ab.seg: ullekhanety ādinā kaphamadātyayacikitsitam| tṛṣyate salilam ity ādau ṣaḍaṅgavidhinā jalasādhanaṃ sādhv iti| madhuprakṛtikaṃ mādhavam| vyoṣapradhāno yūṣo vyoṣayūṣaḥ| nīrasavartitam iti anatidravavartitaṃ śuṣkākhyaṃ vyañjanam ity arthaḥ| vṛṇuyād iti vyāpnuyāt| ārdrakapeśikā ārdrakadīrghakhaṇḍāni; ‘prabhūtārdrakapeṣitam’ iti vā pāṭhaḥ| sauvarcalam ity ādau tvagelāmaricādīnāṃ pratyekam eva bhāgārdhatvam| śarkarābhāgaḥ pūrvaikadravyabhāgaḥ| kaṭukair yuktām iti kiñcid ūṣaṇām| śvetām iti mṛdvīkāṃ, śvetā ca drākṣā kāśmīrabhavā jñeyā| kāravīm iti svalpadrākṣām| āmrāmalakayoḥ peśīty anena phalagataṃ sasyaṃ gṛhyate| saṅkocoṣṇasukhāṅgīnāṃ saṅkocena saṃśleṣeṇa uṣṇasukham aṅgaṃ yāsāṃ tāsāṃ; kecit tu saṅkocaṃ kuṅkumam āhuḥ||164-188||

lg.l: yad idaṃ karma nirdiṣṭaṃ pṛthag doṣabalaṃ prati|

ab.seg: yad idam ity ādinā sānnipātikamadātyayacikitsām āha| yady api trayodaśavidhaḥ sannipāto vṛddhadoṣāṇām uktas tathā'pi sarvamadātyayānāṃ tridoṣajatvād yad etad vātādimadātyayacikitsitam uktaṃ tad ekadoṣolbaṇasannipātajamadātyayacikitsitaṃ bhavati, tena dvyulbaṇahīnamadhyādhikabhedasamasannipātair ye daśāvaśiṣṭāḥ sannipātās tān abhipretyedam uktaṃ- sannipāte daśavidhe tad vikalpyam iti; hīnamadhyādhikadoṣatrayodbhūtamadātyayeṣu hīnamadhyādhikadoṣabhedena vikalpya cikitsā kartavyā; samasannipāte tu trayāṇām api militvā cikitsā kartavyā||189-190||

lg.l: mālyāni gandhayogāś ca vāsāṃsi vimalāni ca|
gāndharvaśabdāḥ kāntāś ca goṣṭhyaś ca hṛdayapriyāḥ||192||
nākṣobhya hi mano madyaṃ śarīram avihatya ca|
kuryān madātyayaṃ tasmād eṣṭavyā harṣaṇī kriyā||194||
ābhiḥ kriyābhiḥ siddhābhiḥ śamaṃ yāti madātyayaḥ|
na cen madyavidhiṃ muktvā kṣīram asya prayojayet||195||
grīṣmopataptasya taror yathā varṣaṃ tathā payaḥ||197||

ab.seg: madātyayasya praharṣajanikā kriyā kartavyety āha- vanānīty ādi| kasmāt punar madātyaye praharṣiṇī cikitsā kāryety āha- nākṣobhyety ādi| manaḥprītyā śarīrapraśamārthaṃ praharṣaṇī kriyā kartavyeti bhāvaḥ| uktakṣīraprayogasya viṣayaṃ guṇaṃ cāha- laṅghanair ity ādi| tatra kāryakṣīravṛttikramaṃ punar madyābhyāsakramaṃ cāha- payasā'bhihṛte ity ādi| krameṇeti kālakrameṇa| alpālpam iti stokaṃ stokam||191-198||

lg.l: dhvaṃsako ‘dhvaṃso vikṣepakaścaiva’ iti pā. vikṣayaś caiva rogas tasyopajāyate||199||
tayor liṅgaṃ cikitsā ca yathāvad upadekṣyate||200||
tayoḥ karma tad eveṣṭaṃ vātike yan madātyaye|
tau hi prakṣīṇadehasya jāyete durbalasya vai||203||

ab.seg: etadviparyayeṇa madyasevāyāṃ doṣam āha- vicchinnety ādi| dhvaṃsakavikṣayau vakṣyamāṇalakṣaṇau| dhvaṃsakavikṣayau cemau suśrutenāpy uktau| kecit tu “vicchinnamadyaḥ sahasā yo 'timadyaṃ niṣevate| tasya pānātyayoddiṣṭā vikārāḥ sambhavanti hi” iti granthena dhvaṃsakavikṣayāvarodhaṃ varṇayanti| etayoś cikitsām āha- tayor ity ādi| karmeti cikitsā| tau hīty ādinā prakṣīṇadurbalatayā dhvaṃsakavikṣayayor vātapradhānatāṃ darśayati| yuktamadyasyeti yathoktavidhinā madyam ācarataḥ||199-205||

lg.l: nivṛttaḥ sarvamadyebhyo naro yaś ca jitendriyaḥ|
śārīramānasair dhīmān vikārair na sa yujyate||206||

ab.seg: sarvathā madyaparityāgaphalam āha- nivṛtta ity ādi| jitendriya iti viśeṣaṇaṃ madyanivṛttāv eva prayojakam| śārīramānasair vikārair iti yogyatayā madyavyāpattijanyair eva śārīramānasair vikāraiḥ; anyahetujāñ śārīramānasavikārān prati madyanivṛttir akiñcitkarīti bhāvaḥ| na yujyata iti śārīramānasavikārair madyanivṛttyā na yukto bhavati||206||

tatra ślokāḥ-
yatprabhāvā bhagavatī surā peyā yathā ca sā|
yaddravyā yasya yā ceṣṭā yogaṃ cāpekṣate yathā||207||

lg.l: yathā madayate yaiś ca guṇair yuktā mahāguṇā|
yo mado madabhedāś ca ye trayaḥ svasvalakṣaṇāḥ||208||
ye ca madyakṛtā doṣā guṇā ye ca madātmakāḥ|
yac ca trividham āpānaṃ yathāsattvaṃ ca lakṣaṇam||209||
ye sahāyāḥ sukhāḥ pāne ‘ye ca’ iti pā. cirakṣipramadā narāḥ|
madātyayasya yo hetur lakṣaṇaṃ yad yathā ca yat||210||
madyaṃ madyotthitān rogān hanti yaś ca kriyākramaḥ|

ab.seg: yatprabhāvety ādir adhyāyasaṅgrahaḥ| saṅgrahārtho vyakta eva||207-211||
ity agniveśakṛte tantre carakapratisaṃskṛte cikitsāsthāne madātyayacikitsitaṃ nāma caturviṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ||24||
iti śrīcakrapāṇidattaviracitāyāṃ carakatātparyaṭīkāyām āyurvedadīpikāyāṃ cikitsāsthāne madātyayacikitsitaṃ nāma caturviṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ||24||

div.head: dvivraṇīyacikitsitam

ab.seg: athāto dvivraṇīyacikitsitaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ||1||
iti ha smāha bhagavān ātreyaḥ||2||
madyamattasya samprahārādinā vraṇotpattau vraṇacikitsārthaṃ dvivraṇīya ucyate||1-2||

lg.l: agniveśo guruṃ kāle vinayād idam abravīt||3||
bhagavan! pūrvam uddiṣṭau dvau vraṇau rogasaṅgrahe|
tayor liṅgaṃ cikitsāṃ ca vaktum arhasi śarmada!||4||

ab.seg: paraḥ mokṣaḥ, avaraṃ dravyādi ‘aparo mudrādito jātaḥ’ iti pā., taj jānātīti parāvarajñaḥ| tayor liṅgaṃ cikitsāṃ cety atra hetor api vyādhigamakatayā liṅgenaiva grahaṇam||3-4||

lg.l: ity agniveśasya vaco niśamya gurur abravīt|
yau vraṇau pūrvam uddiṣṭau nijaś cāgantur eva ca||5||
śrūyatāṃ vidhivat saumya! tayor liṅgaṃ ca ‘sabheṣajam’ iti pā. bheṣajam|
liṅgaikadeśair nirdiṣṭā viparītā nijair vraṇaiḥ ‘nijairvraṇāḥ’ iti pā.||8||

ab.seg: doṣā yady api śārīrā eva, tathā'pīha śārīrapadaṃ snāyukledādiṣv apīha prayuktadoṣavyudāsārtham| nijāgantuvraṇabhedam āha- mantrety ādi| nijaiḥ samam āgantavo vraṇā viparītā mantrādibhir bheṣajaiś ca, tathā hetubhiś ca vadhabandhanādibhiḥ, tathā liṅgaikadeśaiś ca; sa ca liṅgaikadeśo yathā- āgantur vyathāpūrvam udeti paścād vātādīn kopayati, nije tu pūrvaṃ vātādayaḥ prakupyanti paścād vyathotpadyate| yad uktaṃ- “āgantur vyathāpūrvam utpanno jaghanyaṃ vātapittaśleṣmaṇāṃ vaiṣamyam āpādayati” (sū.a.20) iti||5-8||

āgantuvraṇasya bhinnaviṣayatayā vistara iha ‘viśiṣṭateha vaktavyā’ iti pā. na vaktavyaḥ; tena tasya cikitsām api samāsād evāha- vraṇānām ity ādi| āgantūnāṃ vraṇānāṃ nijahetūnāṃ satāṃ mantrādicikitsayā aśāmyatāṃ nijānāṃ yathauṣadhaṃ vakṣyamāṇaṃ tathaiva doṣabalāvekṣī san kuryād iti yojanā| āgantūnāṃ cehāgantucikitsayā'praśamanaṃ nijadoṣānubandhād eva jñeyam; ata eveha nijahetūnām iti kṛtam||9||

yathāsvair ity ādinā nijavraṇahetusamprāptyādikathanam| atra yathāsvair hetubhir iti vacanena vātādīnāṃ svātantryeṇa prakopaṃ darśayati, svahetuduṣṭo hi doṣaḥ svatantro bhavati; kiñ ca yathāsvair hetubhir iti vacanena ya eva vātādikopahetavas ta evātra nijavraṇakārakā bhavanti, na punar vraṇānāṃ viśiṣṭo hetur asti; sāmānyavātādihetos tu viśiṣṭavraṇalakṣaṇakāryotpattiḥ samprāptibhedād bhavatīti jñeyam||10||

tṛṣṇāmohajvarasve(kle)dadāhaduṣṭyavadāraṇaiḥ|
vraṇaṃ pittakṛtaṃ vidyād gandhaiḥ srāvaiś ca pūtikaiḥ||13||

lg.l: śītalair madhurais tiktaiḥ ‘snigdhaiḥ’ iti pā. pradehapariṣecanaiḥ|
sarpiṣpānair virekaiś ca paittikaṃ śamayed vraṇam||14||
kaphavraṇaṃ praśamayet tathā laṅghanapācanaiḥ ‘laṅghanaśodhanaiḥ’ iti pā.||16||

ab.seg: stabdha ity ādinā vātādivraṇānāṃ lakṣaṇāni tathā cikitsāsūtraṃ cāha| pradehaiḥ pariṣekaiś cety atra ‘asnigdhaiḥ’ ity anuvartate| ciraṃ vikāraṃ karotīti cirakārī| cikitsāsamāsābhidhānaṃ ca sukhagrahaṇārtham eva||11-16||

lg.l: tau dvau nānātvabhedena niruktā viṃśatir vraṇāḥ|
teṣāṃ parīkṣā trividhā, praduṣṭā dvādaśa smṛtāḥ||17||
sthānāny aṣṭau tathā gandhāḥ, parisrāvāś caturdaśa|
vibhajyamānāñ chṛṇu ‘vibhāvyamānān’ iti pā. me sarvān etān yatheritān||19||

ab.seg: tau dvāv ity ādi| nānātvakārako bhedo nānātvabhedaḥ| prakarṣeṇa duṣṭāḥ praduṣṭāḥ||17-19||

lg.l: kṛtyotkṛtyas tathā ‘kṛtyākṛtyaḥ’ duṣṭo 'duṣṭo marmasthito na ca|
utsaṅgy utsanna eṣāṃ ca vraṇān vidyād viparyayāt|
iti nānātvabhedena niruktā ‘bhinnāḥ syurviṃśatirvraṇāḥ’ iti pā. viṃśatir vraṇāḥ||21||

ab.seg: ete ca vraṇabhedādayo 'gre kṛtyotkṛtya ity ādinā vyākriyante| tatra kṛtyaḥ chedanādyupakramopakramaṇīyaḥ, utkṛtyasya tu nātra kiñcit karaṇīyam asti paraṃ ropaṇīya eva; kiṃ vā kṛtyaḥ sādhyaḥ, akṛtyas tv asādhyaḥ| kṛtyādayaḥ ṣaṭ saviparyayā evoktāḥ, saṃvṛtādayas tu saptoddiṣṭāḥ saviparyayāḥ santaś caturdaśa| utsanna udgatamāṃsaḥ| utsaṅgī sthūlaparyantaḥ, kiṃ vā vraṇād bahiḥ pūyāvakāśarūpotsaṅgavān utsaṅgī| suśrute tu “tatrātisaṃvṛto 'tivivṛttaḥ” (su.sū.a.22) ity ādinā yad duṣṭavraṇalakṣaṇam uktaṃ tad atisaṃvṛtādiviṣayam, iha tu saṃvṛtatvavivṛtatvamātram ucyate, teneha duṣṭavraṇena saṃvṛtasya grahaṇam udbhāvanīyam ‘grahaṇaṃ nodbhāvanīyam’ iti pā.||20-21||

parīkṣātraividhyam uktaṃ vibhajate- darśanety ādi| indriyāṇi ca yady apy atīndriyatvād anumānagamyāni, tathā'pīha tadadhiṣṭhānānām indriyaśabdenopādānam| agniś ca yady api “agniṃ jaraṇaśaktyā” (vi.a.4) iti vacanād anumānaviṣaya uktas tathā'pi praśnenāgnir avagamyata eveti kṛtveha vacanaparīkṣaṇīyataivoktā vahneḥ| saviparyaye iti kāṭhinyauṣṇye| anumānaṃ ca yady api parīkṣādhikāre proktaṃ “dvividhā parīkṣā jñānavatāṃ pratyakṣam anumānaṃ ca” (vi.a.4) ity ādinā, tathā'py atrānumānasya prāyo vyāpārābhāvād anupādānam iti brūte; kintu darśanādipūrvakatvād anumānasya darśanādinā anumānam apy atīndriyādiṣu grāhakaṃ saṅgṛhītam iti yuktaṃ paśyāmaḥ| darśanaśabdaś cātra sākṣādupalabdhivacanaḥ, tena vraṇagatagandhenāpi vraṇaparīkṣaṇaṃ saṅgṛhītaṃ bhavati| darśanaśabdena ca gṛhīto 'pi sparśa iha bhūyasā vyāpriyamāṇatvāt punaruktaḥ||22-23||

lg.l: śveto 'vasannavartmā'tisthūlavartmā'tipiñjaraḥ ‘śveto'vasannacarmā ca sthūlacarmā'tipiñjaraḥ’ iti gaṅgādharasammataḥ pāṭhaḥ|
ropyaḥ kumbhīmukhaś ceti praduṣṭā dvādaśa vraṇāḥ|
caturviṃśatir uddiṣṭā ‘gaṅgādharastvetamardhaślokaṃ “ṣoḍaśopadravāḥ proktā vraṇānāṃ vraṇacintakaiḥ” ityanantaraṃ paṭhati doṣāḥ kalpāntareṇa vai||25||

ab.seg: śveto 'vasannety ādinā praduṣṭavraṇān āha| ropyalakṣaṇaṃ tantrāntarād avagantavyaṃ, tathā hi bhojaḥ- “rūḍhā rūḍhāḥ prakupyanti sāntardoṣāḥ punaḥ punaḥ| bahiḥ śuddhā ivābhānti ropyās te samprakīrtitāḥ” iti| eteṣām eva śvetādīnāṃ bhedakāraṇāntarabhedena caturviṃśatitvaṃ bhavatīti darśayann āha- caturviṃśatir ity ādi| kalpāntareṇeti vraṇaduṣṭikārakakāraṇayogabhedena snāyukledādinā bhidyamānāś caturviṃśatibhedā bhavantīty arthaḥ||24-25||
tvag ity ādinā sthānanirdeśaḥ| antarāśrayaḥ koṣṭhaḥ||26||
sarpir ity ādinā gandhanirdeśaḥ| śyāvagandhaṃ dadhyādes tāmraghṛṣṭasamānaṃ gandham āhuḥ; kecit tu ‘śāvaṃ’ iti paṭhanti; śavasya gandhaḥ śāvaḥ| amlasahacaritagandho 'mlagandha ucyate||27||

lg.l: kāsaś chardir atīsāro hikkā śvāsaḥ savepathuḥ||30||

div.ab: lasīkety ādinā srāvān āha||28-30||-

lg.l: snāyukledāt sirākledād gāmbhīryāt kṛmibhakṣaṇāt ‘sirācchedāt’ iti pā.||31||
asthibhedāt saśalyatvāt saviṣatvāc ca ‘saviṣatvādatarkaṇāt’ iti pā. sarpaṇāt|
śokāt krodhād divāsvapnād vyāyāmān maithunāt tathā|
vraṇā na praśamaṃ yānti niṣkriyatvāc ca dehinām||34||
parisrāvāc ca gandhāc ca doṣāc copadravaiḥ saha|

ab.seg: prakārāntaroddiṣṭāñ caturviṃśatidoṣān āha- snāyukledād ity ādi| atra nakhakāṣṭhaprabheda ekam eva kāraṇam| carmalomātighaṭṭanaṃ tu kāraṇadvayam| cikitsāvarjanīyatvaṃ niṣkriyatvam||31-35||

lg.l: guṇair anyatamair hīnas tataḥ kṛcchro vraṇaḥ smṛtaḥ|
sarvair vihīno vijñeyas tv asādhyo nirupakramaḥ ‘bhūryupadravaḥ’ iti pā.||37||

ab.seg: asādhyo nirupakrama iti asādhyatvam abhidhāyāpi nirupakramatābhidhānena sopakramasādhyaṃ yāpyaṃ niṣedhayati||36-37||

lg.l: ūrdhvabhāgair adhobhāgaiḥ śastrair bastibhir eva ca||38||
sadyaḥ śuddhaśarīrāṇāṃ praśamaṃ yānti hi vraṇāḥ|39|

div.ab: avasaraprāptāyāṃ ṣaṭtriṃśadupakramarūpāyāṃ cikitsāyāṃ vaktavyāyāṃ saṃśodhanasya prādhānyopadarśanārthaṃ pṛthag agre 'bhidhānaṃ- vraṇānām ity ādinā||38||-

lg.l: yathākramam ataś cordhvaṃ śṛṇu sarvān upakramān||39||
dve taile tadguṇe ‘dve taile ca ghṛte’ iti pā. patraṃ chādane dve ca bandhane||41||

ab.seg: upakramān āha- śophaghnam ity ādinā| śophaghna upakramo raktāvasekādir vakṣyamāṇaḥ| ṣaḍvidhaṃ śastrakarmeti pāṭanādi; atraivāharaṇam eṣaṇaṃ ca śalyatantroktam adhikaṃ karmadvayam antarbhāvanīyaṃ; kiṃ veṣaṇaṃ śastrakarmāṅgaṃ na śastrakarma, tat tu pṛthag eva| avapīḍanaṃ kalkādinā ālepanaṃ pūyanirgamanārthaṃ vakṣyati| nirvāpaṇaṃ dāhauṣṇyaśamanam| śodhanau ropaṇīyau ca kaṣāyau sapralepanau iti śodhanaropaṇakaṣāyau tathā śodhanaropaṇālepau| dve taile tadguṇe ity atra ghṛtasyāpi snehatvasāmānyāt tailenaiva grahaṇaṃ; tena yady api catvāri tailaghṛtāni pratyekaśodhanaropaṇabhedād vakṣyati, tathā'pi śodhanaropaṇakarmadvayakartṛtayā dvitvam evātra tailaghṛtayor gaṇanīyam| kāśmīrās tu “dvau snehau tadguṇau” iti paṭhanti| patraṃ chādane iti patram eka upakramaḥ, chādanaṃ tu dvividhaṃ bāhyāntarabhedena vakṣyamāṇam| utsādanaṃ nimnavraṇotthāpanam| avasādanam utsannavraṇamāṃsakṣayakaram| kāṭhinyamārdavakare dhūpanālepane iti kāṭhinyakaraṃ dhūpanaṃ, mārdavakaraṃ dhūpanaṃ ceti; evam ālepanam api dvividhaṃ jñeyam| vraṇāvacūrṇanaṃ dvividhaṃ vadanti tvagvarṇakararomajanakabhedena| evaṃ ṣaṭtriṃśadupakramā bhavanti; śalyatantre tu ṣaṣṭir upakramā uktās te 'py atraivāntarbhāvanīyāḥ||39-43||

lg.l: pūrvarūpaṃ bhiṣag buddhvā vraṇānāṃ śopham āditaḥ|
saktavo madhukaṃ sarpiḥ pradehaḥ syāt saśarkaraḥ|

ab.seg: atha yathāvasthaṃ vraṇopakramān āha- pūrvarūpam ity ādi| śothas tu vraṇapūrvarūpaṃ, śothacikitsā'nāgatavraṇavihitatvādvraṇopakramatvenoktā| kaṣāyapānaiḥ sarpirbhiś ceti kaṣāyasarpirbhiḥ| vijayā balā||44-48||

lg.l: sa ced evam upakrāntaḥ śopho na praśamaṃ vrajet|
tailena sarpiṣā vā'pi tābhyāṃ vā saktupiṇḍikā|
sukumārasya, kṛcchrasya śastraṃ tu param ucyate||54||

ab.seg: upanāhair iti soṣṇabahalalepaiḥ| kiṇvaṃ surābījam| umā atasī| saudhaṃ payaḥ snuhīkṣīram| hemakṣīrī kaṅkuṣṭham| mukūlakaḥ dantī| sukumārasyeti cchedaḥ| kṛcchrasyeti asukumārasya, śastraṃ paraṃ bhedanamiti sambandhaḥ||49-54||

lg.l: pāṭanaṃ vyadhanaṃ caiva chedanaṃ lepanaṃ tathā|
pracchanaṃ sīvanaṃ caiva ṣaḍvidhaṃ śastrakarma tat||55||

ab.seg: pāṭanam ity ādinā prokte ṣaḍvidhaśastrakarmaṇi tisraiṣaṇīyoktādhikadāraṇādiśastrakarmāvarodho boddhavyaḥ, tena na virodhaḥ||55||

lg.l: antaḥśalyāś ca ye śophāḥ ‘deśāḥ’ iti pā. pāṭyās te tadvidhāś ca ye||56||
dakodarāṇi sampakvā gulmā ye ye ca raktajāḥ|
kuṣṭhāny abhihataṃ cāṅgaṃ śothāṃś ca pracchayed bhiṣak|
sīvyaṃ kukṣyudarādyaṃ tu gambhīraṃ yad vipāṭitam||60||

div.ab: pāṭanādīnāṃ pṛthagviṣayam āha- nāḍīvraṇā ity ādi| sampakva gulmā ye te vyadhyāḥ| tathā ye ca raktajā iti raktagulmāḥ| śoṇitarogā vidhiśoṇitīyoktāḥ| vyadhyā iti sirāvyadhādisādhyāḥ| lekhyānīti lekhanāvasthāprāptāni||56-60||-

lg.l: sūkṣmānanāḥ koṣavanto ye vraṇās tān prapīḍayet||61||
kalāyāś ca masūrāś ca godhūmāḥ sahareṇavaḥ|

ab.seg: vraṇapīḍane iti vraṇapīḍanaś ca lepo niḥsneho vraṇamukhaṃ varjayitvā kartavyaḥ||61-62||

lg.l: ālepanaṃ nirvapaṇaṃ tad vidyāt taiś ca ‘tadvidhānyaiśca’ iti pā. secanam|

div.ab: nyagrodhādikam iti nyagrodhodumbarāśvatthety ādinoktam atraiva| balādikaṃ ‘vijayā madhukaṃ vīrā’ ity ādinā śothaharopakramopadiṣṭam||63-64||-

lg.l: dhātakīlodhracūrṇair vā tathā rohanti te vraṇāḥ|68|

div.ab: lambānīty ādinā sandhānopakramam āha| śuktiḥ badarikā||65-67||-

lg.l: asthibhagnaṃ cyutaṃ sandhiṃ sandadhīta samaṃ punaḥ||68||
avidāhibhir annaiś ca paiṣṭikais tam upācaret||70||
glānir hi na hitā tasya sandhiviśleṣakārikā|
upācared yathākālaṃ ‘upakrame...’ iti pā. kālajñaḥ svāc cikitsitāt|72|

div.ab: samena samam aṅgena kṛtveti samenāvikṛtenānyenāṅgena samaṃ sadṛśaṃ kṛtvā sandadhīteti yojyam| kavalikākuśikābandhau suśrute draṣṭavyau ‘anusartavyau’ iti pā.| vicyutābhihatāṅgānām ity ādau ‘ānāhādīn upakramān’ iti kecit paṭhanti asyāgre ‘suśrutānumataścāyaṃ pāṭhaḥ’ ityadhikaṃ paṭhyate hastalikhitapustake| svāc cikitsitād iti visarpādicikitsitāt||68-71||-

lg.l: śuṣkā mahārujaḥ stabdhā ye vraṇā mārutottarāḥ|
teṣām umāṃ tilāṃś caiva bhṛṣṭān payasi nirvṛtān||74||
tenaiva payasā piṣṭvā kuryād ālepanaṃ bhiṣak|
jīvantī śarkarā kṣīraṃ tailaṃ matsyavasā ghṛtam|
rugdāhayoḥ praśamano vraṇeṣv eṣa vidhir hitaḥ||79||

ab.seg: balā guḍūcīty ādi| atra balādīni piṣṭāni śarkarākṣīramadhūcchiṣṭatailādibhiḥ samair utkarikāṃ kṛtvā svedaḥ kartavyaḥ; anye tu balādikalkena tailādisnehaṃ caturguṇe kṣīre sādhayitvā snehapādikaṃ madhūcchiṣṭaprakṣepam āhuḥ| snehasyātra saṃhatāvasthitatvāt madhuśarkarāvat ‘snehaśarkarā’ iti vyapadeśaḥ| dvipañcamūlakvathiteneti ambhasā payasā sarpiṣā tailena veti yojanīyam||72-79||

lg.l: na ca marmāśritās teṣām eṣaṇaṃ hitam ucyate||80||
dvividhām eṣaṇīṃ vidyān mṛdvīṃ ca kaṭhinām api|
audbhidair mṛdubhir nālair lohānāṃ vā śalākayā||81||
eṣyaṃ vidyād vraṇaṃ nālair viparītam ato bhiṣak||82||

ab.seg: dvividhām ity ādau audbhidair mṛdubhir nālaiḥ mṛdvīṃ, lohaiḥ kaṭhinām| pāṭhyam iti eṣaṇīyaṃ pāṭhyaṃ ca||80-82||

lg.l: triphalā khadiro dārvī nyagrodhādir balā ‘nyagrodho'tibalā’ iti pā. kuśaḥ|
tilakalkaḥ salavaṇo dve haridre trivṛd dhṛtam|

ab.seg: nimbakolakapatrāṇīty atra nimba eva mṛdur nimbakolaka ucyate; kiṃ vā kulaketi pāṭhaḥ, kulakaḥ paṭolaḥ||83-85||

lg.l: na cotsanno na cotsaṅgī śuddho ropyaḥ paraṃ vraṇaḥ||86||
mede mūrvā samaṅgā ca yaṣṭyāhvaṃ vraṇaropaṇam||88||
ropaṇaṃ satilaṃ dadyāt pralepaṃ saghṛtaṃ vraṇe||89||
paṭolaṃ picumardaṃ ca lodhraṃ mustaṃ priyaṅgukam||90||
piṣṭvā sādhyaṃ bhavettailaṃ tat paraṃ vraṇaropaṇam||91||
prapauṇḍarīkaṃ madhukaṃ kākolyau dve ca candane|
siddham etaiḥ samais tailaṃ paraṃ syād vraṇaropaṇam||92||
yenaiva vidhinā tailaṃ ghṛtaṃ tenaiva sādhayet|

ab.seg: nātirakta ity ādinā śuddhavraṇalakṣaṇam abhidhāya ropaṇam āha- nyagrodhety ādi| kaṣāyā iti bahuvacananirdeśād yathoktavyastasamastaprayogān sūcayati| dārvyās tvak dārvītvak vraṇaśodhanī ropaṇī ca| ghṛtaṃ tair eva sādhayed iti yathoktatailadravyair eva sādhayed iti| ghṛtaviṣayam āha- raktapittottaram ity ādi| ropaṇīyam iti vacanād ropaṇam eva ghṛtaṃ kartavyaṃ, na tu śodhanārthaṃ ghṛtaṃ kartavyam ity arthaḥ||86-94||

lg.l: bandhaś ca dvividhaḥ śasto vraṇānāṃ savyadakṣiṇaḥ||96||

ab.seg: vārkṣa ity ādau vṛkṣabhavaṃ valkalaṃ vārkṣam| savyadakṣiṇa iti vāmadakṣiṇaḥ; vāmaparikṣepaḥ savyaḥ, dakṣiṇaparikṣepo dakṣiṇaḥ| atraiva śalyoktacaturdaśabandhāvarodhaḥ kāryaḥ||95-96||
stanyāni ṣaḍvirecanaśatāśritīyoktāni| aśmakāsīsaṃ dhātukāsīsam| adhobhāgāni trivṛtādīni virecanadravyāṇi||97-100||

lg.l: kl̥pteṣu ‘supteṣu’ iti pā. cāṅgadeśeṣu karmāgneḥ sampraśasyate||102||
taptair vā vividhair lohair dahed dāhaviśeṣavit||103||

ab.seg: chedye iti chedanārhe| klṛpteṣv iti kartiteṣu| rūkṣasnigdhadāhabhedaviṣayaṃ dāhakavastubhedaṃ ca darśayann āha- sukumārāṇām ity ādinā| dāhaviśeṣavid iti dāhānāṃ viśeṣaṃ snigdharūkṣādirūpaṃ tathā binduvalayādirūpaṃ jānātīti dāhaviśeṣavit| viṣādinām iti bhakṣitaviṣāṇām||101-106||

lg.l: kaṭhinatvaṃ vraṇā yānti gandhaiḥ sāraiś ca dhūpitāḥ|
rujaḥ srāvāś ca gandhāś ca kṛmayaś ca vraṇāśritāḥ|

ab.seg: yady apy upakrameṣu kṣāraḥ pṛthaṅ na paṭhitaḥ, tathā'pi śastrāgnivyāpārakartṛtvāc chastrāgnyupakramagṛhīta eveti kṛtvā kṣāram apy avacārayed iti vacanena kṣāro 'pi vihitaḥ||107-109||

lg.l: sarujaḥ kaṭhināḥ stabdhā nirāsrāvāś ca ye vraṇāḥ|
saghṛtair jīvanīyair vā tarpayet tān abhīkṣṇaśaḥ||112||

ab.seg: tarpayediti tarpaṇārthaṃ lepaṃ kārayet||110-112||

lg.l: tvacam āśv eva gṛhṇanti tvakcūrṇaiś cūrṇitā vraṇāḥ||113||
manaḥśilailā ‘manaḥśilāle’ iti pā. mañjiṣṭhā lākṣā ca rajanīdvayam|
karoti lepaḥ kṛṣṇatvaṃ ‘pralepaḥ kurute kārṣṇyaṃ’ iti pā. sadya eva navatvaci||115||
tailāktā cūrṇitā bhūmir bhavel lomavatī punaḥ||118||
teṣāṃ cikitsā nirdiṣṭā yathāsvaṃ sve cikitsite||119||

ab.seg: kakubhety ādiprakaraṇena tvagjananaṃ tathā savarṇakaraṇaṃ tathā romajananamiti upakramatrayamāha| tvacam āśv eva gṛhṇantīti satvaco bhavanti| triphalākusumānīti triphalāvṛkṣapuṣpāṇi| latā priyaṅguḥ| kāntā mañjiṣṭhā| rasottamaḥ pāradaḥ, ghṛtaṃ vā| amṛtāsaṅgaḥ karparikātuttham||113-119||

tatra ślokau-
dvau vraṇau vraṇabhedāś ca parīkṣā duṣṭir eva ca|
sthānāni gandhāḥ srāvāś ca sopasargāḥ kriyāś ca yāḥ||120||
dvau vraṇāv ity ādyadhyāyasaṅgraho vyaktaḥ||120-121||
ity agniveśakṛte tantre carakapratisaṃskṛte dṛḍhabalasampūrite cikitsāsthāne dvivraṇīyacikitsitaṃ nāma pañcaviṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ||25||
iti śrīcakrapāṇidattaviracitāyāṃ carakatātparyaṭīkāyām āyurvedadīpikāyāṃ cikitsāsthāne dvivraṇīyacikitsitaṃ nāma pañcaviṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ||25||

div.head: trimarmīyacikitsitam

ab.seg: athātas trimarmīyacikitsitam adhyāyaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ||1||
iti ha smāha bhagavān ātreyaḥ||2||

dvivraṇīye dvisaṅkhyāvacchinnarogacikitsābhidhānānantaraṃ trisaṅkhyāvacchinnaśirobastihṛdayamarmarogacikitsābhidhānārthaṃ trimarmīyacikitsita ucyate| trimarmaśabdena hi trimarmāśritā rogās tasyopacāraś cābhidhīyate; tena trimarmīyarogān adhikṛtya kṛtaṃ cikitsitaṃ trimarmīyacikitsitam||1-2||

lg.l: saptottaraṃ marmaśataṃ yad uktaṃ śarīrasaṅkhyām adhikṛtya tebhyaḥ|
marmāṇi bastiṃ hṛdayaṃ śiraś ca pradhānabhūtāni vadanti tajjñāḥ||3||
prāṇāśrayāt, tāni hi pīḍayanto vātādayo 'sūn api pīḍayanti|
tatsaṃśritānām anupālanārthaṃ mahāgadānāṃ śṛṇu saumya rakṣām||4||

ab.seg: prakṛtapradhānamarmatrayam avadhārayati- saptottaram ity ādi| śarīrasaṅkhyām adhikṛtyeti śarīrasaṅkhyāśārīre (śā.a.7) uktam adhikṛtyety arthaḥ| hṛdayādimarmaprādhānye hetum āha- prāṇāśrayād iti| hṛdayādīnāṃ prāṇāśrayatve evopapattim āha- tānīty ādi| hṛdayādyupaghātena yasmād viśeṣataḥ prāṇopaghāto bhavati, tasmād hṛdayādyāśritāḥ prāṇā ucyante; yathā bhittyupaghātopahanyamānaṃ citraṃ bhittyāśrayam ucyate| tatsaṃśritānām iti prāṇāśrayāṇāṃ hṛdayādīnāṃ; saṃśritaśabdena hi saṃśraya ucyate| mahānto gadā yeṣu bhavanti teṣāṃ mahāgadānāṃ bastyādīnām anupālanārthaṃ rakṣāṃ śṛṇu; kiṃ vā tatsaṃśritānām iti bastyādisaṃśritānāṃ prāṇānām anupālanārthaṃ, mahāgadānāṃ mahāmarmabastyādivyāpakodāvartādīnāṃ, rakṣām iti cikitsām||3-4||

lg.l: pakvāśaye kupyati ced apānaḥ srotāṃsy adhogāni balī sa ruddhvā||5||
karoti viṇmārutamūtrasaṅgaṃ kramād udāvartam ataḥ sughoram|
rug bastihṛtkukṣyudareṣv abhīkṣṇaṃ sapṛṣṭhapārśveṣv atidāruṇā syāt||6||
varco 'pravṛttir jaṭhare ca gaṇḍāny ūrdhvaś ca ‘jaṭhare gaṇḍo hyūrdhvaṃ ca vāyau vihate gude syād’ iti gaṅgādharasammataḥ pāṭhaḥ vāyur vihato gude syāt||7||
kṛcchreṇa śuṣkasya cirāt pravṛttiḥ syād vā tanuḥ syāt khararūkṣaśītā|
anye ca rogā bahavo 'nilotthā bhavanty udāvartakṛtāḥ sughorāḥ|
cikitsitaṃ cāsya yathāvad ūrdhvaṃ pravakṣyate tac chṛṇu cāgniveśa!||10||

ab.seg: bastyādijānāṃ yathākramaṃ hetvādim āha- kaṣāyety ādi| ūṣaṇaḥ kaṭukaḥ| pakvāśaye ity ādinā udāvartasamprāptiliṅgacikitsitāni prāha| nanu katham apānaḥ kupito 'pānasyaiva saṅgaṃ karotīti mārutasaṅgaśabdenocyate? brūmaḥ- ātmanaivāyaṃ duṣṭaḥ samyag apravartamāna ātmanaḥ saṅgaṃ karotīty ucyate, yathā mana eva manonigrahaṃ karoti| uktaṃ ca “indriyābhigrahaḥ karma manasaḥ svasya nigrahaḥ” (śā.a.1) iti| ūrdhvaś ceti ūrdhvagamanasvabhāvaḥ||5-10||

lg.l: sanīlikāṃ dvirlavaṇāṃ guḍena vartiṃ karāṅguṣṭhanibhāṃ vidadhyāt||12||
śyāmāphalālābukapippalīnāṃ nāḍyā'thavā tat pradhamet tu cūrṇam||14||
snigdhe gude tāny anulomayanti narasya varco 'nilamūtrasaṅgam||15||
teṣāṃ vighāte tu bhiṣag vidadhyāt svabhyaktasusvinnatanor nirūham|
vāte 'dhike 'mlaṃ lavaṇaṃ satailaṃ, kṣīreṇa pitte tu, kaphe samūtram|
sa mūtravarco 'nilasaṅgam āśu gudaṃ sirāś ca praguṇīkaroti||17||

ab.seg: tailajvaranāśanāktam iti śītajvaranāśanāgurvādyāktam| śyāmety ādiphalavartau śyāmā trivṛdbhedaḥ| daśabhāgā māṣasya yasyāṃ sā daśabhāgamāṣā| dvirlavaṇām iti dvibhāgalavaṇām| guḍenetivacanena yāvatā guḍena vartiḥ kartuṃ yujyate tāvanmāno guḍo deyaḥ| yāvaśūkair ity antena dvitīyā vartir guḍainaiva ‘māṣaguḍenaiva’ iti pā. kartavyā| śaṅkhinī śvetabuhnā| rāḍhaḥ madanaphalam| veśmadhūmaḥ agāradhūmaḥ| rakṣoghnaḥ sarṣapaḥ| karahāṭaḥ madanaḥ| teṣāṃ vighāte iti phalavarticūrṇanām uktānāṃ kāryākaraṇe| ūrdhvānulomauṣadhaṃ vamanavirecanauṣadham| vāte 'dhika ity ādinā doṣabhedena bastāv āvāpam āha| udāvarte pittakaphau vātakopitāv eva jñeyau| sa iti pūrvokto bastiḥ||11-17||
prasannā madyopari svaccho bhāgaḥ| guḍakṛtaḥ sīdhuḥ guḍasīdhuḥ||18||

lg.l: svasthaṃ tu paścād anuvāsayet taṃ raukṣyād dhi saṅgo 'nilavarcasoś cet||19||

ab.seg: bhūyo 'nubandhe iti bastiprayoge saty apy udāvartānubandhe| etac ca virecanaṃ bastidānāt saptāhād ūrdhvam| yad uktaṃ- “naro viriktas tu nirūhadānaṃ vivarjayet saptadināny avaśyam| śuddho nirūheṇa virecanaṃ ca” (si.a.1) iti||19||

lg.l: dviruttaraṃ hiṅgu vacāgnikuṣṭhaṃ ‘vacā sakṛṣṇā’ iti pā. suvarcikā caiva viḍaṅgacūrṇam|

ab.seg: dviruttarety ādau yathottaraṃ dravyāṇāṃ dvaiguṇyam| suvarcikā svarjikākṣāraḥ| sukhāmbunā ‘pītam’ iti śeṣaḥ| ugragandhā ajamodā||20-22||

lg.l: siddhaḥ kaṣāye dvipalāṃśikānāṃ prastho ghṛtāt syāt pratiruddhavāte||23||

ab.seg: sthirādivargasyeti alpapañcamūlasya| śampākapūtīkakarañjayoś cety atra pūtīkaśabdaḥ karañjaviśeṣaṇam| tathā hi jatūkarṇaḥ- “āragvadhapūtikapunarnavāsthirādyair ghṛtaṃ siddhamḥ” ity ādi||23||

lg.l: phalaṃ ca mūlaṃ ca virecanoktaṃ hiṅgvarkamūlaṃ daśamūlam agryam|
snuk citrakaś caiva punarnavā ca tulyāni sarvair lavaṇāni pañca||24||
snehaiḥ samūtraiḥ saha jarjarāṇi śarāvasandhau vipacet sulipte|
pakvaṃ supiṣṭaṃ lavaṇaṃ tad annaiḥ pānais tathā''nāharujāghnam adyāt||25||

ab.seg: phalaṃ ca mūlaṃ ca virecanoktam iti dīrghañjīvitīye (sū.a.1) mūlinīphalinīvirecanakarmaṇy uktaṃ; kiṃ vā kalpe virecanayogeṣu vakṣyamāṇam||24-25||

div.ab:
hṛtstambhamūrdhāmayagauravābhyām udgārasaṅgena sapīnasena|
ānāham āmaprabhavaṃ jayet tu pracchardanair laṅghanapācanaiś ca||26||
(gulmodarabradhnārśaḥplīhodāvartayoniśukragade cakrapāṇigaṅgādharābhyāmavyākhyātatvādayaṃ pāṭhaḥ prakṣipta iti pratibhāti|
medaḥkaphasaṃsṛṣṭe mārutarakte 'vagāḍhe ca||27||
gṛdhrasipakṣavadhādiṣu virecanārheṣu vātarogeṣu|
vāte vibaddhamārge medaḥkaphapittaraktena||28||
payasā māṃsarasair vā triphalārasayūṣamūtramadirābhiḥ|
doṣānubandhayogāt praśastam eraṇḍajaṃ tailam||29||
tad vātanutsvabhāvāt saṃyogavaśād virecanāc ca jayet|
medosṛkpittakaphonmiśrānilarogajit tasmāt||30|| balakoṣṭhavyādhivaśād āpañcapalā bhaven mātrā| mṛdukoṣṭhālpabalānāṃ saha bhojyaṃ tat prayojyaṃ syat)||31|| ity udāvartacikitsā|

ab.seg: hṛd ity ādinā udāvartasyaiva hetulakṣaṇaviśeṣakṛtām ānāhasañjñāṃ pradarśya tatra bheṣajam āha||26-31||

lg.l: ānūpamatsyādhyaśanād ajīrṇāt syur mūtrakṛcchrāṇi nṛṇām ihāṣṭau||32||
pṛthaṅ malāḥ svaiḥ kupitā nidānaiḥ sarve 'thavā kopam upetya bastau|
mūtrasya mārgaṃ paripīḍayanti yadā tadā mūtrayatīha kṛcchrāt||33||
tīvrā rujo vaṅkṣaṇabastimeḍhre svalpaṃ muhur mūtrayatīha vātāt|
pītaṃ saraktaṃ sarujaṃ sadāhaṃ kṛcchrān muhur mūtrayatīha pittāt||34||
basteḥ saliṅgasya gurutvaśothau mūtraṃ sapicchaṃ kaphamūtrakṛcchre|
sarvāṇi rūpāṇi tu sannipātād bhavanti tat kṛcchratamaṃ hi kṛcchram||35||

ab.seg: vyāyāmety ādinā bastyāśrayarogeṣu mūtrakṛcchrāṇy āha| pṛthag ity ādinā vātapittakaphasannipātajānāṃ mūtrakṛcchrāṇāṃ samprāptim āha| tīvrā hi rug ity ādinā caturṇāṃ pratyekaṃ rūpam āha||32-35||

lg.l: viśoṣayed bastigataṃ saśukraṃ mūtraṃ sapittaṃ pavanaḥ kaphaṃ vā|
yadā tadā'śmary upajāyate tu krameṇa pitteṣv iva rocanā goḥ||36||

ab.seg: viśoṣayed ity ādinā catuṣprakārān apy aśmarīrogān āha| tantrāntare 'śmaryas tu vātapittakaphaśukrajā uktāḥ; yady api sarvāśmarīṣu doṣatrayajanyatvam asti, “saṃhanty āpo yathā divyā māruto 'gniś ca vaidyutaḥ| tadvad balāsaṃ bastistham ūṣmā saṃhanti sanilaḥ” (su. ni. a. 3) iti suśruta pratipāditaṃ; tathā'py utkaṭaikadoṣābhiprāyeṇa vātajādivyapadeśo jñeyaḥ| vātajāyām aśmaryāṃ prabalena vāyunā mūtraśoṣe kriyamāṇe tadgataḥ kapha evāśmarīrūpaḥ kriyate, evaṃ pittāśmaryām api jñeyam, ata eva suśrute śleṣmādhiṣṭhānāḥ sarvā evāśmarya uktāḥ| aśmaryutpāde dṛṣṭāntam āha- pitteṣv iva rocanā gor iti; pitteṣv iti bahuvacanaṃ pittabahutvāpekṣayā ‘bahuśogatapittabahutvāpekṣayā’ iti pā.||36||

lg.l: kadambapuṣpākṛtir aśmatulyā ślakṣṇā tripuṭy apy athavā'pi mṛdvī|
mūtrasya cen mārgam upaiti ruddhvā mūtraṃ rujaṃ tasya karoti bastau||37||
mṛdnāti meḍhraṃ sa tu vedanārto muhuḥ śakṛn muñcati mehate ca||38||
kṣobhāt kṣate mūtrayatīha sāsṛk tasyāḥ sukhaṃ mehati ca vyapāyāt|39|

div.ab: kadambapuṣpākṛtyādayo viśeṣā yathāyogyatayā doṣabhedād unneyāḥ| tatra vātena kadambapuṣpākṛtis tripuṭī ca, pittenāśmatulyā ślakṣṇā, mṛdvī kaphena śukreṇa ca| kṣobhāt kṣata iti aśmarīkṣobhān mūtramārge bastau vā kṣate| tasyā iti aśmaryāḥ| vyapāyād iti mūtramārgāpagamāt| sukham iti nirvedanam||37-38||-

lg.l: eṣā'śmarī mārutabhinnamūrtiḥ syāc charkarā mūtrapathāt kṣarantī||39||
śukreṇa saṃruddhagatipravāho mūtraṃ sa kṛcchreṇa vimuñcatīha|
tam aṇḍayoḥ stabdham iti bruvanti reto 'bhighātāt pravadanti kṛcchram ayaṃ pāṭho'nārṣa iti pratibhāti )||41||

ab.seg: eṣety ādinā śarkarām āha| bhinnamūrtir iti aṇurūpatayā bheditamūrtiḥ| ata eva mūtrapathāt kṣarantīty uktam| tena vātena dvidhā tridhā bhinnā'nekadhā vā'śmarī mūtrapathena kṣarantī śarkareva bhavati||39-41||

lg.l: śukraṃ malāś caiva pṛthak pṛthag vā mūtrāśayasthāḥ prativārayanti|
tadvyāhataṃ mehanabastiśūlaṃ mūtraṃ saśukraṃ kurute vibaddham||42||
stabdhaś ca śūno bhṛśavedanaś ca tudyeta bastir vṛṣaṇau ca tasya|43|

div.ab: śukraṃ malā ity ādinā śukrajamūtrakṛcchralakṣaṇam| mūtrāśayasthā iti mūtramārgasthitāḥ||42||-

kṣatābhighātāt kṣatajaṃ kṣayād vā prakopitaṃ bastigataṃ vibaddham||43||
tīvrārti mūtreṇa sahāśmarītvam āyāti tasminn atisañcite ca|
ādhmātatāṃ vindati gauravaṃ ca baster laghutvaṃ ca viniḥsṛte 'smin||44|| iti mūtrakṛcchranidānam|

ab.seg: kṣatety ādinā raktajaṃ mūtrakṛcchram āha| kṣatajam iti raktam| kṣayād vā prakopitam iti ativyavāyāc chukrakṣaye sati vāyunodīrya bastim ānītam| ādhmātatām iti bastipūrṇatām| tasminn iti rakte atisañcite| evaṃ sūtrasthānoddiṣṭā aṣṭau mūtraghātā mūtrakṛcchraśabdeneha nirdiśya vyākṛtāḥ| ye tu trimarmīyasiddhau trayodaśa mūtrāghātā vaktavyās te sūtrasthāne 'sūtritā api ekādaśakṣudrakuṣṭhavad antarbhāvanīyāḥ| mūtrāghātamūtrakṛcchrayoś cāyaṃ viśeṣaḥ- yan mūtrakṛcchre mūtraṃ kṛcchreṇa vahati, mūtrāghāte mūtraṃ śoṣyate pratihanyate vā; suśrute 'pi ca mūtrakṛcchramūtrāghātayor viśeṣo 'dhyāyabhedenaivoktaḥ| anye tu mūtrakṛcchraviśeṣān eva mūtrāghātān āhuḥ, yathāyogyatayā vātapittādicaturṣu mūtrakṛcchreṣu mūtrāghātān antarbhāvayanti; tena na pṛthaṅmūtrāghātābhidhānam||43-44||

lg.l: sthirādibhir vātaharaiś ca siddhān dadyād rasāṃś cānilamūtrakṛcchre||45||
tailaṃ varāharkṣavasā ghṛtaṃ ca tair eva kalkair lavaṇaiś ca sādhyam|
tan mātrayā''śu pratihanti pītaṃ śūlānvitaṃ mārutamūtrakṛcchram||47||
etāni cānyāni varauṣadhāni piṣṭāni śastāny api copanāhe|
syur lābhatas tailaphalāni caiva snehāmlayuktāni sukhoṣṇavanti||48||

ab.seg: mūtrakṛcchre cikitsām āha- abhyañjanety ādi| sthirādibhiḥ pañcamūlaiḥ| vātaharair iti tatra tatra vātaharatvena pratipāditaiḥ| pattūraḥ śāliñcakā| aśmabhit pāṣāṇabhedaḥ| anyānīti evaṅguṇāny evānyāni| tailaphalāni tilomāsphotādīni||45-48||

lg.l: sekāvagāhāḥ śiśirāḥ pradehā graiṣmo vidhir bastipayovirekāḥ|
drākṣāvidārīkṣurasair ghṛtaiś ca kṛcchreṣu pittaprabhaveṣu kāryāḥ||49||
kvāthaṃ suśītaṃ madhuśarkarābhyāṃ yuktaṃ pibet paittikamūtrakṛcchrī||50||
pibet kaṣāyaṃ kamalotpalānāṃ śṛṅgāṭakānām athavā vidāryāḥ|
daṇḍairakāṇām athavā'pi ‘daṇḍotpalānāṃ’ iti pā. mūlaṃ pūrveṇa kalpena tathā'mbu śītam||51||

ab.seg: graiṣmo vidhir iti tasyāśītīyokto grīṣmavidhiḥ| tatra śiśirāv eva sekāvagāhau yady apy uktau, tathā'pi viśeṣeṇa śiśirasekāvagāhakaraṇārthaṃ punarabhidhānam| daṇḍairakā ‘hoggala’ iti khyātā| pūrveṇa kalpeneti kvāthena madhuśarkarayor yogena ca||49-51||

lg.l: ervārubījaṃ trapuṣāt kusumbhāt sakuṅkumaḥ syād vṛṣakaś ca peyaḥ|
ervārubījaṃ madhukaṃ sadāru ‘sadārvi’ iti pā. paitte pibet taṇḍuladhāvanena|
dārvīṃ tathaivāmalakīrasena samākṣikāṃ pittakṛte tu kṛcchre||53||

ab.seg: trapuṣāt kusumbhād ity atra bījam iti sambadhyate||52-53||

lg.l: kṣāroṣṇatīkṣṇauṣadham annapānaṃ svedo yavānnaṃ vamanaṃ nirūhāḥ|
vyoṣaṃ śvadaṃṣṭrātruṭisārasāsthi ‘kṛmimārakāsthi’ iti pā. kolapramāṇaṃ madhumūtrayuktam|
pibet truṭiṃ kṣaudrayutāṃ kadalyā rasena kaiḍaryarasena vā'pi||55||
takreṇa yuktaṃ śitivārakasya bījaṃ pibet kṛcchravināśahetoḥ|
paktvā jale tena pibed yavāgūṃ siddhaṃ kaṣāyaṃ madhusaṃyutaṃ vā||57||

ab.seg: kṣāroṣṇety ādi| kaphakṛcchre kṣārādibhir yuktaṃ bheṣajam annapānaṃ ca prayojyam| vyoṣaṃ trikaṭukam| truṭiḥ elā| sārasaḥ pakṣī svanāmakhyātaḥ| kolapramāṇam iti aṣṭamāṣakamānam| kaiṭaryaḥ pārvato nimbaḥ| śitivārakaḥ śāliñcaḥ||54-57||

div.ab:
sarvaṃ tridoṣaprabhave tu vāyoḥ sthānānupūrvyā prasamīkṣya kāryam|
tribhyo 'dhike prāg vamanaṃ kaphe syāt pitte virekaḥ pavane tu bastiḥ||58|| iti mūtrakṛcchracikitsā|

ab.seg: sarvam ity ādi| etad eva vātādibheṣajaṃ militaṃ tridoṣaprabhave kṛcchre kartavyam| tac ca sameṣv api doṣeṣu vāyoḥ sthānānupūrvyā cikitsitaṃ kartavyaṃ, na jvara iva tridoṣabhave kaphasthānānupūrvyā kartavyaṃ; mūtrakṛcchrasya samatridoṣārabdhatve 'pi vātasthānabhavatvena vāyur eva prathamaṃ cikitsya iti bhāvaḥ| viṣamasannipātārabdhe kriyām āha- tribhyo 'dhike ity ādi| tribhyo 'dhike iti granthaḥ kaphe tathā pitte tathā pavane ity anena ca krameṇa sambadhyate||58||

lg.l: kriyā hitā sā'śmariśarkarābhyāṃ kṛcchre yathaiveha kaphānilābhyām|
hiṃsrākharāśvāśitivārakāṇām ervārukāṇāṃ ‘kharāhvā...’ iti pā. trapuṣasya bījam||60||
utkuñcikā hiṅgu savetasāmlaṃ syād dve bṛhatyau hapuṣā vacā ca|
cūrṇaṃ pibed aśmaribhedapakvaṃ sarpiś ca gomūtracaturguṇaṃ taiḥ||61||
mūlaṃ śvadaṃṣṭrekṣurakorubūkāt kṣīreṇa piṣṭaṃ bṛhatīdvayāc ca|
āloḍya dadhnā madhureṇa peyaṃ dināni saptāśmaribhedanāya||62||
truṭiṃ surāhvaṃ ‘śatāhvāṃ’ iti pā. lavaṇāni pañca yavāgrajaṃ kundurukāśmabhedau|
kampillakaṃ gokṣurakasya bījam ervārubījaṃ trapuṣasya bījam||64||
amlair aśuktai rasamadyayuṣaiḥ peyaṃ hi gulmāśmaribhedanārtham||65||
śīto 'śmabhit syād dadhimaṇḍayuktaḥ peyaḥ prakāmaṃ lavaṇena yuktaḥ||66||
sitopalā vā samayāvaśūkā kṛcchreṣu sarveṣv api bheṣajaṃ syāt||67||
pītvā'tha madyaṃ nigadaṃ rathena hayena vā śīghrajavena yāyāt|
taiḥ śarkarā pracyavate 'śmarī tu śamyen na cec chalyavid uddharet tām||68||
retobhighātaprabhave tu kṛcchre samīkṣya doṣaṃ pratikarma kuryāt|
kārpāsamūlaṃ vṛṣakāśmabhedau balā sthirādīni gavedhukā ca||69||
vṛścīra aindrī ca punarnavā ca śatāvarī madhvasanākhyaparṇyau|
tatkvāthasiddhaḥ pavane rasaḥ syāt pitte 'dhike kṣīram athāpi sarpiḥ||70||
kaphe ca yūṣādikam annapānaṃ saṃsargaje sarvahitaḥ kramaḥ syāt|
evaṃ na cec chāmyati tasya yuñjyāt surāṃ purāṇāṃ madhukāsavaṃ vā||71||
vihaṅgamāṃsāni ca bṛṃhaṇāya bastīṃś ca śukrāśayaśodhanārtham|
śuddhasya tṛptasya ca vṛṣyayogaiḥ priyānukūlāḥ pramadā vidheyāḥ||72||

ab.seg: kriyā hitā seti yā kaphamārutotthe kṛcchre vihitā sā militaiva śarkarāyām aśmaryāṃ ca kartavyā| kharāśvā ajamodā| cūrṇaṃ pibed ity atra jalenaiva pānam| ikṣurakaḥ kokilākṣaḥ| kunduruḥ svanāmakhyātaḥ| triphalādvibhāgam iti triphalāyāḥ pratyekaṃ mūlabhāgād bhāgadvayam| amlair iti kāñjikādibhiḥ| aśuktair iti śuktavarjitaiḥ| madyaṃ cātrāmlagrahaṇagṛhītam api bastiśodhanatvād aśamarībhedakatvaprakarṣakhyāpanārthaṃ punar ucyate| aśmabhid iti aśmarībhedī| sitopalā śarkarā| śalyavid uddhared iti śalyaśāstravettā taduktavidhānenāśmarīm ākarṣet| samīkṣya doṣam iti doṣam ulbaṇaṃ samīkṣya| pratikarma kuryāt pratikarma cikitsitam| madhvasanākhyaparṇyau madhuparṇī guḍūcī, asanaparṇī aparājitā, ‘dāruparṇī’ ity apare| saṃsargaje iti tridoṣānugate| vihaṅgaḥ pakṣī||59-72||

lg.l: pibet sitākṣaudrayutāni khāded ikṣuṃ vidārīṃ trapuṣāṇi caiva||73||
ghṛtaṃ śvadaṃṣṭrāsvarasena siddhaṃ kṣīreṇa caivāṣṭaguṇena peyam|
sthirādikānāṃ kanakādikānām ekaikaśo vā vidhinaiva tena||74||
kṣīreṇa bastir madhurauṣadhaiḥ syāt tailena vā svāduphalotthitena|
yan mūtrakṛcchre vihitaṃ tu paitte kāryaṃ tu tac choṇitamūtrakṛcchre||75||

ab.seg: khāded iti asiddhāny eva khādet| ghṛtaṃ śvadaṃṣṭrety ādau sāhacaryāt kecic chvadaṃṣṭrāsvarasam apy aṣṭaguṇaṃ vadanti; tan na, svarasaḥ snehasama eva sneheṣu bhavati, uktaṃ hi jatūkarṇe- “kalkāc caturguṇaḥ snehaḥ, svarasaḥ snehasammitaḥ” iti; tena kṣīravat sarvasneheṣu svarasavidhānaṃ jñeyam| sthirādikānām ity ādau katakādiḥ madhuraskandhe (vi.a.8) “...katakakāśmarya... ‘kālaṅkatakakāśmaryetyādinokto gaṇo jñeyaḥ| kālaṅkatako vikaṅkatakaḥ’ iti pā. ” ity ādinokto gaṇo jñeyaḥ| vidhinaiva teneti pūrvaghṛtavidhinaiva; tena śvadaṃṣṭrāsthāne sthirādīni pratyekaṃ kalpanīyāni| svāduphalotthiteneti madhūkākṣoṭādiphalaniṣpannena tailena||73-75||

div.ab:
vyāyāmasandhāraṇaśuṣkarūkṣapiṣṭānnavātārkakaravyavāyān|
kharjūraśālūkakapitthajambūbisaṃ kaṣāyaṃ na rasaṃ bhajeta||76|| ity aśmarīcikitsā|

ab.seg: vyāyāmety ādinā mūtrakṛcchre 'pathyāny āha||76||

lg.l: chardiḥ kaphotkleśarujo 'ruciś ca hṛdrogajāḥ syur vividhās tathā'nye||78||
stabdhaṃ guru syāt stimitaṃ ca marma kaphāt prasekajvarakāsatandrāḥ|
vidyāt tridoṣaṃ tv api sarvaliṅgaṃ tīvrārtitodaṃ kṛmijaṃ sakaṇḍūm||80||

ab.seg: nidānādikrameṇa hṛdrogacikitsām āha| gadāticāra iti rogāṇām asamyagupacāraḥ| hṛdrogakartṝṇīti yathā “bhīṣmaḥ kurūṇāṃ bhayaśokahartā”, tena “tṛjakābhyāṃ kartari” (pā.a.2|2|15|) ity anenātra samāsaḥ| vaivarṇyety ādau hṛdrogajā iti vacanād dhṛdrogānantarakālabhāvitayā vaivarṇyādīnām upadravatvam icchanti; ye tu vaivarṇyādīnāṃ sāmānyahṛdrogalakṣaṇatvam āhuḥ, te hṛdrogeṇa samaṃ jāyante iti hṛdrogajā iti vigrahāl liṅgatvaṃ vyutpādayanti| hṛdrogāś ca kiyantaḥśirasīye (sū.a.17) vistareṇoktā api cikitsāprakaraṇād iha saṅkṣepeṇābhidhīyante| marmeti hṛdayam||77-80||

lg.l: tailaṃ sasauvīrakamastutakraṃ vāte prapeyaṃ lavaṇaṃ sukhoṣṇam|
punarnavāṃ dāru sapañcamūlaṃ rāsnāṃ yavān bilvakulatthakolam|
paktvā jale tena vipācya tailam abhyaṅgapāne 'nilahṛdgadadhnam||82||
sapuṣkarāhvaṃ phalapūramūlaṃ mahauṣadhaṃ śaṭyabhayā ca kalkāḥ|
syāt tryūṣaṇaṃ dve triphale sapāṭhe nidigdhikāgokṣurakau bale dve|
ṛddhis truṭis tāmalakī svaguptā mede madhūkaṃ madhukaṃ sthirā ca||87||
śatāvarī jīvakapṛśniparṇyau dravyair imair akṣasamaiḥ supiṣṭaiḥ|
prasthaṃ ghṛtasyeha paced vidhijñaḥ prasthena dadhnā tv atha māhiṣeṇa||88||
mātrāṃ palaṃ cārdhapalaṃ picuṃ vā prayojayen mākṣikasamprayuktām|
śvāse sakāse tv atha pāṇḍuroge halīmake hṛdgrahaṇīpradoṣe||89||

ab.seg: tailam ity ādinā yathākramaṃ cikitsām āha| tailādīnām atra samabhāgānāṃ peyatvaṃ jñeyam| vayaḥkayastheti vayaḥsthākāyasthayor guḍūcyāmalakayoḥ svarasagrahaṇam| agryasarpir iti atrāgryapadam asya sarpiṣaḥ prādhānyakhyāpanārtham| vikartikeha hṛdayaparikartikākārā vedanā| kvāthaḥ kṛta ity ādau nāgarādīnāṃ kalkaṃ pauṣkarādikvāthe prakṣepam āhuḥ| pathyāśatīty ādau yamakena bhṛṣṭaḥ kalkaḥ guḍaprasannālavaṇaiś ca peya iti vyākhyeyam| dve triphale ity atra drākṣākāśmaryaparūṣakāṇi dvitīyā triphalā| truṭiḥ sūkṣmailā||81-89||

lg.l: śītāḥ pradehāḥ pariṣecanāni tathā vireko hṛdi pittaduṣṭe|
drākṣāsitākṣaudraparūṣakaiḥ syāc chuddhe tu pittāpaham annapānam||90||
yaṣṭyāhvikātiktakarohiṇībhyāṃ ‘piṣṭvā pibeccāpi sitājalena yaṣṭyāhvayaṃ tiktakarohiṇīṃ ca’ iti pā. kalkaṃ pibec cāpi sitājalena|
kṣate ca sarpīṃṣi hitāni sarpirguḍāś ca ye tān prasamīkṣya samyak||91||
dadyād bhiṣag dhanvarasāṃś ca gavyakṣīrāśināṃ pittahṛdāmayeṣu|
tair eva sarve praśamaṃ prayānti pittāmayāḥ śoṇitasaṃśrayā ye||92||
kākolimedāyugajīvakaiś ca kṣīreṇa siddhaṃ mahiṣīghṛtaṃ syāt||93||
granthiś ca sarpiḥ payasā pacet taiḥ kṣaudrānvitaṃ pittahṛdāmayaghnam||94||
sthirādikalkaiḥ payasā ca siddhaṃ drākṣārasenekṣurasena vā'pi|
sarpir hitaṃ svāduphalekṣujāś ca rasāḥ suśītā hṛdi pittaduṣṭe||95||

ab.seg: śītā ity ādi pittahṛdrogacikitsitam| kṣate iti kṣatakṣīṇacikitsite| śreyasī rāsnā| kharjūraṃ kharjūraphalam| kṣaudrānvitam iti sādhanottarakālaṃ pādikamadhuyuktam| svāduphalety ādau svarasā iti rasāḥ||90-95||

lg.l: svinnasya vāntasya vilaṅghitasya kriyā kaphaghnī kaphamarmaroge|
kaulatthadhānyaiś ca rasair vavānnaṃ pānāni tīkṣṇāni ca ‘saśarkarāṇi’ iti pā. śaṅkarāṇi||96||
śilāhvayaṃ vā bhiṣag apramattaḥ prayojayet kalpavidhānadiṣṭam|
prāśaṃ tathā''gastyam athāpi ‘tathā'gastyaharītakīṃ ca’ iti pā. lehaṃ rasāyanaṃ brāhmam athāmalakyāḥ||99||

ab.seg: svinnasyety ādi kaphajahṛdrogacikitsādhikāraḥ| śaṅkarāṇīti kalyāṇakarāṇī| udumbarety ādau udumbarādikvāthe bhāgatraye trivṛttryūṣaṇacūrṇaṃ pādikaṃ prakṣepyam| aśiśirāmbuyukta iti uṣṇasalilānupānaḥ| kalpavidhānadiṣṭam iti rasāyane vihitam; kalpaśabdena ca kṣudrarasāyanam ucyate| prāśa iti cyavanaprāśaḥ| āgastyam iti lehaviśeṣaṇam||96-99||

lg.l: tridoṣaje laṅghanam āditaḥ syād annaṃ ca sarveṣu hitaṃ vidheyam|
hīnātimadhyatvam avekṣya caiva kāryaṃ trayāṇām api karma śastam||100||

ab.seg: tridoṣaje ādau laṅghanavidhānaṃ hṛdayasya kaphasthānatayā tadgate tridoṣaje 'pi kapha evādau laṅghanena jeya iti matvā kṛtam| tridoṣaje tūlbaṇadoṣacikitsāsūtram āha- hīnātīty ādi| hīnatvam adhikatvaṃ madhyamatvaṃ ca doṣāṇām avekṣya yat karma śastam adhikadoṣavijetṛtayā tat kāryam iti vākyārthaḥ||100||

div.ab:
bhukte 'dhikaṃ jīryati śūlam alpaṃ jīrṇe sthitaṃ cet suradārukuṣṭham|
satilvakaṃ dve lavaṇe viḍaṅgam uṣṇāmbunā sātiviṣaṃ pibet saḥ||101||
jīrṇe 'dhike snehavirecanaṃ syāt phalair virecyo yadi jīryati syāt|
triṣv eva kāleṣv adhike tu śūle tīkṣṇaṃ hitaṃ mūlavirecanaṃ syāt||102||
prāyo 'nilo ruddhagatiḥ prakupyaty āmāśaye śodhanam eva tasmāt| kāryaṃ tathā laṅghanapācanaṃ ca ...|103|

bhukte 'dhikam ity ādinā sānnipātikahṛdroge prāyobhāviśūlaṃ lakṣaṇabhedena vibhajañ cikitsati| bhukte 'dhikam ity ādinā śleṣmaśūlam ucyate| sthitam iti praśāntam| jīrṇe 'dhikam ity ādinā anilaśūlaṃ, jīryaty adhikam ity anena ca paittikaṃ brūte| phalair iti drākṣākāśmaryādibhiḥ| triṣv evety ādinā sānnipātikaśūlam āha| mūlavirecanaṃ trivṛnmūlādibhir virecanam| atra virecanopapattim āha- prāyo 'nila ity ādi| atra cānilakope yady api bastir ucitaḥ, tathā'py āmāśayāpekṣayā''māśayaśodhanaṃ virecanam eva deyam||101-102||-
... sarvaṃ kṛmighnaṃ kṛmihṛdgade ca||103|| iti hṛdrogacikitsā|

ab.seg: kṛmighnam iti vyādhitarūpīye (vi. a. 7) kṛmiharatvenoktaṃ vidhānam||103||

lg.l: saṃstyānadoṣe śirasi pravṛddho vāyuḥ pratiśyāyam udīrayet tu|
kāsārucisrāvaghanaprasekāḥ kaphād guruḥ srotasi cāpi kaṇḍūḥ||106||
sarvāṇi rūpāṇi tu sannipātāt syuḥ pīnase tīvraruje 'tiduḥkhe ‘'tīva rujo'tiduḥkhe’ iti pā.|107|

div.ab: kramāgataśirorogacikitsāyāṃ vaktavyāyāṃ śirorogapradhānatvād bhūriśirorogahetutvāc ca pratiśyāyam eva tāvad āha| śālākye 'py uktaṃ- “bhūyiṣṭhaṃ vyādhayaḥ sarve pratiśyāyanimittajāḥ| tasmād rogaḥ pratiśyāyaḥ pūrvam evopadiśyate” iti| yady api rājayakṣmacikitsite pratiśyāya ukta eva, tathā'pi tatra yakṣmapūrvarūpatayoktaḥ, iha tu svatantraḥ pratiśyāya ucyata iti viśeṣaḥ| rajaḥ dhūliḥ| atisvapnaḥ divāsvapnaḥ| avaśyāyaḥ tuṣāraḥ| saṃstyānadoṣe iti ghanībhūtadoṣe| ghrāṇārtīty ādinā vātādipratiśyāyānāṃ caturṇāṃ kramāl lakṣaṇam āha| sasvaramūrdharoga iti svararogaḥ svarabhedaḥ| kaphād gurur ity ādau guruśabdaḥ kaṇḍūviśeṣaṇam| srotasīti nāsāsrotasi||104-106||-

lg.l: tatas tu rogāḥ kṣavathuś ca nāsāśoṣaḥ pratīnāhaparisravau ca|

ab.seg: sarvo 'tivṛddha ity ādinā pratiśyāyajān kṣavathvādīn āha| atra mukharogaṃ ye na paṭhanti te śirorogagrahaṇenaiva mukharogasya grahaṇam iti manyante| eṣāṃ tu duṣṭapratiśyāyakṣavathvādīnāṃ śālākyādiṣu vistaraḥ, atra tu parādhikāratvāt saṅkṣepa eva||107-109||

div.ab:
rodhābhighātasravaśoṣapākair ghrāṇaṃ yutaṃ yaś ca na vetti gandham|
durgandhi cāsyaṃ bahuśaḥprakopi duṣṭapratiśyāyam udāharet tam||110||
saṃspṛśya marmāṇy anilas tu mūrdhni viṣvakpathasthaḥ kṣavathuṃ karoti|
kruddhaḥ sa saṃśoṣya kaphaṃ tu nāsāśṛṅgāṭakaghrāṇaviśoṣaṇaṃ ca||111||
ucchvāsamārgaṃ tu kaphaḥ savāto rundhyāt pratīnāham udāharet tam|
yo mastuluṅgād ghanapītapakvaḥ kaphaḥ sraved eṣa ‘ghrāṇāddhanaḥ pītasitastanurvā doṣaḥ sravet srāvamudāharettam’ iti pā. parisravas tu||112||
vaivarṇyadaurgandhyam upekṣayā tu syāt pūtinasyaṃ śvayathur bhramaś ca|
ānahyate yasya viśuṣyate ca praklidyate dhūpyati cāpi nāsā||113||
na vetti yo gandharasāṃś ca jantur juṣṭaṃ vyavasyet tam apīnasena|
taṃ cānilaśleṣmabhavaṃ vikāraṃ brūyāt pratiśyāyasamānaliṅgam||114||
sadāharāgaḥ śvayathuḥ sapākaḥ syād ghrāṇapāko 'pi ca raktapittāt|
ghrāṇāśritāsṛkprabhṛtīn pradūṣya kurvanti nāsāśvayathuṃ malāś ca||115||
ghrāṇe tathocchvāsagatiṃ nirudhya māṃsāsradoṣād api cārbudāni|
ghrāṇāt sraved vā śravaṇān mukhād vā pittāktam asraṃ tv api pūyaraktam||116||
kuryāt sapittaḥ pavanas tvagādīn sandūṣya cārūṃṣi sapākavanti|
nāsā pradīpteva narasya yasya dīptaṃ tu taṃ rogam udāharanti||117|| iti nāsāroganidānam|

ab.seg: rodhābhighātety ādinā duṣṭapratiśyāyādīnām arjunalomaparyantānāṃ krameṇa lakṣaṇāny āha| kruddha ity ādau sa iti anilaḥ| mastuluṅgād iti mastiṣkāt| kuryāt sapitta ity ādinā aruṃṣikām āha; sā tu śirobhavā jñeyā||110-117||

div.ab:
bhṛśārtiśūlaṃ sphuratīha vātāt pittāt sadāhārti kaphād guru syāt|
sarvais tridoṣaṃ krimibhis tu kaṇḍūr daurgandhyatodārtiyutaṃ śiraḥ syāt||118|| iti śiroroganidānam|

ab.seg: bhṛśārtīty ādinā yady api pratiśyāyotpannatvena śirorogāṇāṃ lakṣaṇam ucyate, tathā'pi svatantrotpannānām api śirorogāṇām etad eva lakṣaṇaṃ jñeyam| evaṃ mukharogādilakṣaṇeṣv api vācyam| sarvais tridoṣam iti vātādilakṣaṇair militais tridoṣaṃ syād ity arthaḥ||118||

div.ab:
mukhāmaye mārutaje tu śoṣakārkaśyaraukṣyāṇi calā rujaś ca|
kṛṣṇāruṇaṃ niṣpatanaṃ saśītaṃ prasraṃsanaspandanatodabhedāḥ||119||
tṛṣṇājvarasphoṭakatāludāhā ‘tṛṣṇājvarasphoṭakadāhapākāḥ’ iti pā. dhūmāyanaṃ cāpy avadīrṇatā ca|
pittāt samūrcchā vividhā rujaś ca varṇāś ca śuklāruṇavarṇavarjyāḥ||120||
kaṇḍūr gurutvaṃ sitavijjalatvaṃ sneho 'rucir jāḍyakaphaprasekau|
utkleśamandānalatā ca tandrā rujaś ca mandāḥ kaphavakraroge||121||
sarvāṇi rūpāṇi tu vakraroge bhavanti yasmin sa tu sarvajaḥ syāt|
saṃsthānadūṣyākṛtināmabhedāc caite catuḥṣaṣṭividhā bhavanti||122||
śālākyatantre 'bhihitāni teṣāṃ nimittarūpākṛtibheṣajāni|
yathāpradeśaṃ tu caturvidhasya kriyāṃ pravakṣyāmi mukhāmayasya||123|| iti mukharoganidānam|

ab.seg: niṣpatanam iti mukhasrāvaḥ| tṛṣṇety ādi pittajamukharogalakṣaṇam| śālākye prapañcoktamukharogāṇām atraiva caturvidhamukharoge 'ntarbhāvaṃ darśayann āha- saṃsthānety ādi| saṃsthānaṃ sthānam oṣṭhādi, dūṣyaṃ raktādi, ākṛtiḥ liṅgaṃ, nāma śītādādi, eṣāṃ bhedād vikalpāc catuḥṣaṣṭividhā bhavanti, te ca śālākye evonneyāḥ| suśrute pañcaṣaṣṭimukharogā uktāḥ, tathā'pīha vaidehamatānusāreṇādūrāntareṇeyaṃ catuḥṣaṣṭiḥ| yathāpradeśam iti yathācikitsāpradeśam||119-123||

div.ab:
vātādibhiḥ śokabhayātilobhakrodhairmanoghnāśanagandharūpaiḥ|
arocakāḥ syuḥ parihṛṣṭadantaḥ kaṣāyavakraś ca mato 'nilena||124||
kaṭvamlam uṣṇaṃ virasaṃ ca pūti pittena vidyāl lavaṇaṃ ca vakram|
mādhuryapaicchilyagurutvaśaityavibaddhasambaddhayutaṃ ‘vibaddhasaṃstambhayutaṃ’ iti pā. kaphena||125||
arocake śokabhayānilobhakrodhādyahṛdyāśanagandhaje ‘krodhādyahṛdyāśucigandhaje’ iti pā. syāt|
svābhāvikaṃ vakram athāruciś ca tridoṣaje naikarasaṃ bhavet tu||126|| ity arocakanidānam|

ab.seg: āsyarogāntarniviṣṭatvād evārocakān āha| yady api rājayakṣmacikitsite 'py arocakā uktāḥ, tathā'pi śoṣoktārocakebhyaḥ pṛthag utpannā evārocakā abhidhīyanta iti na paunaruktyam| atilobhenātrārucir ucyate, tatrātilobhena kṛtaṃ satatābhyāsam arucikāraṇaṃ darśayati| vibaddhasambaddhayutam iti bandhayuktam ity arthaḥ| naikarasam iti anekarasam||124-126||

div.ab:
nādo 'tiruk karṇamalasya śoṣaḥ srāvas tanuś cāśravaṇaṃ ca vātāt|
śophaḥ sarāgo daraṇaṃ vidāhaḥ sapītapūtiśravaṇaṃ ca pittāt||127||
vaiśrutyakaṇḍūsthiraśophaśuklasnigdhaśrutiḥ śleṣmabhave 'lparuk ca|
