yathākālam iti yathākālaṃ śiśirādibhiḥ sevite deśe| śmaśānādibhiḥ pratyekaṃ virahitaśabdaḥ sambadhyate| devayajanenāgāraśabdaḥ sambadhyate| sabhā janamelakasthānam| na phālena kṛṣṭa iti aphālakṛṣṭe||9||

tatra yāni kālajātāny upāgatasampūrṇapramāṇa-rasavīrya-gandhāni ‘... nyāgatasampurṇapramāṇarasavīryagandhāni’ iti pā. kālātapāgnisalilapavanajantubhir anupahatagandha-varṇa-rasa-sparśa-prabhāvāṇi pratyagrāṇy udīcyāṃ diśi sthitāni; teṣāṃ śākhāpalāśam aciraprarūḍhaṃ varṣāvasantayor grāhyaṃ, grīṣme mūlāni śiśire vā śīrṇaprarūḍhaparṇānāṃ, śaradi tvakkandakṣīrāṇi, hemante sārāṇi, yathartu puṣpaphalam iti; maṅgalācāraḥ kalyāṇavṛttaḥ śuciḥ śuklavāsāḥ sampūjya devatā aśvinau gobrāhmaṇāṃś ca kṛtopavāsaḥ prāṅmukha udaṅmukho vā gṛhṇīyāt||10||

tatra yāni kālajātānīty anenaiva kālasampad ucyate; kālajātānīti svakālabhūtāni| upāgatasampūrṇety ādinā pratyagrāṇīty antena guṇasampad ucyate| pratyagrāṇīti sampūrṇaguṇatayā niṣpannāni| teṣāṃ śākhāpalāśam ity ādinā kālasampadam uktāṃ prapañcayati| śākhāgrahaṇenaiva tvagādīnām api grahaṇam| śīrṇaprarūḍhaparṇānām iti cchedaḥ| grīṣme mūlāni śiśire veti kathanena yāny āgneyāni teṣāṃ mūlāni grīṣme, yāni saumyāni teṣāṃ mūlāni śiśire, grāhyāṇīti vyavasthāṃ sūcayati; uktaṃ hy anyatra- “saumyāny auṣadhāni saumyeṣv ṛtuṣv ādadīta, āgneyāny āgneyeṣu” (su.sū.a.36) iti| bheṣajagrahaṇavidhānam āha- maṅgalety ādi||10||

gṛhītvā cānurūpaguṇavadbhājanasthāny āgāreṣū ‘cānurūpaguṇavadbhājane saṃsthāpyāgāreṣu’ iti pā. prāgudagdvāreṣu nivātapravātaikadeśeṣu nityapuṣpopahārabalikarmavatsu, agni-salilopasveda-dhūma-rajo-mūṣaka-catuṣpadām anabhigamanīyāni svavacchannāni śikyeṣv āsajya sthāpayet||11||
bhājanasampadam āha- gṛhītvety ādi| anurūpaguṇavadbhājanasthānīti anurūpaguṇavattā ca bhājanasya bheṣajasamānaguṇatayaiva| svavacchannānīti samyak pihitāni||11||

tāni ca yathādoṣaṃ prayuñjīta surā-sauvīraka-tuṣodaka-maireya-medaka-dhānyāmla ‘...dhānyaphaladadhyamlādibhirvāte’ iti pā. -phalāmla-dadhyamlādibhir vāte, mṛdvīkāmalaka ‘mṛdvīkāmadhumadhukaphāṇitakṣīrādibhiḥ’ iti pā. -madhu-madhuka-parūṣaka-phāṇitakṣīrādibhiḥ pitte, śleṣmaṇi tu madhu-mūtra-kaṣāyādibhir bhāvitāny āloḍitāni ca; ity uddeśaḥ| taṃ vistareṇa dravya-deha-doṣa-sātmyādīni ‘dravyadehadoṣasātmyādīn vasantādīṃśca’ iti pā. pravibhajya vyākhyāsyāmaḥ||12||

saṅkṣepeṇa madanaphalādīnāṃ vātādibhedena bhāvanāloḍanadravyāṇy āha- tāni ca yathādoṣaṃ prayuñjītety ādi| dhānyāmlaṃ kāñjikaṃ, phalāmlaṃ dāḍimarasādi| śleṣmaṇīty ādau kaṣāyaśabdena śleṣmaharadravyakvātho 'bhipretaḥ| uddeśa iti saṅkṣepābhidhānam ity arthaḥ| dravya-deha-doṣa-sātmyādīnīty atra ādiśabdena prakṛtibalādīnāṃ grahaṇam||12||

vamanadravyāṇāṃ madanaphalāni śreṣṭhatamāny ācakṣate, anapāyitvāt| tāni vasantagrīṣmayor antare ‘...rantarā puṣye'śvayuji mṛgaśirasi vā’ iti pā. puṣyāśvayugbhyāṃ mṛgaśirasā vā gṛhṇīyān maitre muhūrte| yāni pakvāny akāṇāny aharitāni pāṇḍūny akrimīṇy apūtīny ajantujagdhāny ahrasvāni; tāni pramṛjya ‘pragṛhya kuśamūlairbaddhvā’ iti pā., kuśapuṭe baddhvā, gomayenālipya, yavatu(bu)ṣamāṣaśālikulatthamudgapalānām anyatame ‘... mudgaparṇānā...’ iti pā. nidadhyād aṣṭarātram| ata ūrdhvaṃ
mṛdūbhūtāni madhviṣṭagandhāny uddhṛtya śoṣayet| suśuṣkāṇāṃ phalapippalīr uddharet ‘phalānāṃ pippalīruddharet’ iti pā.| tāsāṃ ghṛtadadhimadhupalalavimṛditānāṃ punaḥ śuṣkāṇāṃ navaṃ kalaśaṃ supramṛṣṭavālukam arajaskam ākaṇṭhaṃ pūrayitvā svavacchannaṃ svanuguptaṃ śikyeṣv āsajya ‘...ṣvavasṛjya’ iti pā. samyak sthāpayet||13||

vamanadravyāṇām ity ādinā madanaphalasya prādhānyopadarśanapūrvakaṃ prayogavidhim āha| anapāyitvād iti vamanadravyāntarāpekṣayā'lpavyāpattikatvāt| antare iti madhye, sa ca grīṣmavasantayor antarvartikatipayadināny eva madhyo jñeyaḥ| aśvayuk aśvinī| maitre muhūrta iti śivabhujagamitrādīnāṃ madhye mitradevatāke, evaṃ maitre muhūrte| palānām iti rāśīnām| madhuvad iṣṭagandho yeṣāṃ tāni, yāni madhviṣṭagandhāni bhavanti tāni grāhyāṇīti darśayati| phalapippalīr iti madanaphalamadhyagatāni pippalīsaṃsthānāni bījāni| tāsām ity ādi pūraṇavācakaśabdayogāt karaṇe ṣaṣṭhī| svanuguptam iti kṛtarakṣāvidhānam||13||

atha cchardanīyam āturaṃ dvyahaṃ tryahaṃ vā snehasvedopapannaṃ śvaś chardayitavyam iti grāmyānūpaudakamāṃsarasa-kṣīra-dadhi-māṣa-tila-śākādibhiḥ samutkleśitaśleṣmāṇaṃ vyuṣitaṃ jīrṇāhāraṃ pūrvāhṇe kṛtabalihomamaṅgalaprāyaścittaṃ nirannam anatisnigdhaṃ yavāgvā ghṛtamātrāṃ pītavantaṃ, tāsāṃ phalapippalīnām antarnakhamuṣṭiṃ yāvad vā sādhu manyeta jarjarīkṛtya yaṣṭimadhukaṣāyeṇa kovidāra-karbudāra-nīpa-vidula-bimbī-śaṇapuṣpī-sadāpuṣpī-pratyakpuṣpī-kaṣāyāṇām anyatamena vā rātrim uṣitaṃ vimṛdya pūtaṃ madhusaindhavayuktaṃ sukhoṣṇaṃ kṛtvā pūrṇaṃ śarāvaṃ mantreṇānenābhimantrayet- ‘oṃ
brahmadakṣāśvirudrendrabhūcandrārkānilānalāḥ|
ṛṣayaḥ sauṣadhigrāmā bhūtasaṅghāś ca pāntu te|
rasāyanam ivarṣīṇāṃ devānām amṛtaṃ yathā|
sudhevottamanāgānāṃ bhaiṣajyam idam astu te’| ity evam abhimantryodaṅmukhaṃ prāṅmukhaṃ vā''turaṃ pāyayec chleṣmajvaragulmapratiśyāyārtaṃ viśeṣeṇa punaḥ punar āpittāgamanāt, tena sādhu vamati; hīnavegaṃ tu pippalyāmalaka-sarṣapa-vacākalkalavaṇoṣṇodakaiḥ punaḥ punaḥ pravartayed āpittadarśanāt| ity eṣa sarvaś chardanayogavidhiḥ||14||

dvyahaṃ tryahaṃ vā snehasvedopapannam ity anena abhyaṅge kriyamāṇe snehasahacaritasvedopapādanaṃ dvyahaṃ tryahaṃ vā vidhīyate, “tryahāvaraṃ saptadinaṃ paraṃ tu snigdho naraḥ svedayitavya iṣṭaḥ” (si.a.1) ity anena pānaprayujyamānasnehasya saptarātraṃ trirātraṃ vā prakarṣa ucyate iti na virodhaḥ| etac cābhyaṅgasvedasahitasnehasvedakaraṇaṃ pānasnehāntadivasam ārabhya kriyate, tena snehapānaviśrāmadinena samaṃ dvyahatryahapūraṇam abhyaṅgasnehasahitasvedaprayogasya bhavati| snehapānāc ca yad viśrāmadinam, “ekāhoparatas tadvad bhuktvā pracchardanaṃ pibet” (sū.a.13) ity anenoktaṃ, tathaivehāpi| kaphotkleśakāribhojanam āha- śvaś chardayitavyam ity ādinā| śva iti parasminn ahni| vyuṣitam iti rātrim atikrāntam| nirannam iti padacchedaḥ| anatisnigdham ity ādinā vamanadina eva ghṛtamātrāyuktayavāgūpānapūrvakaṃ vamanam anatisnigdhapuruṣaviṣayaṃ brūte| anye tu pūrvadina evānatisnigdhasya ghṛtamātrāṃ ‘ghṛtamātrāyuktayavāgūpānamāhuḥ’ iti pā. pītavata eva yavāgvāḥ pānam āhuḥ,
“peśalair vividhair annair doṣān utkleśya dehinaḥ|
snigdhasvinnāya vamanaṃ dattaṃ samyak pravartate|| athāparedyuḥ pūrvāhṇe sādhāraṇe kāle vamanadravyakaṣāyakalkacūrṇasnehānām anyatamasya” (su.ci.a.33) ity ādi suśrutokteḥ| antarnakhamuṣṭim iti antarīkṛtanakhamuṣṭiparimāṇam| yāvad vā sādhu manyetety anena mātrāyā baladoṣādibhedenāsthiratvam ity āha| yaṣṭīmadhukasya kovidārādiṣu vicchedapāṭha uttaraprayogeṣu kovidārāder yaṣṭīmadhuvirahitasya grahaṇārthaḥ| kovidāraḥ svanāmakhyātaḥ, sa śaradi puṣpati; karbudāras tu kāñcanāraḥ, sa vasante puṣpati; nīpaḥ kadambaḥ, vidulaḥ vetasaḥ, śaṇapuṣpī ghaṇṭāravā, sadāpuṣpī arkapuṣpikā, pratyakpuṣpī apāmārgaḥ| rātrim uṣitaṃ vimṛdya pūtam iti śṛtakaṣāyāt kaṣāyāntaropadarśakaṃ pakṣāntaraṃ; kiṃ vā, kaṣāyapāna eva śītakaṣāyavidhānam ihocyate| pūrṇaṃ śarāvam iti maṅgalārthaṃ pūrṇakumbhavat| punaḥ punar iti yāvat pittāgamanaṃ na bhavati tāvat punaḥ punaḥ kaṣāyaṃ pibed ity arthaḥ| anyatrāpy uktaṃ- “pittāntam iṣṭaṃ vamanaṃ virekād ardhaṃ” (si.a.1) ity ādi| vamanāyogakārakahīnavegapravṛttipratikārārtham āha- hīnavegam ity ādi||14||
sarveṣu tu madhusaindhavaṃ kaphavilayanacchedārthaṃ vamaneṣu vidadhyāt| na coṣṇavirodho madhunaś chardanayogayuktasya, avipakvapratyāgamanād doṣanirharaṇāc ca||15||

yady api ca ghreyādivamanayogeṣu madhusaindhavayogo na bhavati, tathā'pi ‘sarveṣu’ iti padaṃ bāhulyārtham| vamanārthakaṣāye uṣṇe madhuprakṣepo virodhitvān na yujyate, uktaṃ hi- “madhūṣṇam uṣṇārtam athavā” (sū.a.27) ity ādi, evam āśaṅkya samādhānam āha na coṣṇavirodho madhuna ity ādi| avipakvapratyāgamanād ity anena pacyamānaṃ madhūṣṇayuktaṃ virudhyeteti darśayati| doṣanirharaṇāc ceti madhūṣṇaviruddham api vamanayoge uṣṇe iṣyate, tasya doṣanirharaṇād eva na virodho bhavatīti darśayati| evaṃ bastiprayoge 'pi madhuna uṣṇāvirodho varṇanīyaḥ| etena yaṣṭīmadhvādinavadravyakṛtair navabhiḥ kaṣāyair navayogāḥ||15||

phalapippalīnāṃ dvau dvau bhāgau kovidārādikaṣāyeṇa triḥsaptakṛtvaḥ srāvayet, tena rasena tṛtīyaṃ bhāgaṃ piṣṭvā mātrāṃ harītakībhir bibhītakair āmalair vā tulyāṃ vartayet, tāsām ekāṃ dve vā pūrvoktānāṃ kaṣāyāṇām anyatamasyāñjalimātreṇa vimṛdya balavacchleṣmaprasekagranthijvarodarāruciṣu pāyayed iti samānaṃ pūrveṇa||16||

phalapippalīnāṃ dvau bhāgāv ity ādau phalapippalīnāṃ bhāgatrayaṃ kartavyaṃ; tatra bhāgadvayaṃ ṣaḍguṇena kovidārādikaṣāyeṇa kṣāraparisrāvaṇavidhivad ekaviṃśativārān parisrāvaṇīyam| kovidārādīnāṃ cāṣṭānām aṣṭau kaṣāyāḥ pṛthak parisrāvaṇe prayoktavyāḥ| yena ca kaṣāyeṇa ‘taiśca kaṣāyaiḥ’ iti pā. phalapippalībhāgadvayaṃ parisrāvya haritakyādiparimāṇā mātrā tṛtīyabhāgaphalapippalīkalkasya kriyate tenaiva kaṣāyeṇa mātrāyogāḥ ‘tenaiva kaṣāyeṇa mātrāyogāḥ’ ityayaṃ pāṭho hastalikhitapustake na paṭhyate; evam aṣṭau harītakyādimātrayā nirdiṣṭāḥ phalapippalīyogā bhavanti| mātrāvikalpaś ca doṣabalādivikalpakṛto jñeyaḥ| samānaṃ pūrveṇeti pūrvayogavad iha snehasvedābhimantraṇādividhānaṃ kartavyam ity arthaḥ| evam anyatrāpi pūrvavacchabdārtho jñeyaḥ||16||

phalapippalīkṣīraṃ, tena vā kṣīrayavāgūm adhobhāge raktapitte hṛddāhe ca; tajjasya vā dadhna uttarakaṃ kaphaccharditamakaprasekeṣu ‘...prasekeṣu pūrṇaṃ śarāvaṃ’ iti pā.; tasya vā payasaḥ śītasya santānikāñjaliṃ pitte prakupite uraḥkaṇṭhahṛdaye ca tanukaphopadigdhe, iti samānaṃ pūrveṇa||17||

phalapippalyā kṣīrapākavidhinā sādhitaṃ kṣīraṃ phalapippalīkṣīram; ayam eko yogaḥ| teneti phalapippalīsādhitakṣīreṇa| tajjasyeti phalapippalīkṣīrajātasya dadhnaḥ| uttarakam iti saram| santānikā kṣīroparisthaḥ styāno bhāgaḥ||17||
phalapippalīśṛtakṣīrān navanītam utpannaṃ phalādikalkakaṣāyasiddhaṃ kaphābhibhūtāgniṃ viśuṣyaddehaṃ ‘viśuṣkadehaṃ viśuṣyamāṇaṃ ca’ iti pā. ca mātrayā pāyayed iti samānaṃ pūrveṇa||18||
phalādīni phala-jīmūtakekṣvāku-dhāmārgava-kuṭaja-kṛtavedhanāni ṣaṭ| ete kṣīrayogacatuṣṭayena ghṛtayogena ca samaṃ pañca yogā adhyāyasaṅgrahe vaktavyā||18||

phalapippalīnāṃ phalādikaṣāyeṇa triḥsaptakṛtvaḥ suparibhāvitena puṣparajaḥprakāśena cūrṇena sarasi sañjātaṃ ‘sañjātaṃ’ iti hastalikhitapustake na paṭhyate bṛhatsaroruhaṃ sāyāhne 'vacūrṇayet, tadrātrivyuṣitaṃ prabhāte punar avacūrṇitam uddhṛtya haridrākṛsarakṣīrayavāgūnām anyatamaṃ saindhavaguḍaphāṇitayuktam ākaṇṭhaṃ pītavantam āghrāpayet sukumāram utkliṣṭapittakapham auṣadhadveṣiṇam iti samānaṃ pūrveṇa||19||
phalapippalīnāṃ phalādikaṣāyeṇety ādinā ekaṃ ghreyayogam āha| puṣparajaḥprakāśeneti puṣpadhūlisadṛśena| haridrābhidhānaḥ kṛśaro haridrākṛśaraḥ||19||

phalapippalīnāṃ bhallātakavidhiparisrutaṃ ‘bhallātakavidhisrutaṃ’ iti pā. svarasaṃ paktvā phāṇitībhūtam ātantulībhāvāl lehayet; ātapaśuṣkaṃ vā cūrṇīkṛtaṃ jīmūtakādikaṣāyeṇa pitte kaphasthānagate pāyayed iti samānaṃ pūrveṇa||20||
bhallātakavidhiparisrutam iti rasāyanoktabhallātakasnehagrahaṇavidhānena parisrutaḥ svaraso grāhyaḥ| phāṇitayogo 'yam ekaḥ| ātapaśuṣkaṃ vety ādinā cūrṇayogo 'py ekaḥ||20||
phalapippalīcūrṇāni pūrvavat phalādīnāṃ ‘kovidārādīnāṃ’ iti pā. ṣaṇṇām anyatamakaṣāyasrutāni vartikriyāḥ phalādikaṣāyopasarjanāḥ ‘kovidārādikaṣāyopasarjanāḥ’ iti pā. peyā iti samānaṃ pūrveṇa||21||

phalapippalīcūrṇānīty ādau phalādiṣaṭkaṣāyabhedena kṛtatvāt ṣaḍ vartiprayogā jñeyāḥ| vartikriyāyāṃ caturguṇena kvāthena pākād vartyākāratā ‘śalākākāravartiḥ’ iti pā. kartavyā| atrāpi ca tathā lehādau ca sāmānyoktena madhuprakṣepo yuktaḥ; taṃ caike madhunaḥ pākavirodhān nānumanyante||21||

phalapippalīnām āragvadha ‘phalapippalīṣvā...’ iti pā. -vṛkṣaka-svādukaṇṭaka-pāṭhā-pāṭalā-śārṅgeṣṭā-mūrvā-saptaparṇa-naktamāla-picumarda-paṭola-suṣavī-guḍūcī-somavalka-dvīpikānāṃ pippalī-pippalīmūla-hastipippalī-citraka-śṛṅgaverāṇāṃ
cānyatamakaṣāyeṇa siddho leha iti samānaṃ pūrveṇa||22||

phalapippalīnām āragvadhety ādinā āragvadhādiviṃśatidravyakvāthabhedena kṛtatvād viṃśatir lehā jñeyāḥ| vṛkṣakaḥ kuṭajaḥ, svādukaṇṭakaḥ vikaṅkataḥ, śārṅgeṣṭā guñjā, suṣavī kāravellakaṃ, dvīpikā hiṃsrā, ‘kaṇṭakārī’ ity anye||22||

phalapippalīṣv elā-hareṇukā-śatapuṣpā-kustumburu-tagara-kuṣṭha-tvak-coraka-marubakāguru-guggulvelavāluka-śrīveṣṭaka-paripelava-māṃsī-śaileyaka-sthauṇeyaka-sarala-pārāvatapadyaśokarohiṇīnāṃ viṃśater anyatamasya kaṣāyeṇa sādhitotkārikā utkārikākalpena, modakā vā modakakalpena, yathādoṣarogabhakti prayojyā iti samānaṃ pūrveṇa||23||

phalapippalīṣv ity ādinotkārikā modakāś ca pratyekaṃ viṃśatiḥ| corakaḥ gandhadravyaṃ svanāmakhyātaṃ, paripelavaṃ kaivartamustakaṃ, sthauṇeyakaḥ granthiparṇakaṃ, pārāvatapadī jyotiṣmatī, aśokarohiṇī aśokasadṛśapatrā latā, ‘kaṭurohiṇī’ ity anye| kecid atra sthauṇeyakaṃ parityajyāpākīpādyā viṃśatiṃ pūrayanti, apākīpādī svanāmakhyātā| utkārikākalpeneti sūdaśāstroktotkārikāvidhānena||23||
phalapippalīsvarasakaṣāyaparibhāvitāni tilaśālitaṇḍulapiṣṭāni tatkaṣāyopasarjanāni śaṣkulīkalpena vā śaṣkulyaḥ, pūpakalpena vā pūpāḥ iti samānaṃ pūrveṇa||24||

etenaiva ca kalpena sumukha-surasa-kuṭheraka-kāṇḍīra-kālamālaka-parṇāsaka-kṣavaka-phaṇijjhaka-gṛñjana-kāsamarda-bhṛṅgarājānāṃ poṭekṣuvālikā-kālaṅkataka-daṇḍairakāṇāṃ cānyatamasya kaṣāyeṇa kārayet||25||

phalapippalīsvarasenety ādinā śaṣkulyapūpayoḥ pṛthag eko yogaḥ| etenaiva ca kalpenety ādinā sumukhādipañcadaśadravyakaṣāyeṇa pṛthak śaṣkulyapūpayoḥ karaṇāt pañcadaśa yogā bhavanti| evaṃ militvā śaṣkulīpūpayoḥ pṛthak ṣoḍaśayogā bhavanti| poṭā ikṣugandhā; daṇḍairakā gundrākhyagulmaḥ, nalo vā||24-25||

tathā badaraṣāḍava-rāga-leha-modakotkārikā-tarpaṇa-pānaka-māṃsarasa-yūṣa-madyānāṃ ‘...yūṣamadyāni madanaphalaphāṇitenopasaṃsṛjya’ iti pā. madanaphalāny anyatamenopasṛjya yathādoṣarogabhakti dadyāt; taiḥ sādhu vamatīti||26||
tathā badaraṣāḍavety ādinā daśa yogāḥ| badarakṛtaḥ ṣāḍavo badaraṣāḍavaḥ||26||

lg.l: madanaḥ karahāṭaś ca rāṭhaḥ piṇḍītakaḥ phalam|
śvasanaś ceti paryāyair ucyate tasya kalpanā||27||

ab.seg: madanasya vyavahārārthaṃ paryāyān āha- madanaḥ karahāṭaś cety ādi| tasya kalpaneti ya evambhūtaiḥ paryāyair vyākhyātas tasyeyaṃ kalpanā| asya ca paryāyābhidhānaṃ bhūriprayogeṣu vihitatvenābhyarhitatvāj jñeyam| evam anyatrāpi paryāyābhidhāne prayojanaṃ varṇanīyam||27||

tatra ślokāḥ-
nava yogāḥ kaṣāyeṣu, mātrāsv aṣṭau ‘vartiṣvaṣṭau’ iti pā., payoghṛte|
pañca, phāṇitacūrṇe dvau ghreye, vartikriyāsu ṣaṭ||28||
madanaphalayogānāṃ navādisaṅkhyotkarṣanirāsārthaṃ sukhasmaraṇārthaṃ ca tān saṅgraheṇāha- nava yogā ity ādi| asya cārtho yathāsthānaṃ vyāhṛtaḥ||28-30||
ity agniveśakṛte tantre carakapratisaṃskṛte 'prāpte dṛḍhabalasampūrite kalpasthāne madanakalpo nāma prathamo 'dhyāyaḥ||1||
iti śrīcakrapāṇidattaviracitāyāṃ carakatātparyaṭīkāyām āyurvedadīpikāyāṃ kalpasthāne madanakalpo nāma prathamo 'dhyāyaḥ||1||

div.head: jīmūtakakalpaḥ

ab.seg: athāto jīmūtakakalpaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ||1||
iti ha smāha bhagavān ātreyaḥ||2||

madanakalpānantaram anapāyitvenekṣvākvādidravyebhyaḥ prādhānyāj jīmūtakasya jīmūtakalpo 'bhidhīyate| evaṃ yathā yathaiṣām anapāyitvaprakarṣaḥ, tathā tathā pūrvaniveśanaṃ jñeyam| tenāparavamanakalpānām apy adhyāyasambandho 'traivokto jñeyaḥ| madanaphalasya snehasvedādipūrvakatvavad ihāpi kramo 'tideśād unnetavyaḥ||1-2||

lg.l: garāgarī ca veṇī ca tathā syād devatāḍakaḥ||3||

ab.seg: phalapuṣpāśrayam iti vacanena jīmūtasya patranālādiṣu vamanaprayogaṃ niṣedhayati| garāgarī cety ādi paryāyakathanam| jīmūtaḥ pītaghoṣakaḥ||3||

tridoṣaghnam iti yathāsvaṃ vātaharādidravyayuktaṃ, tathā vātādiharadravyakalpitaṃ ‘peyādikalpitaṃ ca’ iti pā. ca sat tridoṣaghnaṃ bhavati| hikkādyeṣv iti ādyaśabdena kāsādīnām urogatadoṣajanyānāṃ grahaṇam||4||

lg.l: payaḥ ‘payaḥpuṣpeṣu nirvṛttaṃ’ iti pā. puṣpe 'sya, nirvṛtte phale peyā payaskṛtā||5||
śṛte payasi dadhy amlaṃ jātaṃ ‘jāte’ iti pā. haritapāṇḍuke||6||
jīrṇānāṃ ca suśuṣkāṇāṃ nyastānāṃ bhājane śucau|

ab.seg: yathoktayuktaguṇayuktānām iti kālajatva-sampūrṇarasatvādiguṇayuktāni madanaphaloktaguṇadvārā'nusartavyāni| deśajānām iti madanakalpoktapraśastabhūmijātānām| yathāvidhīti madanakalpoktavidhānagṛhītānām| payaḥ puṣpe ity eko yogaḥ| nirvṛtte ity ādiko dvitīyo yogaḥ| nirvṛtte iti utpannamātre phale, tatra phalaiḥ kṣīraṃ sādhayitvā tena kṣīreṇa peyā sādhanīyā| romaśe ity ādi tṛtīyaḥ| romaśe iti upagataromṇi phale, atrāpi romaśaphalasādhitakṣīrāt santānikā jñeyā| dadhyuttaram ity ādikaś caturtho yogaḥ, atrāpy upagataromāvasthaphalasādhitakṣīrasambhūtadadhisaro jñeyaḥ| śṛte payasīty ādikaḥ pañcamaḥ| dadhy amlam iti amlāvasthaṃ dadhi jātam| haritapāṇḍuke iti haritapāṇḍvavasthāprāpte jīmūtakaphale| jīrṇānām ity ādikaḥ ṣaṣṭhaḥ kṣīrayogaḥ| ete ca yogāḥ kṣīrasambandhena avidhīyamānakṣīrākārā api kṣīraprayogatvenaiva saṅgrahe ‘ṣaṭ kṣīre’ ity anena saṅgrahītavyāḥ||5-7||

lg.l: āsutya ca surāmaṇḍe mṛditvā prasrutaṃ pibet|
dve cāpothyāthavā trīṇi guḍūcyā ‘guḍūcyāmalakasya vā’ iti pā. madhukasya vā|
kaṣāyeṣv āsutaṃ pūtvā tenaiva vidhinā pibet|

div.ab: āsutyety ādinā madirāyoga eka ucyate| āsutyeti niśāparyuṣitaṃ kṛtvā| atra yoge pakvajīmūtakaphalam evādhikṛtaṃ; tathā, uttarayogeṣv api pakvam eva phalam adhikṛtaṃ jñeyaṃ, “phalaṃ paryāgataṃ grāhyaṃ” ity autsargikavacanāt| dve cety ādinā dvādaśakaṣāyabhedād dvādaśayogā ucyante| tenaiva vidhineti madanakalpoktena sādhanavidhinā| athavety ādau āragvadhādisaptadravyakaṣāyabhedāt saptayogā bhavanti| āragvadhādayaḥ āragvadha-vṛkṣaka-svādukaṇṭaka-pāṭhā-pāṭali-śārṅgeṣṭā-mūrvāḥ (ka.a.1) pūrvādhyāyoktāḥ||8-10||-

lg.l: mātrāḥ syuḥ ‘vartayaḥ’ iti pā. phalavac cāṣṭau kolamātrās tu tā matāḥ||11||

ab.seg: mātrāḥ syur ity ādinā'ṣṭau mātrāyogān āha| phalavad iti madanaphale yathā aṣṭau mātrāyogā uktās tathehāpi kartavyāḥ, viśeṣatas tu etāḥ kolamātrāḥ kartavyāḥ, na tu phalavad dharītakyādipramāṇāḥ kartavyā ity arthaḥ||11||
jīvakety ādinā caturo yogāḥ pānasādhanakaṣāyabhedāt||12||

lg.l: phalādīnāṃ kaṣāyeṇa śreṣṭhaṃ tad vamanaṃ matam||13||

ab.seg: tathety ādinā ghṛtayogam ekam āha||13||

tatra ślokau-
ṣaṭ kṣīre madirāmaṇḍe ‘madirāyoge’ iti pā. eko dvādaśa cāpare|
sapta cāragvadhādīnāṃ kaṣāye 'ṣṭau ca vartiṣu||14||

lg.l: kalpe jīmūtakānāṃ ca ‘ye’ iti ‘te’ iti ca pā. yogās triṃśan navādhikāḥ||15||

ab.seg: ṣaṭ kṣīre ity ādinā saṅgrahārtho vyākṛta eva yathāsthānam||14-15||
ity agniveśakṛte tantre carakapratisaṃskṛte 'prāpte dṛḍhabalasampūrite kalpasthāne jīmūtakakalpo nāma dvitīyo 'dhyāyaḥ||2||
iti śrīcakrapāṇidattaviracitāyāṃ carakatātparyaṭīkāyām āyurvedadīpikāyāṃ kalpasthāne jīmūtakakalpo nāma dvitīyo 'dhyāyaḥ||2||

div.head: ikṣvākukalpaḥ

ab.seg: athāta ikṣvākukalpaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ||1||
iti ha smāha bhagavān ātreyaḥ||2||

div.ab: uktādhyāyasambandhād ikṣvākukalpo 'bhidhīyate| yeṣāṃ praśasyate ikṣvākukalpas tān vakṣyāmīti yojyam||1-2||-

lg.l: lambā'tha ‘lambā piṇḍaphalā tumbī kaṭukālābukī ca sā’ iti pā. kaṭukālābūs tumbī piṇḍaphalā tathā||3||
ikṣvākuḥ phalinī caiva procyate tasya kalpanā|4|

div.ab: lambety ādi paryāyakathanam||3||-

lg.l: pratāmyati nare caiva vamanārthaṃ tad iṣyate|5|

div.ab: tad iṣyate iti ikṣvākukalpanam iṣyate||4||-

lg.l: puṣpādiṣu ca catvāraḥ kṣīre jīmūtake yathā||6||
uraḥsthite kaphe dadyāt svarabhede ca pīnase|
jīrṇe madhyoddhṛte kṣīraṃ ‘jīrṇamadhyoddhṛtaṃ kṣīre’ iti pā. prakṣipet tad yadā dadhi||8||
jātaṃ syāt sakaphe kāse śvāse vamyāṃ ca tat pibet|
ajākṣīreṇa bījāni bhāvayet ‘bhāvitāni prayojayet’ iti pā. pāyayet ca||9||
tena takraṃ vipakvaṃ vā sakṣaudralavaṇaṃ pibet|11|

div.ab: apuṣpasyety ādinā ekaḥ kṣīrayogaḥ| apuṣpasyeti anutpannapuṣpasya| muṣṭiṃ prādeśasammitam iti pradeśinyā mūlaparyantakṛtamuṣṭiparimāṇam; evaṃ ca nātra muṣṭiśabdaḥ palavacanaḥ| kṣīraprasthe śṛtam iti vacanāt kṣīraprasthe yathoktamānam ikṣvākum āvāpya caturguṇaṃ pānīyaṃ dattvā kṣīraṃ sādhanīyam| puṣpādiṣv ity ādinā caturaḥ kṣīrayogān āha| jīmūtake yathā “payaḥ puṣpe 'sya nirvṛtte phale peyā payaskṛtā| romaśe kṣīrasantānaṃ dadhyuttaram aromaśe” (ka.a.2) ity anenoktaṃ, tathehāpi yogacatuṣṭayaṃ karaṇīyam| haritety ādinā surāyogam āha| haritapāṇḍūnām ikṣvākuphalānāṃ surāmaṇḍe jīmūtakavad yogaḥ kartavyaḥ; jīmūtakavidhānātideśena “āsutya ca surāmaṇḍe muditvā prasrutaṃ pibet” (ka.a.2) iti granthoktavidhānam ihāpi bhavati| phalasvarasety ādinā ṣaṣṭhaḥ kṣīrayogo 'bhidhīyate| triguṇakṣīrasādhitam iti triguṇena kṣīreṇa sādhitaṃ; tac ca caturguṇena toyena sādhanīyam| phalaśabdenātrekṣvākuphalam ucyate| jīrṇe ity ādinā saptamaḥ kṣīrayogaḥ| madhyoddhṛte iti uddhṛtamadhye| ajākṣīreṇety ādinā'ṣṭamaḥ kṣīrayogaḥ| tena takram ity ādinā takrayogaḥ| teneti tumbīphalamadhyena||5-10||-

tumbyā ity ādinā ghreyayogam āha| gandhasampatsukhocita iti gandhasampat sugandhavattvaṃ, tayā gandhasampadā sukham ucitam abhyastaṃ yena saḥ; avacūrṇitekṣvākuphalarasapuṣpaṃ ‘avacūrṇitamikṣvākuphalarasabhāvitaṃ’ iti pā. mālyam āghrāyaiva vamaty anabhyastadurgandha iti bhāvaḥ||11||-

lg.l: bhakṣayet phalamadhyaṃ vā guḍena palalena ca||12||
ikṣvākuphalatailaṃ vā siddhaṃ vā pūrvavad ghṛtam|13|

div.ab: bhakṣayed ity ādinā vamanayogam ekam āha| phalamadhyam ikṣvākuphalamadhyam| ikṣvākuphalakalkasādhitaṃ tailam ikṣvākuphalatailam; ayameka eva tailayogaḥ| pūrvavad iti jīmūtakavat, tena “tathā jīmūtakakṣīrāt” (ka.a.2) ity ādinoktavidhānena jīmūtakasthāne ikṣvākuphalaṃ dattveha ghṛtaṃ sādhanīyam||12||-

lg.l: pibed vimṛdya bījāni kaṣāyeṣv āśataṃ pṛthak|14|

div.ab: pañcāśad ity ādinā ṣaḍ vardhamānakayogān āha| pañcāśad ārabhya daśakena vṛddhair ikṣvākubījaiḥ śataṃ pūraṇīyam| tena ṣaḍyogā bhavanti| tāni ca yathāsaṅkhyaṃ madanaphalādīnāṃ ṣaṇṇām anyatamakaṣāyeṣv āsutya vimṛditāni pātavyāni ‘tena madanaphalādīnāṃ ṣaṇṇāṃ kaṣāye āsutāḥ santo vimṛditāḥ pātavyāḥ’ iti pā.| anye tu daśabījād ārabhya pañcāśadbījaparyantaṃ doṣādyapekṣayā pātavyaṃ; tatra madanādikaṣāyabhedād eva yogabheda ity āhuḥ||13||-

ab.seg: yaṣṭyāhvety ādinā navakaṣāyayogān āha| tatra yaṣṭyāhvam ekaṃ, kovidārādayo madanakalpoktā aṣṭau||14||

lg.l: kaṣāyaiḥ kovidārādyair mātrāś ca ‘rvartayaḥ’ iti pā. phalavat smṛtāḥ|15|

div.ab: kaṣāyair ity ādinā madanaphalasadṛśavidhā aṣṭau mātrālakṣitāḥ prayogā ucyante|15|-

lg.l: pūtasyāsya trayo bhāgāś caturthaḥ ‘bhāgāstrayastrikaṭukasya ca’ iti pā. phāṇitasya tu|
saghṛto bījabhāgaś ca piṣṭān ardhāṃśikāṃs tathā ‘piṣṭvā hyardhāṃśikāṃstathā’ iti pā.||16||
taṃ lehaṃ sādhayed darvyā ghaṭṭayan mṛdunā'gninā||17||
yāvat syāt tantumat toye patitaṃ tu na śīryate|
taṃ lihan mātrayā lehaṃ ‘kāle’ iti pā. pramathyāṃ ca pibed anu||18||

div.ab: bilvety ādinā eko lehaḥ, tathā ‘kalpa’ ity ādinā catvāro lehā ante draṣṭavyāḥ, evaṃ pañca lehāḥ| añjaliḥ palacatuṣṭayam| atra ca “tataś ca kuḍavaṃ yāvat toyam aṣṭaguṇaṃ bhavet” iti vacanād bilvamūlakaṣāyasyāṣṭāv añjalayo deyāḥ, tataś caturbhāgāvaśeṣeṇa kuḍavadvayam| phāṇitam ardhaśṛta ikṣurasaḥ| ‘caturthaḥ phāṇitasya ca’ ity asya sthāne ‘trayas trikaṭukasya ca’ iti kecit paṭhanti| saghṛta iti ghṛtasyaiko bhāgaḥ| ardhāṃśikān iti ekabhāgārdhamānān pratyekaṃ mahājālinyādīn| mahājālinī pītakoṣātakī, kṛtavedhanaḥ ghoṣakabhedaḥ ‘jyotsnikā” iti khyātaḥ| yāvat syāt tantumad ity ādinā lehapākalakṣaṇam āha; etac ca lakṣaṇaṃ lehāntareṣv api pācanīyeṣu jñeyam| na śīryate na vistīryate| pramathyāṃ ca pibed anv iti atīsāracikitsite “pippalī nāgaraṃ dhānyaṃ” (ci.a.19) ity ādinoktapramathyānāṃ madhye 'nyatamapramathyākṛtaṃ kaṣāyaṃ pibed ity arthaḥ| ‘pramathyāṃ ca’ ity asya sthāne kecit ‘manthaṃ cāpi’ iti paṭhanti| agnimanthādāv iti pratyekam agnimantha-syonāka-pāṭalā-gambhārīmūlacatuṣkaṃ pañcamūlakathanaprastāve rasāyane kathitam||15-18||-
śaktubhir ity ādinaiko manthayogaḥ||19||-

lg.l: gulme mehe ‘śophe’ iti pā. praseke ca kalkaṃ māṃsarasaiḥ pibet|
naraḥ sādhu vamaty evaṃ na ca daurbalyam aśnute||20||

ab.seg: gulme jvara ity ādinā rasaikayogam āha| kalkam ikṣvākubījakalkam||20||

tatra ślokāḥ-
payasy aṣṭau surāmaṇḍa-mastu-takreṣu ca trayaḥ|
ghreyaṃ sapalalaṃ tailaṃ vardhamānāḥ phaleṣu ṣaṭ||21||

lg.l: aṣṭau vartikriyā lehāḥ pañca mantho ‘manthe rase tathā’ iti pā. rasastathā||22||
yogā ikṣvākukalpe ‘ikṣvākukalpe'smin’ iti pā. te catvāriṃśac ca pañca ca|

ab.seg: payasy aṣṭāv ity ādisaṅgrahārtho vyākṛta eva| atra phaleṣv iti madanaphalādiṣu| ghṛtaṃ yady api vardhamānapūrvapaṭhitaṃ, tathā'pi chandonurodhād iha paścāt paṭhitam||21-23||
ity agniveśakṛte tantre carakapratisaṃskṛte 'prāpte dṛḍhabalasampūrite kalpasthāne ikṣvākukalpo nāma tṛtīyo 'dhyāyaḥ||3||
iti śrīcakrapāṇidattaviracitāyām āyurvedadīpikāyāṃ carakatātparyaṭīkāyāṃ kalpasthāne ikṣvākukalpo nāma tṛtīyo 'dhyāyaḥ||3||

div.head: dhāmārgavakalpaḥ

ab.seg: athāto dhāmārgavakalpaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ||1||
iti ha smāha bhagavān ātreyaḥ||2||
uktasambandhād dhāmārgavakalpo 'bhidhīyate||1-2||

lg.l: karkoṭakī koṭhaphalā ‘kaṭuphalā’ iti pā. mahājālinir eva ca|

ab.seg: tatra karkoṭakīty ādinā paryāyakathanam| dhāmārgavaḥ pītaghoṣakaḥ||3||

lg.l: rogeṣv eṣu ‘rogeṣvetat’ iti pā. prayojyaṃ syāt sthirāś ca guravaś ca ye|5|

div.ab: sthirāś ca guravaś ca ye ity atra ‘gadāḥ’ iti śeṣaḥ||4||-

lg.l: phalaṃ puṣpaṃ pravālaṃ ca vidhinā tasya saṃharet||5||

ab.seg: vidhineti bheṣajagrahaṇoktena vidhinā||5||

lg.l: pravālasvarasaṃ śuṣkaṃ kṛtvā ca ‘kṛtāśca’ iti pā. gulikāḥ pṛthak|

ab.seg: pravālety ādinā navayogān āha| pravālasya svarasaḥ pravālasvarasaḥ| atra kovidārādikaṣāyair guḍikākaraṇaṃ pānaṃ ca jñeyam||6||

div.ab: puṣpādiṣu payoyogāś catvāraḥ ‘prayogāśca’ iti, ‘yathāyogāḥ’ iti ca pā. pañcamī surā| pūrvavat...|7|

puṣpādiṣv ity ādinā jīmūtakakalpavidhānena nirdiṣṭāś catvāraḥ kṣīraprayogāḥ, pañcamaś ca surāyogo 'tidiśyate; te ca ‘payaḥ puṣpe 'sya’ (ka. a. 2) ity ādinoktā jñeyāḥ| pūrvavad iti pūrveṇa sambadhyate|7|-

ab.seg: ... jīrṇaśuṣkāṇām ataḥ kalpaḥ pravakṣyate||7||

lg.l: dadyād gulmodarārtebhyo ye cāpy anye kaphāmayāḥ|9|

div.ab: jīrṇaśuṣkāṇām ity ādinā navakaṣāyayogān āha, tathā ‘jātyāḥ’ ity ādinā ekādaśa kaṣāyayogān vakṣyati; evaṃ viṃśatiḥ kaṣāyayogāḥ saṅgrahe vakṣyamāṇāḥ pūryante| bījakaṇṭhoddhṛtaṃ phalam iti yatra bījāni baddhāni santi sa bījakaṇṭha uddhṛto yasmin tad bījakaṇṭhoddhṛtaṃ phalam| atra ca pūrvanipātāniyama āhitāgnyādipūrvanipātavad bodhyaḥ| evambhūtaṃ ca phalaṃ kaṣāyeṇa saguḍena pūritaṃ rātrivyuṣitaṃ kartavyam| uktaṃ hi jatūkarṇe- dhāmārgavakalpe- “dhāmārgavaphaleṣūddhṛtabījamadhyeṣu saguḍoṣitāḥ kovidārādikaṣāyā nava” iti| gulmināṃ cāvasthāyāṃ vamanaṃ hitam eva, teneha gulmaviṣayatayā vamanopadarśanaṃ na virodhi||7-8||-

ab.seg: dadyād ity ādinā eko 'nnayoga ucyate| anne ca dhāmārgavasya saṃyogenaiko yogaḥ||9||
cūrṇair ity ādinā ghreye ekayogam āha| utpalādīnāṃ cātra bhedo 'vivakṣitaḥ utpalasyaika eva ghreyayogaḥ| atra ādiśabdena saugandhikapadmādīnāṃ grahaṇam| prabhūtaśaś cūrṇair bhāvitānīti jñeyam||10||

lg.l: vinīyāñjalimātre tu pibed go 'śvaśakṛdrase ‘gośakṛto rase’ iti pā.||11||
śvadaṃṣṭrakharakhaṅgānāṃ caivaṃ peyā śakṛdrase ‘pṛṣatarṣyakuraṅgāśvataragokarṇarāsame| hariṇājaśvadaṃṣṭrāvisambhave ca śakṛdrase’ iti pā.||12||

ab.seg: cūrṇīkṛtasyety ādinā go 'śvaśakṛdrase iti dvau yogau| tathā pṛṣatety ādidaśayogaiḥ samaṃ śakṛdrasayogasambandhād dvādaśa śakṛdyogā ucyante| pṛṣataḥ binducitritahariṇaḥ; ṛṣyaḥ nīlāṇḍaḥ, kuraṅgaḥ cañcalagatiḥ, aśvataraḥ vegasaraḥ, śvadaṃṣṭraḥ caturdaṃṣṭro mṛgaviśeṣaḥ||11-12||

div.ab: jīvakety ādinā daśa lehān āha| madhūlikā ‘markaṭahasta’ iti khyātā| atra leheṣu dhāmārgavāditaradravyacūrṇasya samānatvaṃ; madhuśarkarayoś ca tāvatī mātrā yāvatyā lehatvāpattir bhavati| pittoṣmasahite kaphe iti udyatoṣmaguṇena pittena yukte kaphe; anye tu pittoṣmaśabdena pittoṣmaṇā ‘pittakṛtaṃ’ iti pā. kṛtaṃ jvaram āhuḥ||13-14||-
dhānyety ādinaikaṃ kalkayogam āha| dhānyatumbarukvātha eva dhānyatumburuyūṣaḥ| uktaṃ hi jatūkaṇa “dhānyatumbururasena kalko viṣanut” iti||15|

lg.l: bimbyāḥ punarnavāyā vā kāsamardasya vā pṛthak ‘punarnavākāsamardabimbīhaimavatasya ca| mahāsahākṣudrasahāvṛścīrāṇāṃ pṛthak pṛthak’ iti pā.|
ekaṃ dhāmārgavaṃ dve vā kaṣāye parimṛdya tu||17||

div.ab: jātyā ity ādinā ekādaśakaṣāyayogān āha| jātī saumanasyāyinī, anye yūthikāṃ vadanti| vṛścīraḥ śvetapunarnavā| mahāsahā kṣudrasahā mudgamāṣaparṇyau| haimavatī vacā||16-17||-

ab.seg: tacchṛtety ādinaikaṃ ghṛtayogam āha||18||

tatra ślokau-
pallave nava catvāraḥ kṣīra ekaḥ surāsave|
kaṣāye viṃśatiḥ kalke daśa dvau ca śakṛdrase||19||

lg.l: anna ekas tathā ghreye daśa lehās tathā ghṛtam|

ab.seg: pallave navety ādisaṅgrahe vyutkramasaṅgrahābhidhānaṃ chando 'nurodhāt| daśa dvau ceti dvādaśety arthaḥ||19-20||
ity agniveśakṛte tantre carakapratisaṃskṛte 'prāpte dṛḍhabalasampūrite kalpasthāne dhāmārgavakalpo nāma caturtho 'dhyāyaḥ||4||
iti śrīcakrapāṇidattaviracitāyām āyurvedadīpikāyāṃ carakatātparyaṭīkāyāṃ kalpasthāne dhāmārgavakalpo nāma caturtho 'dhyāyaḥ||4||

div.head: vatsakakalpaḥ

ab.seg: athāto vatsakakalpaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ||1||
iti ha smāha bhagavān ātreyaḥ||2||
yathoktasambandhād vatsakakalpābhidhānam||1-2||

lg.l: kalpaṃ cāsya pravakṣyāmi ‘nibodhemaṃ’ iti pā. vistareṇa yathātatham||3||
bṛhatphalaḥ śvetapuṣpaḥ ‘sitaiḥ puṣpaiḥ’ iti pā. snigdhapatraḥ pumān bhavet|
śyāmā cāruṇapuṣpā strī phalavṛntais tathā'ṇubhiḥ ‘phalapuṣpaiḥ’ iti pā.||5||

ab.seg: vatsakanāmāni vyavahārārthaṃ strīpuruṣabhedaṃ cāha- athety ādi| atra vatsakastrīpuruṣabhedena yady api guṇabhedaḥ prayogabhedo vā na pratipāditaḥ, tathā'pi strīrūpavatsake 'puṣpaphalatvādiviśiṣṭalakṣaṇayukte 'py aviśeṣeṇobhābhyām evāmayanivṛttiḥ syād ity etadartham ubhayor api samānaguṇatā jñātavyā||3-6||

lg.l: kāle phalāni saṅgṛhyā tayoḥ śuṣkāṇi nikṣipet ‘saṅkṣipet’ iti pā.|
teṣām antarnakhaṃ muṣṭiṃ jarjarīkṛtya bhāvayet ‘tepayet’ iti, ‘temayet iti’ ca pā.||7||

div.ab: kāle iti ucite kāle| śuṣkāṇīti pakvaśuṣkāṇi| teṣām antarnakham ity ādinā kaṣāyair navayogān āha| kṣaudrasaindhavayogo yady api sarvavamaneṣv eva sāmānyena vihitaḥ, tathā'pīha ‘lavaṇakṣaudrasaṃyutam’ iti vacanād utkarṣo lavaṇasaindhavayor abhidhīyate||7-8||-

lg.l: jīvakasya ‘jīmūtakakaṣāyeṇa’ iti pā. kaṣāyeṇa tataḥ pāṇitalaṃ pibet|

div.ab: aṣṭāham ity ādinā pañca cūrṇayogān āha||9-10||-

ab.seg: kṛśareṇety ādinā kṛśarayoga ucyate| atra ca indrayavacūrṇam adhikṛtatvād evocyate||11||

tatra ślokaḥ-
kaṣāyair nava cūrṇaiś ca pañcoktāḥ salilais trayaḥ|
ekaś ca kṛśarāyāṃ syād yogās te 'ṣṭādaśa smṛtāḥ ‘kṛśarā'ṣṭādaśayogā vatsakasya nidarśitāḥ’ iti pā.||12||
kaṣāyair ity ādisaṅgrahaśloko vyākhyātārtha eva||12||
ity agniveśakṛte tantre carakapratisaṃskṛte 'prāpte dṛḍhabalasampūrite kalpasthāne vatsakakalpo nāma pañcamo 'dhyāyaḥ||5||
iti śrīcakrapāṇidattaviracitāyām āyurvedadīpikāyāṃ carakatātparyaṭīkāyāṃ kalpasthāne vatsakakalpo nāma pañcamo 'dhyāyaḥ||5||

div.head: kṛtavedhanakalpaḥ

ab.seg: athātaḥ kṛtavedhanakalpaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ||1||
iti ha smāha bhagavān ātreyaḥ||2||
vamanakalpapāriśeṣyāt kṛtavedhanakalpo 'bhidhīyate||1-2||

lg.l: kṣveḍaḥ kośātakī coktaṃ ‘jālī’ iti pā. mṛdaṅgaphalam eva ca||3||

ab.seg: gāḍheṣv iti atyarthagāḍheṣu kuṣṭhādiṣu||3-4||

lg.l: kṣīrādi kusumādīnāṃ ‘kṣīrādikusumādīni’ iti pā. surā caiteṣu pūrvavat|5|

div.ab: kṣīrādīty ādinā kṣīrayogā ucyante| kṣīrayogacatuṣṭayaṃ madirāyogaṃ ca jīmūtakakalpavidhānātideśenāha| kṣīrādiśabdena kṣīrakṛtapeyā-kṣīrasantānikā-dadhyuttarāṇāṃ grahaṇam| ete ca saṅgrahe 'kṣīrarūpā api kṣīravikāratayā kṣīraśabdenaiva gṛhītāḥ ‘kṣīre dvau dvau’ iti vacanena| kusumādīnām iti kṛtavedhanasya puṣpādīnāṃ “payaḥ puṣpe 'sya nirvṛtte phale peyā payaskṛtā| lomaśe kṣīrasantānaṃ dadhyuttaram alomaśe” (ka.a.2) iti jīmūtakavidhānoktānām| surā caiteṣu pūrvavad iti yathā jīmūtakakalpavidhānena kṣīrādayaḥ kartavyās tathā surā ca kartavyā|5|

lg.l: suśuṣkāṇāṃ tu jīrṇānām ekaṃ ‘bījānāmekaṃ’ iti pā. dve vā yathābalam||5||
kvāthayitvā phalaṃ ‘rasaṃ taṃ ca kṛtvā lehaṃ’ iti, ‘rasaṃ tasya paktvā lehaṃ’ iti ca pā. tasya pūtvā lehaṃ nidhāpayet||6||

ab.seg: suśuṣkāṇām ity ādinā nava kaṣāyayogān āha| phalavad iti madanaphalaṃ yathā yaṣṭīmadhukādibhiḥ pīyate, tathaitad api pātavyam ity arthaḥ| eke navakaṣāyaprayogeṣu śeṣavidhipratyāyakaṃ lehaṃ paṭhanti- “kvāthayitvā rasaṃ tasya pūtvā lehaṃ nidhāpayet” ity ādi, tac ca saṅgatārtham| uktaṃ ca jatūkarṇe- “atra jīrṇabījānāṃ madanaphalavat kaṣāyair lehā bhavanti nava” iti| pṛthag ity ādinā trayodaśa kaṣāyayogān āha| evaṃ dvāviṃśatiḥ kaṣāyayogā bhavanti| āragvadhādayas trayodaśa madanakalpe “āragvadhavṛkṣaka ...” (ka.a.1) ity ādinā guḍūcyantenoktā jñeyāḥ||5-7||

lg.l: śālmalīmūlacūrṇānāṃ ‘śālmalīmūlavṛntānāṃ’ iti pā. picchābhir daśabhis tathā|8|

div.ab: śālmalīty ādinā daśa picchāyogān āha| śālmalīmūlam ādiḥ yeṣāṃ te śālmalīmūlāḥ śālmalyādayo vimānapaṭhitā daśa śālmalīśālmalakabhadraparṇyelāparṇyupodikoddāladhanvanarājādanopacitrāgopyantāḥ (vi.a.8); eṣāṃ cūrṇānāṃ picchābhir yuktyā kṛtatvenaiva daśa yogā jñeyāḥ| śālmalakaḥ śālmalībhedaḥ, rohitako vā; bhadraparṇī gambhārī; elāparṇī nāgabalā, ahiṃsrety anye; rājādanāṃ kṣīrikā, upacitrā dantī, gopī sārivā|8|

lg.l: vartikriyāḥ ‘vartayaḥ phalavat ṣaṭ syuḥ’ iti pā. ṣaṭ phalavat, phalādīnāṃ ghṛtaṃ tathā||8||

ab.seg: vartikriyāḥ ṣaṭ phalavad iti “phalapippalīcūrṇāni pūrvavat” (ka.a.1) ity ādinā granthena yā vartikriyā uktā madanakalpe, tadvad ihāpi kṛtavedhanacūrṇānāṃ ṣaḍvartikriyāḥ kartavyāḥ| phalādīnāṃ ghṛtaṃ tathety anena kṛtavedhanasādhitakṣīrād utthitaṃ navanītaṃ phalādikaṣāyeṇa sādhanīyaṃ madanaphalaghṛtavad ity arthaḥ||8||

lg.l: taṃ kaṣāyaṃ phalādīnāṃ kalkair lehaṃ punaḥ pacet||9||
kṣveḍasya tatra bhāgaḥ syāc cheṣāṇy ardhāṃśikāni tu|
kaṣāyaiḥ kovidārādyair evaṃ ‘kovidārādyairaṣṭābhistaṃ pṛthak pibet’ iti pā. tat kalpayet pṛthak||10||

ab.seg: kośātakānīty ādi| atraiva kvāthapādike kalke kartavye kṣveḍasya pūrṇo bhāgo deyaḥ, phalādīnāṃ ca pratyekaṃ kṣveḍād ardhabhāgikatvam||9-10||

lg.l: kośātakyā samaṃ paktvā rasaṃ salavaṇaṃ pibet||11||

div.ab: kaṣāyeṣv ity ādinā sapta māṃsayogān āha| samam iti kośātakītulyaṃ māṃsam| atra pibed ity antena ṣaṇmāṃsarasāḥ, phalādīty anena caikaḥ| phalādipippalītulyaṃ tadvad ity anena phalādibhiḥ samaṃ māṃsam| tadvad iti vacanāt kośātakyāḥ kaṣāyeṇa sādhanīyam||11||-

lg.l: kṣveḍaṃ kāsī kāsīti kāsavānityarthaḥ pibet siddhaṃ miśram ikṣurasena ca||12||

ab.seg: ikṣurasayogam ekam āha- kṣveḍam ity ādi| siddham iti ikṣurasena miśritaṃ sat sādhitaṃ pibed ity arthaḥ uktaṃ hi jatūkarṇe- “kṣveḍam ikṣurase śṛtam” iti||12||

tatra ślokau-
kṣīre dvau dvau surā caikā kvāthā dvāviṃśatistathā|
daśa picchā ghṛtaṃ caikaṃ ṣaṭ ca vartikriyāḥ śubhāḥ||13||

lg.l: lehe 'ṣṭau sapta māṃse ca yoga ikṣurase 'paraḥ|

ab.seg: kṣīre dvau dvāv ity ādisaṅgrahaḥ| dvau dvāv iti catvāraḥ||13-14||
ity agniveśakṛte tantre carakapratisaṃskṛte 'prāpte dṛḍhabalasampūrite kalpasthāne kṛtavedhanakalpo nāma ṣaṣṭho 'dhyāyaḥ||6||
iti śrīcakrapāṇidattaviracitāyāṃ carakatātparyaṭīkāyām āyurvedadīpikāyāṃ kalpasthāne kṛtavedhanakalpo nāma ṣaṣṭho 'dhyāyaḥ||6||

div.head: śyāmātrivṛtkalpaḥ

ab.seg: athātaḥ śyāmātrivṛtkalpaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ||1||
iti ha smāha bhagavān ātreyaḥ||2||

vamanārthakalpanānantaraṃ virecanakalpeṣu vaktavyeṣu trivṛtāyā virecanadravyeṣu sukhavirecanatayā pradhānatvāt trivṛtkalpa evābhidhīyate| trivṛtābheda eva ca śyāmā, tena śyāmāyās trivṛtāyāś ca kalpaḥ śyāmātrivṛtkalpaḥ| yady api cāruṇamūlaiva trivṛd atrotkṛṣṭā vaktavyā, tathā'py adhyāyasañjñāyāṃ śyāmāyā agre pāṭhenāśudoṣahantṛtayā śyāmāyāḥ prakarṣaṃ darśayati| ye cātra yogā vaktavyās te 'ruṇayā vā śyāmayā vā ubhābhyāṃ vā doṣaśarīrādibalābalam avekṣya kartavyāḥ||1-2||

lg.l: virecane trivṛnmūlaṃ śreṣṭham āhur manīṣiṇaḥ ‘…rmaharṣayaḥ’ iti pā.|
tasyāḥ sañjñā guṇāḥ karma bhedaḥ kalpaś ca vakṣyate||3||

ab.seg: virecane ity ādau trivṛnmūlaśabdena śyāmamūlāyā aruṇamūlāyāś ca sāmānyena mūlaṃ gṛhyate||3||

lg.l: tribhaṇḍī trivṛtā caiva ‘śyāmā suvahā koṭarā tathā| trivṛt sarvānubhūtiśca’ iti pā. śyāmā kūṭaraṇā tathā|
sarvānubhūtiḥ suvahā ‘saralā’ iti pā. śabdaiḥ paryāyavācakaiḥ||4||

ab.seg: paryāyatvena vācakaiḥ paryāyavācakaiḥ||4||

lg.l: kaṣāyā madhurā rūkṣā vipāke kaṭukā ca sā|
kalpavaiśeṣyam āsādya ‘kalpe vaiśeṣyamāsādya’ iti pā. sarvarogaharā bhavet||6||

ab.seg: sedānīm ity ādi| vātāpahauṣadhayogena vātahantṛtvam avidyamānaṃ bhavati, kaphapittahantṛtvaṃ vidyamānam adhikaṃ bhavatīti jñeyam| kalpavaiśeṣyam iti kalpanāviśeṣam| sarvarogahareti vyastasamastasarvadoṣārabdharogaharā||5-6||

lg.l: mūlaṃ tu dvividhaṃ tasyāḥ śyāmaṃ cāruṇam eva ca|
tayor mukhyataraṃ ‘tayoḥ śreṣṭhataraṃ’ iti pā. viddhi mūlaṃ yad aruṇaprabham||7||
sukumāre śiśau vṛddhe mṛdukoṣṭhe ca tac chubham ‘taddhitam’ iti pā.|
mohayed āśukāritvāc chyāmā kṣiṇvīta mūrcchayet ‘śyāmā kaṇṭhaṃ kṣiṇotyapi’ iti pā.||8||
taikṣṇyāt karṣati hṛtkaṇṭham āśu doṣaṃ haraty api|
śasyate bahudoṣāṇāṃ krūrakoṣṭhāś ca ye narāḥ||9||

ab.seg: trivṛtayor bhedam āha- mūlaṃ tu dvividham ity ādi| mukhyataram iti virecanakriyāyām evāvyāpattikaratvāc chreṣṭhataram| sukumārāḥ śiśavaś ca yady apy avirecanīyā uktās tathā'pi teṣāṃ vidhīyamānavirecane hitam iti jñeyam| mohayed ity ādinā śyāmamūlāyā guṇakarmaṇī brūte| kṣiṇvīteti dhātukṣayaṃ kuryāt||7-9||

lg.l: guṇavatyāṃ tayor bhūmau jātaṃ mūlaṃ samuddharet|
tad vipāṭyoddhared garbhaṃ ‘tadvipothyoddharedgarbha’ iti pā. tvacaṃ śuṣkāṃ nidhāpayet||11||

ab.seg: yady api madanakalpa eva guṇavadbhūmijātatvādi sāmānyena bheṣajānām uktam eva, tathā'pi gambhīrānugatatvādiviśeṣasya tatrānuktasyehābhidhāne sati tatprasaṅgāt tat kiñcid ucyate- guṇavatyām ity ādi| śukle iti śuklapakṣe| gambhīrānugam iti dūrapraviṣṭam| uddhared garbham iti mūlasyāsthi uddharet| nidhāpayed iti yathoktabhaiṣajyasthāpanavidhānena sthāpayet||10-11||

lg.l: snigdhasvinno virecyas tu peyāmātroṣitaḥ ‘peyāmātrocitaḥ’ iti, ‘peyāmātrāśritaḥ’ iti ca pā. sukham|12|

div.ab: peyāmātroṣita iti pūrvadine peyāmātrāhāratayā uṣitaḥ; yady api cānyatra virecanapūrvadineṣu tathaivāhāro niyamitaḥ- “snehavaddravam uṣṇaṃ ca tryahaṃ bhuktvā rasaudanam” (sū.a.13) ity anena, tathā'pi trivṛdvirecanaprayoge pūrvadine viśeṣavidhānāt peyādānaṃ jñeyam| kiñceyam eva tadvacanāt snigdhoṣṇamāṃsarasasādhitā ca kriyamāṇā na pūrvoktasnehavaddravauṣṇamāṃsarasaudanaviruddhā bhavati|12|

lg.l: akṣamātraṃ tayoḥ piṇḍaṃ vinīyāmlena nā pibet||12||
prasannayā triphalayā śṛtayā ca pṛthak pibet||13||

ab.seg: akṣamātram ity ādinā navabhir amlādibhir dravyair navayogān āha| tayor iti śyāmātrivṛdaruṇatrivṛtayoḥ| etayoś ca militayoḥ pratyekaṃ ca prayogā iti prāg eva pratipāditam| amleneti kāñjikena||12-13||

lg.l: trivṛddviguṇasaṃyuktaṃ ‘trivṛttriguṇasaṃyuktaṃ’ iti pā. cūrṇam uṣṇāmbunā pibet||14||

ab.seg: ekaikam ity ādinā saindhavādibhir dvādaśayogān āha| saindhavādayaś ca dvādaśa rogabhiṣagjitīye (vi.a.8) lavaṇaskandhoktā jñeyāḥ| sanāgaram iti nāgarasahitaṃ sat pratyekaṃ saindhavādīnāṃ cūrṇaṃ dviguṇatrivṛtācūrṇayuktaṃ pātavyam||14||

lg.l: saralaḥ kilimaṃ hiṅgu bhārgī tejovatī tathā||15||
mustaṃ haimavatī pathyā citrako rajanī vacā|
svarṇakṣīryajamodā ca śṛṅgaveraṃ ca taiḥ pṛthak||16||

div.ab: pippalīty ādinā pippalyādidravyabhedena mūtre 'ṣṭādaśayogān āha||15-16||-

ab.seg: madhukety ādinaikaḥ prayogaḥ| ayaṃ ca saṅgrahoktayoḥ ‘yaṣṭyāṃ dvau’ ity anayor ekataraḥ||17||

lg.l: kākolīṃ kṣīrakākolīm indrāṃ ‘kṣudrāṃ’ iti, ‘citrāṃ’ iti ca pā. chinnaruhāṃ tathā|
kṣīraśuklāṃ payasyāṃ ca yaṣṭyāhvaṃ vidhinā pibet||19||

div.ab: jīvakety ādinā caturdaśayogān tathā yaṣṭyāhvam ity ekaṃ cāha| ayaṃ ca saṅgrahoktayoḥ ‘yaṣṭyāṃ dvau’ iti dvayor anyataraḥ| kṣīraśuklā kṣīravidārī| indrā kokilākṣaḥ| payasyā arkapuṣpī||18-19||-

lg.l: sarpiṣā vā tayoś cūrṇam abhayārdhāṃśikaṃ pibet|21|

div.ab: kṣīrety ādinā kṣīrādau sapta yogān āha| pīlu auttarapathikaṃ phalam||20||-

lg.l: sādhayed vidhival lehaṃ lihyāt pāṇitalaṃ tataḥ|
sakṣaudrāṃ śarkarāṃ paktvā kuryān mṛdbhājane nave||24||
kṣipec chīte ‘dadyācchīte’ iti pā. trivṛccūrṇaṃ tvakpatramaricaiḥ saha|
mātrayā ‘lihyāttaṃ mātrayā lehaṃ’ iti pā. lehayed etad īśvarāṇāṃ virecanam||25||
kuḍavāṃśān ‘rasān kauḍavikānikṣu...’ iti pā. rasān ikṣudrākṣāpīluparuṣakāt|
taṃ lehaṃ yojayec chītaṃ trivṛccūrṇena śāstravit|
etad utsannapittānām īśvarāṇāṃ ‘etadutkṛṣṭapittānā...’ iti pā. virecanam||27||
pippalīṃ nāgaraṃ kṣāraṃ śyāmāṃ trivṛtayā saha|
lehayen madhunā sārdhaṃ śleṣmalānāṃ ‘ślaiṣmikāṇāṃ’ iti pā. virecanam||29||
subhṛṣṭān svarasāṃs taile sādhayet tatra cāvapet||30||
sahakārāt kapitthāc ca madhyam amlaṃ ca yat phalam|

ab.seg: lihyād vā madhv ity ādinā'ṣṭau lehān āha| lihyād vety ādinā prathamo lehaḥ| ajagandhety ādinā dvitīyaḥ| ajagandhā ajamodā| śyāmātrivṛd ity ādinā tṛtīyo lehaḥ| atra śarkarātrivṛccūrṇābhyāṃ samābhyāṃ kvāthapādikābhyāṃ lehaḥ| sakṣaudrām ity ādinā caturthaḥ| atra kṣaudrapāko yogamahimnā| trivṛccūrṇamātrāpādikatvaṃ tvakpatrādīnāṃ, saugandhamātraprayojanatvāt ‘trivṛccūrṇamatra pādikaṃ, tvakpatrādīni saugandhamātraprayojanatvādalpāni’ iti pā.| īśvarāṇāṃ virecanam iti vacanena sukumāratvād asnigdhaviṣayatām asya darśayati, īśvarā hi prāyeṇa sukumārāḥ snigdhāś ca bhavanti| kuḍavāṃśān ity ādiḥ pañcamaḥ| atra trivṛccūrṇam anirdiṣṭamānaṃ, tac ca prakṣepanyāyāl lehāt pādikaṃ kartavyam| utsannapittānām udbhūtapittānām| śarkarety ādinā sitāyogāṃś caturo 'tideśānuguṇyāl lehānāṃ madhya evāha| atra vartyādayo 'pi śarkarākṛtā eva jñeyāḥ| anena vidhineti ikṣvādirasasaṃskāreṇa trivṛccūrṇayogena ca| pippalīṃ nāgaram ity ādinā ṣaṣṭho lehaḥ| madhyam iti amlakapitthasya madhyaṃ bhāgam| amlaṃ ca yat phalam iti mātuluṅgādi| pūrvavad iti kauḍavikatvaṃ mātuluṅgādirasānāṃ darśayati||21-32||
pānakānīty ādinā'tideśānuguṇyāt pānakādipañcayogān āha| rāgapradhānaḥ ṣāḍavo rāgaṣāḍavaḥ| anena vidhineti pūrvalehoktavidhinā||33||

lg.l: bhṛṅgailābhyāṃ samā nīlī tais trivṛt taiś ca śarkarā|

ab.seg: bhṛṅgailābhyām ity ādinā tarpaṇayogaṃ prathamam evāha, dvitīyas tu tarpaṇayogo bhaviṣyatīti| bhṛṅgaṃ guḍatvak| taiś ca śarkareti bhṛṅgalānīlītrivṛdbhiḥ| phalarasaḥ dāḍimarasaḥ||34-35||
śarkarety ādinā modakaḥ prathamaḥ| tatra ca “modake dviguṇo guḍaḥ” iti vacanāt guḍaśarkarāṃ cūrṇād dviguṇām icchanti||36||

lg.l: trivṛcchāṇā matās tisras tisraś ca triphalātvacaḥ|
lihyāt sarpirmadhubhyāṃ ca modakaṃ vā guḍena tu|
bhakṣayen niṣparīhāram etac chodhanam uttamam ‘... metacchreṣṭhaṃ virecanam’ iti pā.||38||
gulmaṃ plīhodaraṃ śvāsaṃ ‘kāsaṃ’ iti pā. halīmakam arocakam|

ab.seg: trivṛcchāṇā ity ādineha modake ca yady api paṭhyate yogaḥ, tathā'py asya lehenaiva grahaṇād ayam aṣṭamo leho bhavati||37-39||

div.ab:
viḍaṅgapippalīmūlatriphalādhānyacitrakān|
maricendrayavājājīpippalīhastipippalīḥ||40||
lavaṇāny ajamodāṃ ca cūrṇitaṃ kārṣikaṃ pṛthak|
tilatailatrivṛccūrṇabhāgau cāṣṭapalonmitau||41||
dhātrīphalarasaprasthāṃs trīn guḍārdhatulāṃ tathā|
paktvā mṛdvagninā khāded badarodumbaropamān||42||
guḍān kṛtvā na cātra syād vihārāhārayantraṇā|
mandāgnitvaṃ jvaraṃ mūrcchāṃ mūtrakṛcchram arocakam||43||
asvapnaṃ gātraśūlaṃ ca kāsaṃ śvāsaṃ bhramaṃ kṣayam|
kuṣṭhārśaḥkāmalāmehagulmodarabhagandarān||44||
grahaṇīpāṇḍurogāṃś ca hanyuḥ puṃsavanāś ca te|
kalyāṇakā iti khyātāḥ sarveṣv ṛtuṣu yaugikāḥ||45|| iti kalyāṇakaguḍaḥ|46|

ab.seg: viḍaṅgety ādinā dvitīyo modakaḥ||40-45||

lg.l: vyoṣatvakpatramustailāviḍaṅgāmalakābhayāḥ ‘... malakān samān| trivṛto'ṣṭaguṇaṃ bhāgaṃ’ iti pā.|
samabhāgā bhiṣag dadyād dviguṇaṃ ca mukūlakam||46||
bhakṣayet kalyam utthāya śītaṃ cānu pibej jalam|
mūtrakṛcchre jvare vamyāṃ kāse śvāse bhrame kṣaye||48||
yogaḥ sarvaviṣāṇāṃ ca mataḥ śreṣṭho ‘śreṣṭhaṃ virecanam’ iti pā. virecane||49||

div.ab: vyoṣety ādinā tṛtīyo modakaḥ| ayaṃ modakas tantrāntare ‘abhayādya’ iti khyātaḥ| mukūlakaṃ dantī| atra mukūlādīnām ekaikadravyāpekṣayā dvaiguṇyādi bhavati| madhu ca tāvanmātraṃ yāvatā modako bhavati| kecid atra vyoṣādimilitacūrṇād dantyādīnāṃ dvaiguṇyaṃ vadanti||46-49||-

lg.l: daśa tān modakān kuryād īśvarāṇāṃ virecanam|51|

div.ab: pathyety ādinā caturthaḥ||50||-

ab.seg: trivṛd dhaimavatīty ādinā pañcamo modakaḥ pūryate| veṣṭayed iti avacūrṇayet||51-55||

lg.l: kṣaudradrākṣārasopetaṃ ‘samṛdvīkārasakṣaudraṃ’ iti pā. varṣāsv etad virecanam||56||
trivṛtāṃ citrakaṃ pāṭhām ajājīṃ saralaṃ vacām|
svarṇakṣīrīṃ ca hemante piṣṭvā tūṣṇāmbunā pibet||58||
trivṛttrāyantihapuṣāḥ sātalāṃ kaṭurohiṇīm ‘hapuṣāṃ saptalāṃ śyāmāṃ dravantīṃ kaṭurohiṇīm’ iti pā.||59||
svarṇakṣīrīṃ ca sañcūrṇya gomūtre bhāvayet tryaham|
nīlinī triphalā mustaṃ kaṭukā ca sucūrṇitam||61||
pibet sukhatamaṃ ‘pibedetatsarvakālaṃ’ iti pā. hy etad rūkṣāṇām api śasyate||62||
tac cūrṇaṃ śarkarātulyaṃ madyenāmlena vā pibet|

ab.seg: trivṛtāṃ kauṭajam ity ādinā ṣaḍṛtuvihitān yogān rūkṣāṇām api śasyate ity antenāha| sātalā carmakaśā| jaladātyaye śaradi| hemante yady api prabalaśītavāte virecanaṃ niṣiddhaṃ, tathā'pi vyādhiviṣayavihitaṃ virecanam etaj jñeyam| sarvartukayogau anukte ṛtau vasantādau ca jñeyau| trivṛc chyāmety ādiko 'pi sarvartuko yogaḥ| tryūṣaṇam ity ādiś cūrṇayogo dvitīyaḥ||56-64||

lg.l: kṛtvā cūrṇaṃ tu saptāhaṃ bhāvyam āmalakīrase||65||
tad yojyaṃ tarpaṇe yūṣe piśite rāgayuktiṣu|66|

div.ab: trivṛtāṃ triphalām ity ādikas tarpaṇayogaḥ| evaṃ sarvartukayogena samaṃ dvau tarpaṇayogau bhavataḥ||65||-

lg.l: jale tena kaṣāyeṇa ‘niryūheṇa tayoryuktyā’ iti pā. paktvā sarpiḥ piben naraḥ||67||
sādhitaṃ vā payas tābhyāṃ sukhaṃ tena viricyate||68||

ab.seg: tulyāmlam ity ekaṃ ghṛtaṃ, śyāmety ādi dvitīyaṃ, śyāmātrivṛtkaṣāyeṇety ādi tṛtīyam| sādhitaṃ cety ādinā kṣīrayogam ekam āha| ghṛtena kṣīreṇa ca ghṛtena kṣīreṇa vaikena militvā catvāro ghṛtakṣīrair bhavanti||66-68||

lg.l: trivṛnmuṣṭīṃstu sanakhān aṣṭau droṇe 'mbhasaḥ pacet ‘jale droṇe trivṛnmuṣṭīnaṣṭau tu sanakhān pacet’ iti pā.|
pralipte madhunā ‘vidhinā’ iti pā. māsaṃ jātaṃ tan mātrayā pibet||70||
surāṃ vā trivṛtāyogakiṇvāṃ ‘trivṛtākiṇvāṃ pibettatkvāthasaṃyutām’ iti pā. tatkvāthasaṃyutām||71||

ab.seg: trivṛnmuṣṭīn ity ādinā prathamā surā, surāṃ vety ādinā dvitīyā, evaṃ dvau surāyogau bhavataḥ| trivṛdyogayuktaṃ kiṇvaṃ yasyāṃ sā tathā||69-71||

lg.l: āsutaṃ ṣaḍahaṃ palle jātaṃ sauvīrakaṃ pibet||72||
bhṛṣṭān vā satuṣāñ chuddhān ‘kṣuṇṇān’ iti pā. yavāṃs taccūrṇasaṃyutān|
āsutān ambhasā tadvat pibej jātaṃ tuṣodakam||73||

ab.seg: yavair ity ādinā sauvīrakatuṣodake prāha| etau dvau kāñjikayogau| kulmāṣa utsvinnayavapiṣṭakam| palle iti dhānyādirāśau| taccūrṇasaṃyutān iti trivṛccūrṇasaṃyutān| tadvad iti ṣaḍahaṃ palle sthitāna||72-73||
tathety ādinā ṣāḍavādiyogān daśāha| daśa ṣāḍavādayo “badaraṣāḍavarāgalehamodakotkārikātarpaṇaśākamāṃsarasayūṣamadyānāṃ” (ka.a.1) iti granthena madanakalpoktāḥ||74||

bhavataś cātra-
tvakkeśarāmrātakadāḍimailāsitopalāmākṣikamātuluṅgaiḥ|
madyais tathā'mlaiś ca manonukūlair yuktāni deyāni virecanāni||75||

lg.l: śītāmbunā pītavataś ca tasya siñcen mukhaṃ chardivighātahetoḥ|
hṛdyāṃś ca mṛtpuṣpaphalapravālān amlaṃ ca dadyād upajighraṇārtham||76||

ab.seg: samprati daśottaraṃ yogaśatam abhidhāya vāntinirāsārthaṃ kṛtyatrayeṇa samaṃ virecanaprayogān āha- tvakkeśarety ādi||75-76||

tatra ślokāḥ-
eko 'mlādibhir aṣṭau ca daśa dvau saindhavādibhiḥ|
mūtre 'ṣṭādaśa yaṣṭyāṃ ‘yaṣṭyā’ iti pā. dvau jīvakādau caturdaśa||77||

lg.l: kṣīrādau sapta lehe 'ṣṭau catvāraḥ sitayā'pi ca|
catvāraś ca ghṛte kṣīre dvau cūrṇe tarpaṇe tathā|
dvau madye kāñjike dvau ca daśānye ṣāḍavādiṣu||79||

ab.seg: eko 'mlādibhir ity ādisaṅgraho vyaktārthaḥ| yaṣṭyāṃ dvāv iti ‘yaṣṭyāhvaṃ vidhinā’ iti jīvakādāv ekaḥ, madhukety ādinā cāparaḥ||77-80||
ity agniveśakṛte tantre carakapratisaṃskṛte 'prāpte dṛḍhabalasampūrite kalpasthāne śyāmātrivṛtkalpo nāma saptamo 'dhyāyaḥ||7||
iti śrīcakrapāṇidattaviracitāyām āyurvedadīpikāyāṃ carakatātparyaṭīkāyāṃ kalpasthāne śyāmātrivṛtkalpo nāma saptamo 'dhyāyaḥ||7||

div.head: caturaṅgulakalpaḥ

ab.seg: athātaś caturaṅgulakalpaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ||1||
iti ha smāha bhagavān ātreyaḥ||2||
śyāmātrivṛtkalpānantaraṃ mṛduvirecanatvasāmānyāc caturaṅgulakalpo 'bhidhīyate||1-2||
vyavahārārthaṃ paryāyān āha- āragvadha ity ādi||3||

lg.l: bāle vṛddhe kṣate kṣīṇe sukumāre ca mānave|
yojyo ‘deyaḥ’ iti pā. mṛdvanapāyitvād viśeṣāc caturaṅgulaḥ||5||

ab.seg: adhikaṃ pathya iti jvarādiṣu viśeṣeṇa virecanaprayoge hitaḥ||4-5||

lg.l: phalakāle ‘recanārthe pariṇataṃ phalaṃ tasyāharedbudhaḥ’ iti pā. phalaṃ tasya grāhyaṃ pariṇataṃ ca yat|
teṣaṃ guṇavatāṃ bhāraṃ ‘jātaṃ’ iti, ‘sāraṃ’ iti ca pā. sikatāsu nidhāpayet||6||
tato majjānam uddhṛtya śucau bhāṇḍe nidhāpayet||7||

ab.seg: phalakāle iti ucitaphalakāle| teṣām iti phalānām| bhāram iti bhūridravyopalakṣaṇam| majjānam iti phalamajjānam||6-7||

div.ab: drākṣety ādiḥ prathamo yogaḥ| caturvarṣamukhe bāle yāvad dvādaśavārṣike ity anenāsya prayogasya caturvarṣād arvāg ūrdhvaṃ ca dvādaśavarṣād avaśyatayā yaugikatvaṃ niṣedhayati||8||-

lg.l: dadhimaṇḍena vā yuktaṃ ‘samyak’ iti pā. rasenāmalakasya vā|
kṛtvā śītakaṣāyaṃ taṃ ‘vā’ iti pā. pibet sauvīrakeṇa vā||10||

ab.seg: surāmaṇḍeneti dvitīyaḥ| athavā kolasīdhuneti tṛtīyaḥ| kolakṛtaḥ sīdhuḥ kolasīdhuḥ| sauvīrakeṇa vety antena yogatrayam aparaṃ vyaktam||9-10||

lg.l: trivṛto ‘trivṛnmajjñostathā kalkaṃ tatkaṣāyeṇa vā pibet’ iti pā. vā kaṣāyeṇa majjñaḥ kalkaṃ tathā pibet|

ab.seg: trivṛto vā kaṣāyeṇa majjñaḥ kalkaṃ tathā pibed iti saptamaḥ| tathety ādinā'ṣṭamaḥ| etatkalkakaṣāyayor dvayaṃ ‘kaṣāye yogadvayam’ iti pā. jatūkarṇe 'py uktam eva- ‘trivṛdbilvakaṣāyābhyāṃ sakṣaudralavaṇau dvau’ iti| tenātra pāṭhāntaraṃ na pramāṇam| saṅgrahe ca kariṣyati- ‘kaṣāye ca trivṛto bilvakasya ca’ iti||11||

lg.l: sādhayitvā śanair lehaṃ lehayen mātrayā naram||12||

ab.seg: kaṣāyeṇety ādiko leho navamaḥ||12||

lg.l: caturaṅgulasiddhād vā kṣīrād yad udiyād ghṛtam|
majjñaḥ kalkena dhātrīṇāṃ rase tat sādhitaṃ pibet||13||

ab.seg: caturaṅgulety ādinā prathamaṃ ghṛtam| majjña iti caturaṅgulamajjñaḥ||13||

lg.l: tad eva daśamūlasya kulatthānāṃ yavasya ca|
kaṣāye sādhitaṃ sarpiḥ kalkaiḥ śyāmādibhiḥ pibet||14||

ab.seg: tad evety ādinā ca dvitīyaṃ ghṛtam| śyāmādibhir iti madanakalpapaṭhitair navabhiḥ ‘śyāmātrivṛddantī ... ’ (ka.a.1) ity ādibhiḥ||14||

lg.l: dattvā māsārdhamāsastham ariṣṭaṃ pāyayeta ‘pāyayedbhiṣak’ iti pā. ca||15||

ab.seg: dantīty ādinā'riṣṭayogam āha| guḍasya cāñjalim iti sambandhaḥ| māsārdhamāsastham iti sārdhamāsastham||15||

lg.l: yasya yat pānam annaṃ ‘pānamamlaṃ ca’ iti pā. ca hṛdyaṃ svādv atha vā kaṭu|
lavaṇaṃ vā bhavet tena yuktaṃ dadyād virecanam||16||

ab.seg: yasya yad ity ādinā'nuktam aparāparasādhanaṃ vidhatte| hṛdyena hi virecanayogasya priyatā syāt| pānam annaṃ ceti hṛdyam ity ādibhiḥ pratyekaṃ sambadhyate||16||

tatra ślokāḥ
drākṣārase surāsīdhvor dadhni cāmalakīrase|
sauvīrake kaṣāye ca trivṛto bilvakasya ‘sauvīrake'tha trivṛtaḥ kaṣāye tilvakasya ca’ iti, ‘sauvīrake kaṣāyābhyāṃ bilvaśampākayostathā’ iti ca pā. ca||17||

lg.l: lehe 'riṣṭe ghṛte dve ca yogā dvādaśa kīrtitāḥ|

ab.seg: drākṣety ādisaṅgraho vyaktaḥ||17-18||
ity agniveśakṛte tantre carakapratisaṃskṛte 'prāpte dṛḍhabalasampūrite kalpasthāne caturaṅgulakalpo nāmāṣṭamo 'dhyāyaḥ||8||
iti śrīcakrapāṇidattaviracitāyām āyurvedadīpikāyāṃ carakatātparyaṭīkāyāṃ kalpasthāne caturaṅgulakalpo nāmāṣṭamo 'dhyāyaḥ||8||

div.head: tilvakakalpaḥ

ab.seg: athātas tilvakakalpaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ||1||
iti ha smāha bhagavān ātreyaḥ||2||
caturaṅgulavat tilvakasyānapāyitvāc caturaṅgulakalpānantaraṃ tilvakakalpo 'bhidhīyate||1-2||

lg.l: cūrṇayet tu tridhā kṛtvā dvau bhāgau ścotayet tataḥ|
bhāgaṃ taṃ daśamūlasya punaḥ ‘kaṣāye bhāvitaṃ punaḥ’ iti pā. kvāthena bhāvayet|
śuṣkaṃ cūrṇaṃ punaḥ kṛtvā tata ‘snigdhasvinne pradāpayet’ iti pā. ūrdhvaṃ prayojayet||5||

ab.seg: antarvalkalavarjitām iti tilvakasyāntarvalkalaṃ kaṭhinaṃ bhavati, tadarthaṃ tadvarjanam| ścotayed iti vacanena ṣaḍguṇadraveṇaikaviṃśativārān srāvayed iti jñeyaṃ, madanaphalakalpe evambhūtasyaiva srāvaṇasya dṛṣṭatvāt| bhāvanāvidhiś ca nirantaraṃ vyākṛta eva||3-5||
dadhimaṇḍety ādinā pibed ity antena pañca yogāḥ||6||

lg.l: marujān sunuyāt tac ca jātaṃ sauvīrakaṃ yadā||7||
bhaved añjalinā tasya lodhrakalkaṃ pibet sadā|8|

div.ab: meṣaśṛṅgīty ādinā viśiṣṭasauvīrakeṇa yoga ekaḥ| marujā bhṛṣṭayavāḥ||7||-

lg.l: āvapet tat paraṃ pakṣān madyapānāṃ ‘madyapānādvi...’ iti pā. virecanam|10|

div.ab: surām ity ādinā surāyogam āha| dantīty ādinaikam ariṣṭayogam āha| dantīcitrakayor āḍhakaṃ pṛthak saliladroṇe pacet| tilvakacūrṇam āvāpaḥ||8-9||-

lg.l: kampillakakaṣāyeṇa ‘tilvakasya kaṣāyeṇa’ iti pā. daśakṛtvaḥ subhāvitām||10||

div.ab: kampillakety ādinā kampillakayogam āha| kampillakaḥ guṇḍārocanikā| mātrām iti tilvakacūrṇamātrām||10||-

lg.l: lodhracūrṇayutaḥ siddho lehaḥ śreṣṭho ‘śreṣṭhaṃ virecanam’ iti pā. virecane||12||
saghṛtaḥ sādhito lehaḥ sa ca śreṣṭho ‘śreṣṭhaṃ virecanam’ iti pā. virecane||13||

ab.seg: caturaṅgulety ādinā prathamo lehaḥ| caturaṅgulakalpeneti ‘kaṣāyeṇāthavā tasya’ (ka.a.8) ity ādinoktavidhānena| tenātra tilvakakvāthena guḍānvitatrivṛccūrṇaṃ paktvā lehaḥ kartavyaḥ| triphalāyā ity ādinā dvitīyo lehaḥ| tilvakasyety ādinā tṛtīyaḥ||11-13||

lg.l: droṇe 'pāṃ sādhayet pādaśeṣe prasthaṃ ghṛtāt pacet||14||
piṣṭais tair eva bilvāṃśaiḥ samūtralavaṇair atha|
tato mātrāṃ pibet kāle śreṣṭham etad virecanam||15||

ab.seg: aṣṭāṣṭāv ity ādinā prathamaṃ ghṛtam| sanakhān iti vidyamānanakhān| atra trivṛdādigṛhītalodhrasya ‘trivṛtādigṛhīte lodhre lodhrasya pradhānatvāt’ iti pā. pradhānatvād dviguṇo bhāgo bhavati| uktaṃ hi jatūkarṇe- “trivṛdādidviguṇo lodhrakvāthaḥ” iti| samabhāgatve tu lodhraprayogatvasya kena viśeṣaḥ syāt, tasmād yathāvyākhyātam eva sādhu| lavaṇam apy atra palāṃśam eva| lodhrety ādi dvitīyaṃ ghṛtam| caturaṅgulety ādinā ghṛtadvayam atidiśyate| evaṃ ghṛtena catvāro yogā bhavanti| caturaṅgulaghṛte ca “caturaṅgulasiddhāt” (ka.a.8) ity ādinā, tathā “tad eva daśamūlasya” (ka.a.8) ity ādinā prokte jñeye; tathā ca caturaṅgulakalpena lodhrādinā dve lodhraghṛte bhavataḥ||14-16||

tatra ślokau-
pañca dadhyādibhis tv ekā surā sauvīrakeṇa ca|
eko 'riṣṭas tathā yoga ekaḥ kampillakena ca||17||

lg.l: yogās te lodhramūlānāṃ kalpe ṣoḍaśa darśitāḥ||18||

ab.seg: pañca dadhyādibhir ity ādisaṅgraho vyaktaḥ||17-18||
ity agniveśakṛte tantre carakapratisaṃskṛte 'prāpte dṛḍhabalasampūrite kalpasthāne tilvakakalpo nāma navamo 'dhyāyaḥ||9||
iti śrīcakrapāṇidattaviracitāyām āyurvedadīpikāyāṃ carakatātparyaṭīkāyāṃ kalpasthāne tilvakakalpo nāma navamo 'dhyāyaḥ||9||

div.head: sudhākalpaḥ

ab.seg: athātaḥ sudhākalpaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ||1||
iti ha smāha bhagavān ātreyaḥ||2||

ṣoḍaśasaṅkhyaprayogābhidhāyakatilvakakalpānantaraṃ yathākramam adhikasaṅkhyāprayogābhidhānakramād viṃśatiyogābhidhāyakasudhākalpo 'bhidhīyate; itaś cānantaram atiriktasaṅkhyābhidhānakrameṇaiva ūnacatvāriṃśatprayogābhidhāyakasaptalāśaṅkhinīkalpo 'bhidhāsyate||1-2||

lg.l: saṅghātaṃ hi bhinatty āśu doṣāṇāṃ kaṣṭavibhramā||3||
tasmān naiṣā mṛdau koṣṭhe prayoktavyā kadācana|
na doṣanicaye cālpe sati mārgaparikrame ‘cānyaparikrame’ iti pā.||4||

ab.seg: virecanānām iti virecanadravyāṇām| kaṣṭavibhrameti duḥkhasādhyavibhramajanikā| tasmād iti atitīkṣṇatvāt kaṣṭavibhramatvāc ca| sati mārgaparikrama iti upakramamārgāntare sati na sudhā prayoktavyā, tena gatyantarāsambhava eva sudhā prayoktavyety arthaḥ||3-4||

lg.l: rogair evaṃvidhair grastaṃ jñātvā saprāṇam āturam|
prayojayen mahāvṛkṣaṃ samyak sa hy avacāritaḥ||6||
sadyo harati ‘nudati’ iti pā. doṣāṇāṃ mahāntam api sañcayam|7|

div.ab: pāṇḍurogety ādau madhumehaśabdena pramehā evocyante; viśiṣṭas tu vātikamadhumeho 'sādhya eva, tena taṃ prati virecanopadeśo 'narthaka eva syāt; madhumehaśabdaś ca yathā pramohamātra eva vartate tat pratipāditam eva pramehacikitsite| doṣavṛddhyā vibhrāntaṃ ceto yasmin tasmin doṣavibhrāntacetasi unmāde| saprāṇam iti balavantam||5-6||-

lg.l: dvividhaḥ sa mato 'lpaiś ca bahubhiś caiva kaṇṭakaiḥ||7||
sa nāmnā snugguḍā nandā sudhā nistriṃśapatrakaḥ||8||
tau ‘taṃ’ iti pā. vipāṭyāharet kṣīraṃ śastreṇa matimān bhiṣak|
dvivarṣaṃ vā trivarṣaṃ vā śiśirānte viśeṣataḥ||9||

ab.seg: pravaro bahukaṇṭaka iti anatitīkṣṇatayā'lpakaṇṭakamahāvṛkṣataḥ śreṣṭha ity arthaḥ| tāv iti svalpakaṇṭakabahukaṇṭakau mahāvṛkṣau| yady api madanakalpe “śaradi tvakkandakṣīrāṇi” (ka.a.1) ity uktaṃ, tathā'pi sudhāyā ‘sudhāṃ prāpya’ iti pā. atra śiśirānte kṣīragrahaṇam apavādarūpaṃ jñeyam| śiśirasya śeṣā divasāḥ śiśirāntāḥ||7-9||

lg.l: tataḥ ‘kolapramāṇāṃ guṭikāṃ pibet sauvīrakeṇa tām’ iti pā. kolasamāṃ mātrāṃ pibet sauvīrakeṇa vā|

div.ab: bilvādīnām iti bilvādipañcamūlasya| aṅgāreṣu śoṣayed iti aṅgāroparisthitapātrasthaṃ tat sudhākṣīraṃ bilvādīnām anyatamasya kaṣāyeṇa samānaṃ śoṣaṇena kaṭhinaṃ kuryāt; tataḥ kolamātrā guṭikāḥ kāryāḥ, tataḥ sauvīrakādīnām anyatamena pātavyā| evaṃ sauvīrakādibhedāt sapta yogā bhavanti; tathā'tra bilvādikaṣāyasya bhedena bhedo na vivakṣitaḥ||10-11||-

lg.l: sātalāṃ kāñcanakṣīrīṃ śyāmādīni kaṭutrikam ‘phalatrikam’ iti pā.||12||

ab.seg: sātalām ity ādinā vātasādhanaghṛtamāṃsarasabhedād yogadvayam āha| sātalā carmakaśā| śyāmādigrahaṇenaiva sātalāyām api labdhāyāṃ pṛthak sātalābhidhānam ekayā'pi sātalayā kṛtasudhāyogasya prādhānyakhyāpanārtham||12-13||

lg.l: tryūṣaṇaṃ triphalāṃ dantīṃ citrakaṃ trivṛtāṃ tathā|

ab.seg: tryūṣaṇam ity ādinā pānakayogam āha| guḍapānakam iti guḍasaṃskṛtapānakam||14||

lg.l: gomūtre rajanīṃ kṛtvā ‘niśi sthitaṃ gavāṃ mūtre’ iti pā. śoṣayed ātape tataḥ||15||
saptāhaṃ bhāvayec chuṣkaṃ tatas tenāpi bhāvitam||16||
gandhamālyaṃ tad āghrāya ‘samāghrāya’ iti pā. prāvṛtya paṭam eva ca|

ab.seg: trivṛtety ādinā ghreyayogam āha| gomūtre rajanīṃ kṛtveti rajanīṃ vyāpya gomūtre sthāpayitvā| paṭam eveti yathoktavidhibhāvitaṃ paṭam āvṛtyety arthaḥ||15-17||

lg.l: lehaṃ paktvā ‘kṛtvā’ iti pā. virekārthaṃ lehayen mātrayā naram||18||

ab.seg: śyāmety ādinā lehayogam āha| mātrayeti anapāyimātrayā||18||

lg.l: pāyayet tu sudhākṣīraṃ yūṣair māṃsarasair ghṛtaiḥ|19|

div.ab: pāyayed ity ādinā pṛthag yūṣamāṃsarasaghṛtair yogatrayam āha|19|

lg.l: bhāvitāñ chuṣkamatsyān vā māṃsaṃ vā bhakṣayen naraḥ||19||

ab.seg: bhāvitān ity ādinā śuṣkamatsyamāṃsayogāv āha||19||

lg.l: surāṃ vā kārayet kṣīre ghṛtaṃ vā pūrvavat pacet||20||

ab.seg: kṣīreṇety ādinā ekaṃ ghṛtam| ghṛtaṃ vety ādinā ekaṃ vakṣyati| āmalakaiś caturaṅgulavad iti vacanād āmalakarasayuktaṃ yac caturaṅgulakalpe “caturaṅgulasiddhād vā” (ka.a.8) ity ādinoktaṃ tasya vidhānam atidiśati| surāṃ vā kārayet kṣīre iti snukkṣīrabhāvitam ity ādividhinā surāṃ kuryāt| ghṛtaṃ vā pūrvavat paced ity atra pūrvavad ity anena tilvakakalpe pūrvaṃ yat “lodhrakalkena” (ka.a.9) ity ādigranthavihitaṃ, tadvidhir eva pratyāsannatvād atidiśyate||20||

tatra ślokau-
sauvīrakādibhiḥ sapta sarpiṣā ca rasena ca|
pānakaṃ ghreyalehau ca yogā yūṣādibhis trayaḥ||21||

lg.l: dvau śuṣkamatsyamāṃsābhyāṃ suraikā dve ca sarpiṣī|

ab.seg: sauvīrakety ādiḥ saṅgraho vyākṛta eva||21-22||
ity agniveśakṛte tantre carakapratisaṃskṛte 'prāpte dṛḍhabalasampūrite kalpasthāne sudhākalpo nāma daśamo 'dhyāyaḥ||10||
iti śrīcakrapāṇidattaviracitāyām āyurvedadīpikāyāṃ carakatātparyaṭīkāyāṃ kalpasthāne sudhākalpo nāma daśamo 'dhyāyaḥ||10||
athātaḥ saptalāśaṅkhinīkalpaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ||1||
iti ha smāha bhagavān ātreyaḥ||2||

lg.l: saptalā carmasāhvā ca bahuphenarasā ca sā|
śaṅkhinī tiktalā caiva ‘tiktakā jñeyā’ iti, ‘tiktanālā ca’ iti ca pā. yavatiktā'kṣi(kṣa)pīḍakaḥ||3||

ab.seg: pūrvādhyāyoktasambandhād eva saptalāśaṅkhinīkalpo 'bhidhīyate| iha cādhyāye ye yogā abhidhīyante te saptalayā vā śaṅkhinyā vā ubhābhyāṃ vā sampādyante śyāmātrivṛdyogavat||1-3||

lg.l: saptalāyāś ca mūlāni gṛhītvā bhājane kṣipet||5||

ab.seg: te gulmety ādi| te saptalāśaṅkhinyau||4-5||

lg.l: hṛdroge kaphavātotthe ‘hṛdrogakaphavātārte’ iti pā. gulme caiva prayojayet||6||
sīdhau cāpy eṣa kalpaḥ syāt sukhaṃ śīghravirecanaḥ||8||

ab.seg: akṣamātram ity ādinā kalkasya prasannālavaṇayuktasya priyālādikaṣāyeṣu ṣoḍaśayogā bhavanti| atra yady api maireyaikṣavau na kaṣāyau tathā'pi bahukaṣāyāntargatatvāt kaṣāyāv eva vaktavyau, saṅgrahe ‘kaṣāyā daśa ṣaṭ’ ity anena vyapadiṣṭau| kaṣāyaśabdena kalkakaṣāyo 'bhipretaḥ| karkandhūkolabadaraśabdena triprakārabadaragrahaṇam||6-8||

lg.l: dadhimaṇḍena sannīya siddhaṃ tat pāyayeta ca|
śaṅkhinīcūrṇabhāgau dvau tilacūrṇasya ‘nīlīcūrṇasya cāparaḥ’ iti pā. cāparaḥ||10||

ab.seg: tailam ity ādinā prathamas tailayogaḥ| trivṛcchyāmārdhabhāgike iti saptalāśaṅkhinīkalkayor ardhabhāgena trivṛcchyāmākalko deyaḥ| śaṅkhinīty ādinā pañcatailayogān āha, evaṃ ṣaṭtailayogā bhavanti| tailaṃ tatpīḍitam iti śaṅkhinīcūrṇaṃ tilacūrṇaṃ ca harītakīkaṣāyeṇa sandhāya ‘sannīya’ iti pā. pīḍitaṃ tat tailaṃ pibed iti| atasyādiṣv eṣa saṃvidhir iti vacanena tilasthāne 'tasyādīnāṃ prayogaṃ vidhatte||9-11||

lg.l: kṣīreṇāloḍya sampakvaṃ ‘vipacet’ iti pā. pibet tac ca virecanam|
kṣīriṇyā nīlikāyāś ca ‘syāt kṣīriṇīnīlikayoḥ’ iti pā. tathaiva ca karañjayoḥ|
śaṅkhinīsaptalādhātrīkaṣāye sādhayed ghṛtam ‘cāparaṃ smṛtam’ iti pā.||15||
trivṛtkalpena sarpiś ca trayo lehāś ca lodhravat ‘pūrvavat’ iti pā.|
surākampillayor yogaḥ kāryo lodhravad eva ca||16||

ab.seg: śaṅkhinīsaptalety ādi prathamaṃ ghṛtam| dantīdravantyor ity ādinā dvidvidravyakalkena saptalāśaṅkhinīkalkārdhena pūrvaghṛtavatpākāc ca pañcaghṛtayogā apare| dravantī dantībhedaḥ| ajaśṛṅgī viṣāṇikā| kṣīriṇī dugdhikā| masūravidalā śyāmalatā| pratyakparṇī mūṣikaparṇī| dvivargārdhāṃśakalkeneti dantyādidvivargaśaṅkhinīsaptalārdhabhāgikena kalkena| śaṅkhinīty ādinā saptamaṃ ghṛtaṃ, trivṛtkalkenety ādy aṣṭamaṃ ghṛtam| atra tv adhikṛtatvāt saptalāśaṅkhinyor dviguṇaḥ kaṣāyo vidhīyate| lodhravad iti lodhrakalpavat; lodhrakalpe yathā trayo lehāḥ “caturaṅgulakalpena” (ka.a.9) ity ādinoktāḥ, tena lodhrasthāne saptalāśaṅkhinīyogaḥ kartavyaḥ| tathā surāyogaḥ kampillayogaś ca lodhravad iti atrāpi lodhrasthāne saptalāśaṅkhinīprakṣepaḥ kartavyaḥ||12-16||

lg.l: ajagandhājaśṛṅgyośca tadvat ‘kārye syātāṃ’ iti pā. syātāṃ virecane||17||

ab.seg: dantīdravantyor ity ādinā sandhānacatuṣṭayam āha| etat sandhānacatuṣṭayaṃ pūrvasurāyogena samaṃ ‘pañca madye” iti vacanena saṅgrahagṛhītaṃ; sauvīrakādīnāṃ ca madyaśabdenābhidhānam ihāsūtatvasāmānyāj jñeyam| dantīdravantyoḥ kalpeneti anāgatāvekṣaṇena dantīdravantīkalpe sauvīrakatuṣodake ye vaktavye tadvidhānam ihāpy atidiśati| tatra “ajagandhākaṣāyeṇa sauvīrakatuṣodake” (ka.a.12) iti vaktavyaṃ, tenehāpy ajagandhākaṣāyayuktasaptalāśaṅkhinyoḥ sauvīrakatuṣodake kartavye| atra “tathā dantīdravantyoś ca kaṣāye sājagandhayoḥ| gauḍaḥ kāryo 'jaśṛṅgyā ca sa vai sukhavirecanaḥ” (ka.a.12) ity anenoktasya gauḍāriṣṭasya dantīdravantīkalpoktasya vidhānam atidiśati||17||

tatra ślokau-
kaṣāyā daśa ṣaṭ caiva ṣaṭ taile 'ṣṭau ca sarpiṣi|
pañca madye trayo lehā yogaḥ kampillake tathā||18||

lg.l: yogāḥ siddhāḥ samastābhyām ekaśo 'pi ca te hitāḥ||19||

ab.seg: kaṣāyā ity ādisaṅgraho vyākṛtaḥ||18-19||
ity agniveśakṛte tantre carakapratisaṃskṛte 'prāpte dṛḍhabalasampūrite kalpasthāne saptalāśaṅkhinīkalpo nāmaikādaśo 'dhyāyaḥ||11||
iti śrīcakrapāṇidattaviracitāyām āyurvedadīpikāyāṃ carakatātparyaṭīkāyāṃ kalpasthāne saptalāśaṅkhinīkalpo nāmaikādaśo 'dhyāyaḥ||11||

div.head: dantīdravantīkalpaḥ

ab.seg: athāto dantīdravantīkalpaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ||1||
iti ha smāha bhagavān ātreyaḥ||2||
pāriśeṣyāt dantīdravantīkalpo 'bhidhīyate||1-2||

div.ab:
danty udumbaraparṇī syān nikumbho 'tha mukūlakaḥ|
dravantī nāmataś citrā nyagrodhī mūṣikāhvayā||3||
(tathā mūṣikaparṇī cāpy upacitrā ca śambarī| pratyakśreṇī sutaśreṇī dantī ra(ca)ṇḍā ca kīrtitā ayaṃ ślokaḥ kvacitpustake na paṭhyate )|

ab.seg: tayoḥ paryāyān āha- dantīty ādi||3||

lg.l: tayor mūlāni saṅgṛhya sthirāṇi bahalāni ca|

ab.seg: sthirāṇīti sārabhūtāni| bahalānīti ghanatvakkāni| hastidantaprakārāṇīti antapūrvopacitāni| śyāvatāmrāṇīti yathākrameṇa dantyāḥ śyāvāni, dravantyās tāmrāṇi||4||

lg.l: śoṣayed ātape 'gnyarkau ‘śoṣayedātape'rkāgnī’ iti pā. hato hy eṣāṃ vikāśitām||5||

ab.seg: svedayen mṛtkuśāntara iti pippalīmadhukakalkābhyāṃ parilipya kuśaiḥ pariveṣṭya tato mṛdāvaliptāni svedayet| agnisvedātapaśoṣaṇaphalam āha- agnyarkau hato hy eṣāṃ vikāśitām iti|- eṣāṃ dantīdravantīmūlānāṃ vikāśitālakṣaṇaṃ guṇaṃ svedopaśoṣaṇābhyām agnyarkau hataḥ; tena nātidoṣāṇi dantīdravantīmūlāni syur iti bhāvaḥ||5||

lg.l: vilāyayanti doṣau dvau mārutaṃ kopayanti ca||6||

ab.seg: tīkṣṇoṣṇānīty ādinā teṣāṃ guṇakathanam| doṣau dvāv iti pittaśleṣmāṇau||6||

lg.l: pibed gulmodarī doṣair abhikhinnaś ca ‘doṣairabhiṣyaṇṇaśca’ iti pā. yo naraḥ|
kakṣyālajīvisarpeṣu ‘visarpālajikakṣyāsu’ iti pā. dāhe ca vipaced ghṛtam||9||
tailaṃ mehe ca gulme ca sodāvarte kaphānile|
lehaḥ siddho virekārthe dāhasantāpamehanut ‘deyaḥ santāpamehanut’ iti pā.||11||
vātatarṣe jvare paitte syāt sa evājagandhayā|
trīṃs tu tasya kaṣāyasya bhāgau dvau phāṇitasya ca|
tapte sarpiṣi taile vā bharjayet tatra cāvapet||13||
kalkaṃ dantīdravantyoś ca śyāmādīnāṃ ca bhāgaśaḥ|
tatsiddhaṃ prāśayel lehaṃ sukhaṃ tena viricyate||14||

ab.seg: dadhīty ādinā saptabhir dravyaiḥ saptaprayogān āha| śīdhuśabdaḥ priyālādibhiś caturbhiḥ pṛthak sambadhyate| abhikhinna iti ākrāntaḥ| gomṛgājarasair ity atrāpi ‘piṇḍam akṣasamaṃ tayoḥ’ ity anuvartate| atrāpi gavādirasais tribhis trayaḥ prayogā bhavanti| tayor ity ādinā trīn snehayogān āha| anayoḥ kalkakaṣāyeṇa daśamūlarasatulyabhāgena ghṛtaṃ paced visarpādiṣu, tailaṃ tu pūrvavan mehādiṣu, catuḥ snehaṃ tu śakṛcchukravātasaṅgādiṣu| rase ity ādinā eko lehaḥ| vātatarṣe ity ādinā dvitīyaḥ| sa evājagandhayety anena pūrvoktalehe evājaśṛṅgīsthāne 'jagandhādānaṃ viśiṣṭaṃ khyāpayati| dantīty ādinā tṛtīyo lehaḥ| bhāgaśa iti pratyekabhāgagrahaṇena| evam etadantaiḥ prayogair ādyaḥ ṣoḍaśako bhavet||7-14||

lg.l: rase ca daśamūlasya tathā baibhītake rase|
harītakīrase caiva lehān evaṃ pacet pṛthak ‘bhiṣak’ iti pā.||15||
asṛṣṭe viśi vātotthe gulme cāmlayutaṃ śubham||16||
svedayitvā tataḥ ‘naraḥ’ iti pā. khādet sukhaṃ tena viricyate||17||
mūlaṃ dantīdravantyoś ca saha mudgair vipācayet|
lāvavartīrakādyaiś ca ‘lāvatittirikābhyāṃ ca’ iti pā. te rasāḥ syur virecane||18||
tayor vā'pi kaṣāyeṇa yavāgūṃ jāṅgalaṃ rasam|
māṣayūṣaṃ ‘māṃsaṃ yūṣāṃśca’ iti pā. ca saṃskṛtya dadyāt taiś ca viricyate||19||

ab.seg: rase cetyādai evam ity anena pūrvoktalehatrayam atidiśati| tayor ity ādikaś caturthaḥ; tayor iti dantīdravantīmūlayoḥ| asṛṣṭe iti vibaddhe| pāṭayitvety ādinā pañcamaḥ| kalkenālipya cāntareti dantīdravantīkalkena pāṭitekṣukāṇḍamadhye ālipya| mūlaṃ dantīty ādinā'ṣṭau kṛtākṛtarasān āha| atra lāvavartīrakādayaḥ “lāvo vartīrakaś caiva vārtīkaḥ sakapiñjalaḥ| cakoraś copacakraś ca kakubho raktacarmakaḥ” (sū.a.27) iti granthenāṣṭāv uktāḥ; teṣāṃ pratyekayogād aṣṭau rasā bhavanti| tayor vā'pīty ādinā yavāgūjāṅgalarasayogaṃ māṣayūṣayogaṃ cāha| evam etair dravaiḥ pūrvayogaiś ca militvā dvitīyaḥ ṣoḍaśako bhavet||15-19||

lg.l: tatkaṣāyāt trayo bhāgā dvau sitāyās tathaiva ca|
eko godhūmacūrṇānāṃ kāryā ‘kāryaiṣotkārikā’ iti pā. cotkārikā śubhā||20||
modako vā'sya kalpena ‘kalkena’ iti pā. kāryas tac ca virecanam|
dantīkvāthena cāloḍya ‘dantīkaṣāyairlulitān’ iti pā. dantītailena sādhitān|
nāgaraṃ hemadugdhāṃ ca citrakaṃ ceti cūrṇitam||23||
saptāhaṃ bhāvayen mūtre gavāṃ pāṇitalaṃ tataḥ|
pibet ghṛtena jīrṇe ‘cūrṇa’ iti pā. tu viriktaś cāpi tarpaṇam||24||
gaṇḍamālāsu vāte ‘gaṇḍamālāsravāte ca’ iti pā. ca pāṇḍuroge ca śasyate||26||
palaṃ citrakadantyoś ca harītakyāś ca viṃśatiḥ|
vinīya modakān kuryād daśaikaṃ bhakṣayet tataḥ|
uṣṇāmbu ca pibec cānu ‘pibeccheṣān’ iti pā. daśame daśame 'hni ca||28||
virecanaṃ mukhyatamaṃ ‘etadvirecanaṃ mukhyaṃ’ iti pā. kāmalāharam uttamam||31||
gauḍaḥ kāryo''jaśṛṅgyā vā sa ‘rase’ iti pā. vai sukhavirecanaḥ||33||
surākampillake yogau lodhravac ca tayoḥ smṛtau||35||

ab.seg: tatkaṣāyād ity ādinā utkārikāyogaṃ modakayogaṃ cāha| tatkaṣāyād iti dantīdravantīkaṣāyāt| modakakaraṇe 'pi tatkaṣāyāt trayo bhāgā ity ādividhānam anuvartate| tayoś cāpi kaṣāyeṇa madyānīti tṛtīyaḥ| dantīty ādinā bhakṣyayogaś caturthaḥ| dantīṃ dravantīṃ maricam ity ādikaḥ pañcamaḥ| hemadugdhā svarṇakṣīrī| cūrṇitam ity antaṃ pibed iti sambandhaḥ| palam ity ādikaḥ ṣaṣṭhaḥ| harītakyāś ca viṃśatir iti ākṛtimānena| ayaṃ yogas tantrāntare “agastyamodaka” iti khyātaḥ| dantīdvipalety ādikaḥ saptamaḥ| atra dantīdvipaladrākṣārdhaprasthayoḥ kvāthaḥ kartavyaḥ| dantīkalkam ity ādiko 'ṣṭamaḥ| śyāmety ādiko navamaḥ| gauḍa iti guḍaprakṛtikaḥ| lipte ity atra ‘ghaṭe’ iti śeṣaḥ| tathā dantīdravantyoś cety ādiko daśamaḥ| tathety anena pūrvayogoktapippalyādighaṭāvalepa atidiśyate| ajaśṛṅgyā vety ādika ekādaśaḥ| tathā ajaśṛṅgyā dantīdravantyoś ca kaṣāye gauḍo 'riṣṭaḥ kārya iti sambandhaḥ| taccūrṇety ādiko dvādaśaḥ| atra tayor dantīdravantyoś cūrṇakvāthābhyāṃ tathā māṣāmbunā kiṇvakaraṇapūrvakaṃ yā surā kṛtā tatsurodbhavā madirā kartavyeti vākyārthaḥ| ajagandhety ādinā yogadvayam āha| tatrājagandhākaṣāyeṇa dantīdravantībhyāṃ sauvīrakatuṣodake kartavye| surety ādinā'paraṃ yogadvayam āha| lodhravac ca tayor iti yathā lodhrakalpeṣu “surā lodhrakaṣāyeṇa” ity ādinā surā proktā, tathā “kampillakakaṣāyeṇa” (ka.a.9) ity ādinā kampillakayoga uktaḥ, tathā tayor api dantīdravantyor lodhrasthāne prakṣepāt surāyogaḥ sauvīrakatuṣodakavidhānenaiva kartavyaḥ| iti tṛtīyaḥ ṣoḍaśakaḥ||20-35||

tatra ślokāḥ-
(dadhyādiṣu trayaḥ pañca priyālādyais trayo rase|
sneheṣu vai trayo lehyāḥ ṣaṭ cūrṇe tv eka eva ca||36||

lg.l: ikṣāv ekas tathā mudgamāṃsānāṃ ca rasāstrayaḥ|
ekaś ca modake madye caikas tatkvāthatailake|
cūrṇamekaṃ punaś caiko modakaḥ pañca cāsave||38||
ekaḥ sauvīrake 'thaiko yogaḥ syāt tu tuṣodake|
ekā suraikaḥ kampille tathā pañca ghṛte smṛtāḥ etacchlokacatuṣṭayaṃ hastalikhitapustake na paṭhyate )||39||

ab.seg: dantīty ādy adhyāyārthasaṅgraho vyakta ‘vyāhṛta eva’ iti pā. eva| bhaktidoṣāmayān prati uktānāṃ nānāvidhānāṃ yogānāṃ trayaḥ ṣoḍaśakāḥ proktā iti yojanā| bhaktiḥ icchā||36-40||

lg.l: dve śate navakāḥ pañca yogānāṃ tu virecane||41||
prādhānyataḥ samāśritya dravyāṇi daśa pañca ca||42||

ab.seg: samprati kalpasthānārthasaṅgraham āha- triśatam ity ādinā| triśataṃ pañcapañcāśad iti pañcapañcāśadyogādhikaṃ triśatam| prādhānyataḥ samāśrityeti prādhānyena madanaphalādīni dravantīparyantāni pañcadaśadravyāṇi yogavyapadeśatayā''śritya||41-42||

bhavanti cātra-
yad dhi yena pradhānena dravyaṃ samupasṛjyate|
tatsañjñakaḥ sa yogo vai bhavatīti viniścayaḥ ‘saṃyogo bhavatīti viniścitam’ iti pā.||43||

lg.l: te hi tāny anuvartante manujendram ivetare||44||

ab.seg: athātra vamanādiyogeṣu dravyāntarāṇāṃ surādīnām api vidyamānatvāt kathaṃ madanaphalādyāśrayavattvenaivāmī ‘madanaphalādīnāmavayavattvenaivāmī’ iti pā. yogā vyapadiśyanta ity āha- yad dhīty ādi| yady api madanādibhiḥ surādibhiś ca militvaivāmī yogāḥ kriyante, tathā'pi phalādīnāṃ prādhānyāt phalādīnāṃ yogā ete iti vyapadeśo bhavati, na surādiyogā iti| guṇabhūtā iti apradhānabhūtāḥ ‘apradhānībhūtāḥ’ iti pā.| surādīnām aprādhānya eva hetum āha- te hi tāny anuvartanta iti; surādayo hi madanādīni vamanavirecanaprakārakāryānuguṇatayā'pratīghātena cānuvartante||43-44||

lg.l: adhikaṃ tulyavīrye hi kriyāsāmarthyam iṣyate ‘samānavīrye tvadhikaṃ kriyāsāmānyamiṣyate’ iti pā.||45||

ab.seg: nanu ye tāvad anuguṇā madanādīnāṃ te guṇabhūtā bhavantu, viparītā ye dantyā ugratāyā māṃsarasādayaḥ, tathā elādayo hṛdyatayā vamanapratikūlā madanādīnāṃ te kathaṃ guṇabhūtā ity āha- viruddhavīryam apy eṣāṃ pradhānānām abādhakam iti| viruddhavīryam apīti virecanarūpakāryāprabādhakatayā guṇabhūtam ity arthaḥ| yadi hi viruddhavīryaṃ guṇabhūtaṃ na syāt tadā madanādīnāṃ kāryaṃ pratihanyāt; viruddhasyāpi ca kāryāpratīghāto 'vaśyam abādhakatvam eveti bhāvaḥ| viparītasya kāryābādhanarūpaṃ sāhāyyam abhidhāya ‘mahārthatvamabhidhāya’ iti pā. tulyavīryasya kāryam āha- adhikam ity ādi| tulyavīrye saṃyukte sati kriyāsāmarthyam adhikaṃ bhavatīty arthaḥ||45||

atha tulyavīryaṃ tāvat kriyāsāmarthyādhikyakārakaṃ ‘kriyāsāmānyādhikyakārakaṃ’ iti pā., tena tatsaṃyogo 'stu, viruddhavīryasaṃyogās tu kimarthaṃ kriyanta ity āha- iṣṭety ādi| iṣṭavarṇatvādisampattyartham; ato madanaphalāder viruddhavīryāṇāṃ prayogas tathā ‘yogaḥ’ iti pā. viruddhāmayaṃ ca prati viruddhavīryāṇāṃ prayogo ‘yogaḥ’ iti pā. vamanavirecanahartavyāmayaviśeṣe yaugika ity arthaḥ||46||

lg.l: subhāvitaṃ hy alpam api dravyaṃ syād bahukarmakṛt||47||
svarasais tulyavīryair vā tasmād dravyāṇi bhāvayet|48|

div.ab: atha madanaphalādīnāṃ vīryotkarṣādike vidhim āha- bhūyaś caiṣām ity ādi| tulyavīryair veti tulyavīryaiḥ svarasaiḥ kvāthair vā||47||-

tulyātulyavīryasaṃyogādikāryam āha- alpasyāpīty ādi| tatrālpamātrasya samānavīryasaṃyogān mahārthatvaṃ bhavati, tathā viruddhavīryasaṃyogāt prabhūtamātrasyāpy alpakarmatā kartavyā| iyaṃ cālpakarmakatā prabhūtabheṣajasya dīptikāraṇakoṣṭhavyāptyādiprayojanāt kriyate, tena na niṣprayojanā| viśleṣād apy alpasya mahārthatvaṃ viruddhavīryaviśleṣād boddhavyaṃ; samādhikaviśleṣāt tu prabhūtasyālpakarmatā jñeyā| evaṃ saṃskārād api samānāsamānaguṇān mahārthatvam alpakarmatā vā yuktā| alpasyāpi mahārthatvaṃ yathā snigdhe 'lpamātram api śodhanaṃ bahudoṣaharaṇāya bhavati, tadviparyayeṇa prabhūtasyālpakarmatā udāharaṇīyā||48||-

lg.l: bahudravyavikalpatvād yogasaṅkhyā ‘... ddravyasaṅkhyā’ iti pā. na vidyate||50||

ab.seg: samprati, uktaprayogaṣaṭśatabījenānuktaprayogakalpanaṃ darśayann āha- pradeśety ādi| pradeśa ekadeśaḥ| atha kasmān niḥśeṣeṇa naiva yogā abhidhīyanta ity āha- bahudravyety ādi| asaṅkhyatvān niḥśeṣānabhidhānam iti bhāvaḥ||49-50||

lg.l: sukhaṃ kṣipraṃ mahāvegam asaktaṃ yat pravartate||51||
nātiglānikaraṃ pāyau hṛdaye na ca rukkaram|
virecanaṃ nirūho vā tat tīkṣṇam iti nirdiśet|53|

div.ab: atha vamanavirecanānāṃ tadupodghātāc ca nirūhāṇāṃ tīkṣṇamadhyamṛdutāyā lakṣaṇaṃ kāraṇaṃ cāha- tīkṣṇety ādi| sukham iti duḥkham akurvan| asaktam iti apratibaddham| nātiglānikaraṃ pāyāv iti virecanasya nirūhasya ca, hṛdaye na ca rukkaram iti tu vamanasya lakṣaṇaṃ jñeyam| akṣiṇvann iti apīḍayan| virecanam iti vamanaṃ virecanaṃ ca; uktaṃ hi- ubhayaṃ hi śarīradoṣamalavirecanād virecanaśabdaṃ labhate (ka.a.1) iti||51-52||-

lg.l: kiñcid ebhir guṇair hīnaṃ pūrvoktair mātrayā tathā|
snigdhasvinnasya vā samyaṅ madhyaṃ bhavati bheṣajam||55||

ab.seg: jalāgnīty ādinā tīkṣṇatve kāraṇam āha| deśakālaguṇānvitam iti anuguṇadeśakālaprāptyotkṛṣṭaguṇavat| snehasvedopapannasyeti susnigdhasvinnasya| kiñcid ity ādinā madhyasya vamanādeḥ kāraṇalakṣaṇe āha| ebhir guṇair ity anena kṣipratvādi jalāgnikīṭāspṛṣṭhatvādi ca pratyavamṛṣyate| mandavīryam ity ādinā mṛdūnāṃ lakṣaṇaṃ kāraṇaṃ cāha| mandavegavad iti lakṣaṇaṃ, śeṣaṃ tu kāraṇam||53-56||

tīkṣṇādiśuddhiviṣayāvacāraṇārtham āha- akṛtsnety ādi| te madhyālpaśuddhī balīyasāṃ puruṣāṇāṃ kṛtsnadoṣaṃ yasmān na nirharataḥ, tasmād aśuddhī| akṛtsnadoṣaharaṇād iti hetuvarṇanena yadā balīyaso 'lpadoṣatayā kṛtsnadoṣaharaṇakārike madhyālpaśuddhī bhavataḥ, tadā samyakśuddhī eva te iti sūcayati| madhyety ādi madhyabale madhyā, avarabale tu mṛdvī śuddhiḥ prayojyeti vākyārthaḥ| tatra prayojyabhāṣayā asamyakśuddhī api balāpekṣayā kartavye, madhyāvarau prati tayoḥ samyakśuddhikartṛtvaṃ bhavatīti darśayati||57||

lg.l: tīkṣṇādīni balāvekṣī ‘bhiṣak teṣu balāpekṣī prayojayet’ iti pā. bheṣajāny eṣu yojayet||58||

ab.seg: vyādhitīkṣṇatvādivibhāgena viśuddhau tīkṣṇatvādividhānam āha- tīkṣṇo madhya ity ādi| sarvamadhyālpalakṣaṇa iti yathāsaṅkhyaṃ tīkṣṇādivyādhilakṣaṇaṃ; sarvalakṣaṇaḥ tīkṣṇaḥ, madhyalakṣaṇaḥ madhyaḥ, alpalakṣaṇaḥ mṛdur vyādhiḥ| balāvekṣīty anena vyādhes tīkṣṇatve yadi balaṃ mahad bhavati tadaiva tīkṣṇaśodhanaṃ kartavyam iti darśayati||58||

lg.l: deyaṃ tv anirhṛte pūrvaṃ pīte paścāt punaḥ punaḥ|

ab.seg: vamane kriyamāṇe 'vasthāviśeṣakartavyam āha- deyam ity ādi| evaṃ pīte vamane sati anirhṛte doṣe paścāt punaḥ punar vamanārthīyaṃ bheṣajaṃ deyam| āpittadarśanād iti yāvat pittaṃ na dṛśyate tāvat punaḥ punar vamanaṃ deyam| vamanaṃ hi pittāntatayā samyag yuktaṃ bhavati| uktaṃ hi- “pittāntam iṣṭaṃ vamanaṃ virekād ardhaṃ” (si.a.1) iti||59||

lg.l: balatraividhyam ālakṣya ‘balaṃ trividhamālakṣya’ iti pā. doṣāṇām āturasya ca|
punaḥ pradadyād bhaiṣajyaṃ sarvaśo vā vivarjayet||60||

ab.seg: punaḥ punarbhaiṣajyaprayogasyāpavādaviṣayam ucitaviṣayaṃ ca darśayann āha- balety ādi| balavati doṣe puruṣe 'pi punaḥ prayojyaṃ bhaiṣajyaṃ, hīnabale doṣe puruṣe ca sarvaśo vā bheṣajaṃ śodhanārthaṃ vivarjayet, śodhanaṃ na kuryād ity arthaḥ| vāśabdena ca madhyamabale puruṣe doṣe ca na sarvathā vivarjanenaikavāraprayogaṃ śodhanasya darśayati||60||

lg.l: nirhṛte vā'pi jīrṇe vā doṣanirharaṇe budhaḥ|

ab.seg: nirhṛte ity ādau doṣanirharaṇe iti doṣanirharaṇakaprayojane bheṣaje| nirhṛte iti doṣam anirhṛtyaiva nirgate| jīrṇe veti yena vamanam adhikṛtyaitad ucyate, tena vamanasya pākakālāpratīkṣaiveti ‘apakvaṃ vamanaṃ’ ity ādinā vaktavyam| jīrṇasadṛśatā ca vamanasya kṣobhākartṛtayā pākonmukhatayā ca jñeyā| anyat prayuñjīteti vamanārthabheṣajapānānantaraṃ tadahar eva dadyāt||61||

lg.l: apakvaṃ vamanaṃ doṣaṃ ‘doṣān’ iti pā. pacyamānaṃ virecanam|

ab.seg: vamanaprayogeṣv ayogapratīkārārthaṃ bheṣajāntaraprayoge kartavye pākakālāpratīkṣaṇaṃ sopapattikam āha- apakvam ity ādi||62||

lg.l: pīte prasraṃsane ‘praskandane’ iti pā. doṣān na nirhatya jarāṃ gate|
vamite cauṣadhe dhīraḥ pāyayed auṣadhaṃ punaḥ||63||

ab.seg: vamane āvaśyakaṃ kartavyam abhidhāya virecane 'py āha- pīte prasraṃsane ity ādi| vamite cauṣadhe iti virecanauṣadhamātre vamite| punar iti tadahar eva||63||

lg.l: duḥśuddhaṃ tadahar bhuktaṃ śvobhūte pāyayet punaḥ||64||
durbalo bahudoṣaś ca doṣapākena yo naraḥ|
viricyate śanair bhojyair bhūyas tam anusārayet ‘sarairbhojyaiḥ’ iti pā.||65||

ab.seg: virecanena stokadoṣaharaṇe sati kartavyam āha- dīptāgnim ity ādi| dṛḍhasnehaguṇam ity anena snehalakṣaṇo guṇo dehe yadā dṛḍho nāsti tadā'sya bheṣajaṃ na dātavyaṃ, kintu sneha eva tāvat kartavyaḥ; asamyaksnigdhe hi punar api kriyamāṇaṃ virecanam asamyagyogāyaiva bhavati| duḥśuddham iti ayogenāviśuddham ‘ayogena śuddhaṃ’ iti pā.| śvobhūte, dināntare bhūte, kiṃ vā ‘śvo bhūyaḥ’ iti pāṭhaḥ| doṣapākeneti pakvadoṣe 'vibaddhatvād bahutvāc ca śanair viricyate| bhojyair iti anulomanaiḥ| atra ca pravṛttadoṣe 'tiyogabhayān na punar virecanaprayogam anujānīte||64-65||

lg.l: vamanaiś ca virekaiś ca viśuddhasyāpramāṇataḥ ‘viśuddhasya pramāṇataḥ| bhojanottarapānābhyāṃ’ iti pā.|

ab.seg: vamanavirecanābhyāṃ kiñciccheṣīkṛtadoṣapratīkārārtham āha- vamanaiś cety ādi| atra bahuvacanaṃ vegabahutvāpekṣayā| apramāṇata iti na niḥśeṣeṇa| tatra bhojanaṃ pācanaṃ yavāgvādibhojanam| antarapānaṃ kaṣāyapānam| ye tu ‘pramāṇataḥ’ iti paṭhanti, te samyakśuddhāv api koṣṭhopalepakadoṣapraśamanārthaṃ bhojanāntarapānaṃ vyākhyānayanti||66||

lg.l: durbalaṃ śodhitaṃ pūrvam alpadoṣaṃ ‘pūrvamalpaśeṣaṃ’ iti pā. ca mānavam|

ab.seg: mṛduśodhanopapādanīyam āha- durbalam ity ādi| śodhitaṃ pūrvam iti pūrvaśodhitasya durbalatayā mṛdu bheṣajaṃ deyaṃ, tīkṣṇena hi balabhraṃśo 'tiyogaś ca syāt||67||

lg.l: na cātitīkṣṇaṃ yat kṣipraṃ janayet prāṇasaṃśayam||68||

ab.seg: mṛdubheṣajaprayogopapattim āha- śreya ity ādi| asakṛtpītam iti asakṛtpītam alpabādhaṃ bhavatīty arthaḥ| śreya iti śreyastvaṃ cāsyātivyāpattikaratīkṣṇāpekṣayā jñeyam| na cātitīkṣṇam iti na cātitīkṣṇaṃ durbalādīnāṃ deyaṃ; yasmād atitīkṣṇaṃ durbalādīn prāpya kṣipraṃ prāṇasaṃśayaṃ janayet||68||

lg.l: mṛdubhir bheṣajair doṣā hanyur hy enam anirhṛtāḥ||69||

ab.seg: durbale bahudoṣe kartavyam āha- durbalo 'pīty ādi| bahuśo 'lpaśa iti punaḥ punaḥ stokamātrayā| evambhūtānāṃ mahādoṣanirharaṇe hetum āha- doṣā hanyur hy enam anirhṛtā iti||69||

lg.l: vamitaṃ kavalaiḥ śuddhaṃ laṅghitaṃ pāyayet tu tam||70||
vibaddhe 'lpe ‘vibandhe'lpaṃ’ iti pā. cirād doṣe sravaty uṣṇaṃ pibej jalam|
tenādhmānaṃ tṛṣā cchardir vibandhaś caiva śāmyati||71||
bheṣajaṃ doṣaruddhaṃ cen nordhvaṃ nādhaḥ pravartate|
sodgāraṃ sāṅgaśūlaṃ ‘saśūlaṃ ca’ iti pā. ca svedaṃ tatrāvacārayet||72||

ab.seg: yasyety ādāv ānulomikaṃ virecanam auṣadham ūrdhvaṃ yāti yasya, taṃ pāyayet ‘virecanam auṣadham’ iti śeṣaḥ| kavalaiḥ śuddham iti kavalaiḥ śodhitamukhakaṇṭham| teneti uṣṇajalena pītena||70-72||

lg.l: suvirikte ‘suviriktastu’ iti, ‘suviriktasya’ iti ca pā. tu sodgāram āśv evauṣadham ullikhet|
atipravartanaṃ ‘atipravṛttaṃ jīrṇe tu’ iti pā. jīrṇe suśītaiḥ stambhayed bhiṣak||73||

ab.seg: atiyogaśaṅkāyāṃ kartavyam āha- suvirikte ity ādi| suvirikte iti samyakpramāṇena nirhṛte ity arthaḥ| sodgāram iti udgāreṇa pacyamānāvasthā'bhihitā ‘apacyamānāvasthā’ iti pā.| etena samyagvirecane bhūte 'pi yad auṣadhaṃ tiṣṭhati tat taddine evollikhet| tasyāpy auṣadhaikadeśasyāpacyamānatāyāṃ virecanātiyogaḥ syād iti darśayati||73||

lg.l: kadācic chleṣmaṇā ruddhaṃ tiṣṭhaty urasi bheṣajam|
kṣīṇe śleṣmaṇi sāyāhne rātrau vā tat pravartate||74||

ab.seg: kadācid ity ādinā virecanasyāvikramatve ‘virecanasyāviriktatve’ iti pā. hetum āha| atra kartavyaṃ yady api noktaṃ, tathā'pi śleṣmaṇā nirodhaṃ bheṣajasya gauravādibhir upalabhya rātriparyantaṃ bheṣajasyāyogapravṛttir upekṣaṇīyeti kartavyam ūhanīyam| pravartate iti doṣasahitaṃ bheṣajaṃ pravartate||74||

lg.l: rūkṣānāhārayor jīrṇe ‘virūkṣānāhayorjīrṇe’ iti pā. viṣṭabhyordhvaṃ gate 'pi vā|
vāyunā bheṣaje tv anyat sasnehalavaṇaṃ pibet||75||

div.ab: rūkṣety ādāv ayogāj jīrṇe viṣṭabhya ūrdhvaṃ gate vā bheṣaje anyad virecanaṃ sasnehalavaṇaṃ dātavyam|75||

lg.l: tṛṇmohabhramamūrcchāyāḥ syuś cej jīryati ‘syurjīryati hi bheṣaje’ iti pā. bheṣaje|
pittaghnaṃ svādu śītaṃ ca bheṣajaṃ tatra śasyate||76||

ab.seg: tṛṇmohety ādinā pittāvṛtabheṣajasya lakṣaṇaṃ cikitsitaṃ cāha| syur jīryatīti jīryati bheṣaje tṛḍādayo bhavantīty arthaḥ||76||

lg.l: bheṣajaṃ tatra tīkṣṇoṣṇaṃ kaṭvādi kaphanud dhitam||77||

ab.seg: lālety ādinā kaphāvṛtabheṣajasya lakṣaṇaṃ cikitsitaṃ cāha||77||

susnigdham ity ādau avirecitam iti īṣadvirecitam| snehaja iti snehaprayogajanitaḥ śleṣmā| saṅgaḥ doṣasaṅgaḥ| tena laṅghanena doṣapākād eva prabalaśleṣmopaśamo doṣasaṅgopaśamaś ca kriyata ity arthaḥ||78||

lg.l: tebhyo bastiṃ purā dattvā paścād dadyād virecanam|
bastipravartitaṃ ‘bastipracālitaṃ’ iti pā. doṣaṃ harec chīghraṃ virecanam||80||
