vimathya saṃyojya punar dravais taṃ bastau nidadhyān mathitaṃ ‘nidadhyādbhiṣagapramattaḥ’ iti pā. khajena|24|

div.ab: ‘pūrvaṃ hi dadyād’ iti granthaṃ kecid anārṣam āhuḥ; tantrāntareṣu tv asyārthasya dṛṣṭatvād yukta evāyaṃ pāṭhaḥ; ucyate hi suśrute “dattvā''dau saindhavasyākṣaṃ madhunaś ca paladvayam ‘madhunaḥ prasṛtadvayam’ iti pā.| pātre talena mathnīyāt” (su.ci.a.38) ity ādi| punar dravais tam ity atra dravaśabdena kvāthasya ‘kvāthasyāvyavahitasya’ iti pā. grahaṇam||23||-

lg.l: vāmāśraye ‘vāmāśrayo'gnirgrahaṇī gudaṃ ca’ iti pā. hi grahaṇīgude ca tat pārśvasaṃsthasya sukhopalabdhiḥ||24||
līyanta evaṃ valayaś ca tasmāt savyaṃ śayāno 'rhati bastidānam|25|

div.ab: vāmapārśvaśayanaṃ yad uktaṃ tasya prayojanam āha- vāmāśraye ity ādi| vāmāśraye ‘vāmāśrayo yasmādagnirgrahaṇīgude ca’ iti pā. yasmād grahaṇīgude, tena vāmapārśvasuptasya grahaṇīgude prakṛtisthe bhavataḥ, prakṛtisthe ca gude gudasya bastinā samyagupaśleṣād ‘samyagupalabdhyā’ iti pā. vyāptir bhavati, tathā ‘tathā dravamapi suprasṛtaṃ bhavati, tena sukhaṃ bastiryāti, grahaṇyāḥ prakṛtisthataya bastidravyaṃ sukhaṃ grahaṇīṃ bhāvayatīti boddhavyam’ iti pā. valayaś ca līnā bhavanti, tena sukhaṃ bastir yāti, grahaṇīgudayoḥ prakṛtisthatayā ca bastir vyāpya sukhaṃ grahaṇīṃ bhāvayatīti boddhavyam||24||-

lg.l: viḍvātavego yadi cārdhadatte niṣkṛṣya mukte praṇayed aśeṣam ‘praṇayetta śeṣam’ iti pā.||25||
uttānadehaś ca kṛtopadhānaḥ syād vīryam āpnoti tathā'sya deham ‘dehaḥ’ iti pā.|26|

div.ab: viḍvātety ādau niṣkṛṣya mukte iti nalikām ākṛṣya viḍvātavege mukte| datte tu bastau uttānadehaḥ kṛtopadhānaś ca syāt| etatkaraṇaprayojanam āha- vīryam āpnotīty ādi||25||-

lg.l: eko 'pakarṣaty anilaṃ svamārgāt pittaṃ dvitīyas tu kaphaṃ tṛtīyaḥ||26||

ab.seg: eko 'pakarṣatīty ādi| etad vātādibhedena ekādibastidānavidhānaṃ; na tu tridoṣe prathamo vātaṃ jayati, dvitīyaḥ pittaṃ jayati, tṛtīyaḥ kapham ity ādi vyākhyeyaṃ; yataḥ, “snigdhoṣṇa ekaḥ pavane samāṃsaḥ” ity ādinā pavanādibhedenaiva saṅkhyāniyamaṃ kariṣyati| evaṃ ‘evaṃ ca mārge'pi eko bastiranilamapakarṣati’ iti pā. svamārgāc cānilam eko bastir apakarṣati, pittaṃ dvitīyas tu svamārgād iti pittaṃ dvāv eva jayataḥ ‘jayata ityādi jñeyam’ iti pā., kaphaṃ traya eva jayantīti jñeyaṃ; svamārgād iti svasthānāt| yady api ca bastiḥ ‘bastinā pakvāśayagata eva doṣo hriyate’ iti pā.| ‘anilasya pakvāśayaḥ sthānaṃ, tasya ca pratyāsannatvādeka eva puṭo yuktaḥ, pittāśayasthānasyātivyavahitatvāddvitīyaḥ, āmāśayasyātivyavahitatvāttṛtīyaḥ’ iti śrīkaṇṭhadattaḥ pakvāśayagatam eva doṣaṃ jayatīty uktaṃ, tathā'pi pittādisthāne 'pi viśeṣabastividhisāmarthyād doṣaharaṇam ucyate; tena, utsargatas tadgatadoṣaharaṇaṃ viśiṣṭavidhānena ca sthānāntaragatadoṣaharaṇaṃ bhavati| ayam artho jatūkaṇe 'py ucyate- “bastiḥ kāryaḥ sakṛd bastisthānaśaktyā'nilādiṣu” iti| atra dvitīyaḥ pittam apakarṣati, tṛtīyaḥ kapham apakarṣatīty ucyate; tathā'pi prathamadvitīyayor api pittakaphāpahatvam asty eva ‘atra dvitīyaḥ pittamapakarṣati tṛtīyo vātakaphamapakarṣatītyucyate, atrāpi prathamadvitīyayoḥ pittakaphāpahatvamastyeva, paraṃ dvitīyena tṛtīyena ca vātakaphāpaharaṇaṃ sthānapratyāsattyā kriyata iti kṛtvā dvitīyaḥ pittaṃ harati, tṛtīyaḥ kaphaṃ haratīti coktam’ iti pā., paraṃ dvitīyena pittāpaharaṇaṃ, tṛtīyena ca kaphāpaharaṇaṃ sthānapratyāsattyā kriyata iti kṛtvā dvitīyaḥ pittaṃ harati, tṛtīyaḥ kaphaṃ haratīti coktam| pittakaphayoś ca yady api sukhaṃ cikitsitaṃ bastir na bhavati, tathā'pi vātāvarake vātānubandhe vā pitte kaphe caitad bastidānaṃ jñeyam; uktaṃ hi suśrute- “bastir vāte ca pitte ca kaphe rakte ca śasyate” (su.ci.a.35) iti||26||

lg.l: pratyāgate koṣṇajalāvasiktaḥ śālyannam adyāt tanunā rasena|
jīrṇe tu sāyaṃ laghu cālpamātraṃ bhukto 'nuvāsyaḥ paribṛṃhaṇārtham||27||
dattvā sphicau pāṇitalena hanyāt snehasya śīghrāgamarakṣaṇārtham||28||
īṣac ca pādāṅguliyugmam āñched uttānadehasya ‘īṣat padāṅguṣṭhayugaṃ ca karṣe…’ iti pā. talau pramṛjyāt|
snehena pārṣṇyaṅgulipiṇḍikāś ca ye cāsya gātrāvayavā rugārtāḥ||29||
tāṃś cāvamadgīta sukhaṃ tataś ca nidrām upāsīta kṛtopadhānaḥ|30|

div.ab: śālyannam ity ādau jīrṇe iti āsthāpanopalepe koṣṭhasthe jīrṇe| tanumāṃsarasādibhojanaṃ ceha nirūheṇa manāg upahatasya vahneḥ paripālanārtham| peyādikramas tv atra na kriyate, virecanavad ihāmasyābhāvāt; ata eva suśrute peyādikramaṃ tyaktvā rasādikrama uktaḥ| paribṛṃhaṇārtham ity anena lekhanārthaṃ kriyamāṇe nirūhe paribṛṃhaṇārtham anuvāsanaṃ tadahaḥ kartavyam iti darśayati| ata eva kalpanāsiddhāv api- “naras tato niśy anuvāsanārhaḥ” (si.a.1) ity anena tadahar anuvāsanasyāvaśyakatvam uktaṃ ‘tadaharanuvāsanaṃ sārvatrikamuktaṃ’ iti pā.; jatūkarṇe 'py uktaṃ- “jīrṇe sāyaṃ kṛtānnaṃ ca puṣṭyartham anuvāsayet” iti| nirūhapādāṃśasamena taileneti nirūhapādapramāṇena, caturviṃśatipale nirūhe ṣaṭpalena snehenety arthaḥ; iyaṃ cottamā mātrā'nuvāsanasya; uktaṃ hy anyatra- “uttamā ṣaṭpalī proktā madhyamā tripalī bhavet| kanīyasī ‘kanīyasyadhyardhapalā’ iti pā. sārdhapalā tridhā mātrā'nuvāsane” iti; suśrute 'py etāvanmānam eva snehasyānuvāsana mātrābastivibhāgenānuvāsane uktam| snehaśīghrāgamanarakṣārthaṃ vidhānam āha- īṣad ity ādi| tac ca pādāṅgulyottānadehasya mātrāśataṃ sthāpanaṃ kartavyam| nirūhe tu triṃśanmātrākālaṃ yāvad uttānasya sthāpanaṃ manyante| pādāṅguliyugmam iti parvasandhiḥ| āñched iti ‘āñchediti prasārayedityarthaḥ’ iti pā. ākarṣet| nidrām upāsīteti vacanaṃ kriyāntarasya niṣedhārtham||27-29||-

lg.l: bhāgāḥ kaṣāyasya tu pañca, pitte snehasya ṣaṣṭhaḥ prakṛtau sthite ca||30||
vāte vivṛddhe tu caturthabhāgo, mātrā nirūheṣu kaphe 'ṣṭabhāgaḥ|31|

div.ab:
samprati trividho yo dvādaśaprasṛto nirūhas tasya kaṣāyasnehamātrāṃ nirūpayann āha ‘niyamayannāha’ iti pā. - bhāgā ity ādi| bhāgāḥ kaṣāyasya pañcety anena sarvatraiva doṣe svasthe ca puruṣe dvādaśaprasṛtabhāgarūpe nirūhe pañcabhāgāḥ kaṣāyasya bhavanti, tena pañca prasṛtāḥ kaṣāyasya| snehasya ca doṣabhedena svasthe ca mānabhedam āha- pitte ity ādi| pitte snehasya ṣaṣṭhaḥ, tathā prakṛtau sthite ca puruṣe svasthe ṣaṣṭha ity arthaḥ; tatra ṣaṇṇāṃ pūraṇaḥ ṣaṣṭhaḥ, tena dvādaśaprasṛtasya ṣaṣṭho bhāgo dviprasṛtaṃ bhavati| snehaśabdena ghṛtatailādigrahaṇam| vāte tu vṛddhe caturtho bhāgaḥ; snehacaturtho bhāgaḥ prasṛtatrayam| aṣṭabhāga iti sārdhaḥ prasṛtaḥ| asminn arthe hārītaḥ- “kvāthasya pañcaprasṛtā vibhāgāḥ, snehasya ṣaṣṭho hy adhike tu pitte| svasthe ca tāvat, pavane caturthaḥ, kaphe 'ṣṭamo 'tyantagate(?) vikalpaḥ” iti| eṣā snehamātrā hīnamātre 'pi nirūhe kvāthasnehayor uktamātrānusāreṇa yojanīyā; śeṣaṇāṃ tu madhukalkasaindhavānām iha mātrāniyamo noktaḥ, teṣām api prakṛtyādibhadenāniyatatvāt; tena madhvādīnāṃ prakṛtyādyanusāreṇa prasṛtamānena dvādaśaprasṛtatvaṃ pūraṇīyam| tatra jatūkaṇapratyayāt sarvatra kalkasya paladvayaṃ bhavati| uktaṃ hi tatra “caturviṃśatike puṭake peṣyāṇāṃ dvipalaṃ, kiñcic ca madhusaindhavāt, sneho vakṣyamāṇaḥ, śeṣaṃ kaṣāyasya; vāte tailaṣaṭpalaṃ svasthe ca; catvāri pitte ghṛtasya, kaphe trīṇi tailasya” iti; saindhavaṃ tu karṣapramāṇam asti; yataḥ suśrute- “saindhavākṣaṃ samādāya madhunaḥ prasṛtadvayam” (su.ci.a.38) ity ādy uktam; hārīta tu- “kṣaudraṃ tu deyaṃ prasṛtapramāṇaṃ dvitīyam āhur lavaṇasya cākṣam” ity uktaṃ; tenānayā diśā saindhavamadhukalpanā| yathoktakaṣāyasnehakalkamadhusaindhavāpūritāṃśapūraṇaṃ cāvāpenaiva kartavyam; āvāpaś cātrānukto 'py uttaratra vakṣyamāṇo vātādibhedena māṃsarasakṣīragomūtrādiko jñeyaḥ| vakṣyati hi- “snigdhoṣṇa ekaḥ pavane nirūho, dvau svāduśītau payasā ca pitte| trayaḥ samūtrāḥ kaṭukoṣṇatīkṣṇāḥ kaphe nirūhā na paraṃ vidheyāḥ” iti| hārīta'py uktaṃ “snehaṃ guḍaṃ māṃsarasaṃ payaś ca hy amlāni mūtrāṇi ca saindhavaṃ ca| etāni sarvāṇy api yojayīta nirūhayoge madanāt phalaṃ ca” iti| yat tu tantrāntare- dvādaśaprasṛtapūraṇaṃ prati pratidravyavibhāgenoktaṃ; yathā-
“dattvā''dau saindhavasyākṣaṃ madhunaḥ prasṛtadvayam|
vinirmathya tato dadyāt snehasya prasṛtatrayam|
ekībhūte tataḥ snehe kalkasya prasṛtaṃ kṣipet|
sammūrcchite kaṣāyaṃ tu catuḥprasṛtasammitam|| vitarec ca tadāvāpam ante ‘tathā''vāpamante’ iti pā. dviprasṛtonmitam| evaṃ sukalpito bastir dvādaśaprasṛto bhavet” (su.ci.a.38) iti; tad vātaviṣayam eva, snehasya vātaghnatvāt; kintv atra yac catuḥprasṛtaṃ kaṣāyasya manyate, tad asmattantrānumatam eva ‘tadasmattantrānugatatvādanumatameva’ iti pā.| yat tv anye paṭhanti-
“madhusnehanakalkākhyakaṣāyāvāpataḥ kramāt|
trīṇi ṣaṭ dve daśa trīṇi palāny anilarogiṇām|| pitte catvāri catvāri dve dvipañca catuṣṭayam ‘pitte catvāri dve pañca catuṣṭayapalāni hi’ iti pā.| ṣaṭ trīṇi dve daśa trīṇi kaphe cāpi nirūhaṇam” iti; tad asmattantrānugatatvād anumatam eva||30||-

lg.l: ādvādaśāt syāt prasṛtābhivṛddhir aṣṭādaśād dvādaśataḥ paraṃ syuḥ|
āsaptates tad vihitaṃ ‘āsaptateruktamidaṃ’ iti pā. pramāṇam ataḥ paraṃ ṣoḍaśavad vidheyam||32||
nirūhamātrā prasṛtapramāṇā bāle ca vṛddhe ca mṛdur viśeṣaḥ|33|

div.ab: idānīṃ vayobhedena nirūhapramāṇaṃ darśayann āha- nirūhety ādi| ādye varṣe bālasya palamāne nirūhe kvāthādi yathoktamānānusāreṇa vaktavyam; ardhaprasṛtābhivṛddhiḥ tataḥ prativarṣaṃ bhavati; tena dvādaśavarṣe ṣaṭprasṛto bastirbhavati; dvādaśād ūrdhvam aṣṭādaśavarṣaparyantaṃ prativarṣaṃ prasṛtavṛddhyā dvādaśaprasṛtapūraṇaṃ bhavati; ‘dvādaśataḥ paraṃ syuḥ’ ity anenādhikapramāṇabastimānaṃ mahātyayakaraṃ kaiścid anumataṃ niṣedhayati; yathā hārīte ekīyamataṃ paṭhyate- “ardhāḍhakaṃ paramatamaṃ ‘paramataṃ’ iti pā. pramāṇam” iti asyāgre hastalikhitapustake ‘tathāhi hārīte ekīyamatamapyanumatam, ‘apratiṣiddhaṃ paramatamanumatam’ iti nyāyāt’ ityadhikaṃ paṭhyate; tathā suśrute 'pi (?)- “dvādaśaprasṛtaṃ kecit triṃśatpalam athā'pare” ity ādi| bastimānaṃ darśayitum āha- āsaptater ity ādi| āsaptates tad iti dvādaśaprasṛtamānaṃ saptatiṃ yāvad bhavati| ṣoḍaśavad iti daśaprasṛtapramāṇam| bālavṛddhayor yathoktaprasṛtamānaviṣayaṃ darśayan ‘darśayitumevānyaṃ’ iti pā. tatrānyaṃ viśeṣam āha- nirūhamātrety ādi| bālavṛddhayor yathoktaiva nirūhamātrā prasṛtapramāṇā kāryā, viśeṣeṇa tayor bastir mṛduḥ kāryaḥ| tīkṣṇatvamārdavakaraṃ ca vidhānaṃ vakṣyati; yathā- “tīkṣṇatvaṃ mūtrapīlvagnilavaṇakṣārasarṣapaiḥ| prāptakālaṃ vidhātavyaṃ kṣīrādyair mārdavaṃ tathā” (si.a.7) iti||31-32||-

lg.l: nātyucchritaṃ nāpy atinīcapādaṃ sapādapīṭhaṃ śayanaṃ praśastam||33||

div.ab: samprati ‘śayane vidhiḥ kaḥ’ iti praśnasyottaram āha- nātyucchritam ity ādi| pūrvaṃ yaḥ śayanavidhir uktaḥ sa tātkālikaḥ, ayaṃ tūttarakālika iti viśeṣaḥ| pradhānaṃ mahan mṛdu cāstaraṇaṃ pradhānamṛdvāstaraṇaṃ, tenopapannaṃ yuktam| prākśīrṣakam iti “prācyāṃ diśi sthitā devās tatpūjārthaṃ ca prākśirāḥ” (su.sū.a.19) iti vacanāt||33||-

lg.l: bhojyaṃ punar vyādhim avekṣya tadvat ‘samyak’ iti pā. prakalpayed yūṣapayorasādyaiḥ||34||
sarveṣu vidyād vidhim etam ādyaṃ vakṣyāmi bastīn ata uttarīyān|35|

div.ab: yūṣādi bhojyavidhānaṃ yathākramaṃ kaphe, pitte, vāte; kiṃ vā, agnyapekṣaṃ yathāyogyatayā vyākhyeyam| yathoktavidhānaṃ vakṣyamāṇavidhiṣu kartavyatayā darśayann āha- sarveṣv ity ādi| etad ādyam iti pradhānam, autsargikam iti yāvat; tena viśeṣavidhānenāpavādo 'py asya bhaviṣyatīti sūcayati||34||-

lg.l: prastho rasāc chāgarasārdhayuktaḥ sādhyaḥ punaḥ prasthasamas tu yāvat|
syād dīpano māṃsabalapradaś ca cakṣurbalaṃ cāpi dadāti bastiḥ ‘sadyaḥ’ iti pā.|
eraṇḍamūlaṃ tripalaṃ palāśā ‘palāni’ iti pā. hrasvāni mūlāni ca yāni pañca||38||
bhāgāḥ palāṃśā madanāṣṭayuktā ‘madanāṣṭakaṃ ca’ iti pā. jaladvikaṃse kvathite 'ṣṭaśeṣe||39||
peṣyāḥ śatāhvā hapuṣā priyaṅguḥ sapippalīkaṃ madhukaṃ balā ‘vacā’ iti pā. ca|
rasāñjanaṃ vatsakabījamustaṃ bhāgākṣamātraṃ ‘akṣapramāṇaṃ’ iti pā. lavaṇāṃśayuktam||40||
samākṣikas tailayutaḥ samūtro bastir nṛṇāṃ dīpanalekhanīyaḥ|
catuṣpale tailaghṛtasya bhṛṣṭāc chāgāc chatārdho dadhidāḍimāmlaḥ|
rasaḥ sapeṣyo balamāṃsavarṇaretognidaś cāndhyaśirortiśastaḥ ‘…śirorujāghnaḥ’ iti pā.||43||
kalkair vacāmāgadhikāpalābhyāṃ ‘…rbalāmāgadhikāpalābhyāṃ’ iti pā. yuktaḥ śatāhvādvipalena cāpi||44||
sasaindhavaḥ kṣaudrayutaḥ satailo deyo nirūho balavarṇakārī|

ab.seg: ‘ke bastaya’ ity ādipraśnasyottaraṃ- dvipañcamūlasyety ādi| atra māṃsaṃ daśamūlasamam| rasaḥ kvāthaḥ| amlaṃ kāñjikādi| sapūrvapeṣya iti balādyuktakalkayuktaḥ| trisnehayukta ity anena, majjaparityāgaṃ sarvabastisiddhaṃ smārayati; uktaṃ hy anyatra- “vijñeyas trividhaḥ sneho bastyartha majjavarjitaḥ” iti| sthirādivargasyety ādau madhusaindhave yady api sāmānyenoktabastividhānalabdhe, tathā'pi tailādīnām atrāprakarṣārthaṃ punas tayor abhidhānaṃ, kiṃ vā sāmānyavidhismaraṇārtham atrābhidhānam; evam anyatrāpi sāmānyavidhiprāptasya punarabhidhāne vyākhyeyam| eraṇḍamūlam ity ādau palāśā śaṭī| hrasvāni mūlānīti sthirādipañcamūlam| kaṃsa āḍhakaḥ| bhāgākṣamātram iti bhāgenākṣamātram| chāgāc chatārdha iti pañcāśatpalo bhavati| sapeṣya iti balādikasya kalkayuktaḥ||35-45||

lg.l: yaṣṭyāhvayasyāṣṭapalena ‘yaṣṭyāhvamūlāṣṭapalena’ iti pā. siddhaṃ payaḥ śatāhvāphalapippalībhiḥ|
yaṣṭyāhvalodhrābhayacandanaiś ca śṛtaṃ payo 'gryaṃ kamalotpalaiś ca|
saśarkaraṃ kṣaudrayutaṃ suśītaṃ pittāmayān hanti sajīvanīyam||47||
toye samutkvāthya rasena tena śṛtaṃ payo 'rdhāḍhakam ambuhīnam|
piṣṭair ghṛtakṣaudrayutair nirūhaṃ sasaindhavaṃ śītalam eva dadyāt|
pratyāgate dhanvarasena śālīn kṣīreṇa vā'dyāt pariṣiktagātraḥ||51||
pathyāvidārīkṣurasair guḍena ‘tathā’ iti pā. bastiṃ yutaṃ pittaharaṃ vidadhyāt||54||
hṛnnābhipārśvottamadehadāhe ‘hṛnnābhipārśvodaradehadāhe’ iti pā. dāhe 'ntarasthe ca sakṛcchramūtre|
kṣīṇe kṣate retasi cāpi naṣṭe paitte 'tisāre ca nṛṇāṃ praśastaḥ||55||

ab.seg: yaṣṭyāhvayasyety ādikāś catvāraḥ pitte, pūrvaṃ tūktāḥ pañca vāte| atra payaḥsādhanaṃ kṣīrapākaparibhāṣayaiva| yaṣṭyāhvalodhrety ādinā jīvanīyam ity antenaiko yogaḥ| jīvanīyānām atra kalkaḥ| suśītatvam ihautsargikaṃ mṛdukoṣṭheṣv adhikaṃ ‘mṛdukoṣṭhasambādhakaṃ’ iti, ‘mṛdukoṣṭhatvabādhakaṃ’ iti ca pā. pittahitatvāt; anayā ca diśā'parapittaharabastāv api śītatvaṃ jñeyam| dvikārṣikam ity ādau anantā utpalasārivā| tṛṇapañcamūlaṃ- “śarekṣudarbhakāśānāṃ śālīnāṃ mūlam eva ca” (ca.ci.a.1pā.1) ity ādinoktam| ambuhīnam iti kṣīrāvaśeṣaparyantaṃ śṛtam| rājakaśeruḥ kaśerur eva| sasaindhavam iti īṣatsaindhavam| sasārivety ādau śītapākī śītalī| madhuyaṣṭitailaṃ madhuyaṣṭisādhitaṃ tailam| uttamadehaḥ mastakam||46-55||

lg.l: paktvā kulatthān bṛhatīṃ ca toye rasasya tasya prasṛtā daśa syuḥ||56||
tān sarṣapailāmadanaiḥ sakuṣṭhair akṣapramāṇaiḥ prasṛtaiś ca yuktān|
phalāhvatailasya samākṣikasya ‘kṣaudrasya tailasya phalāhvayasya’ iti pā. kṣārasya tailasya ca sārṣapasya||57||
dadyān nirūhaṃ kapharogiṇe jño mandāgnaye cāpy aśanadviṣe ca|
dvipañcamūle triphalāṃ sabilvāṃ phalāni gomūtrayutaḥ kaṣāyaḥ|
hanyāt tathā mārutamūtrasaṅgaṃ bastes tathā''ṭopam athāpi ‘…matīva ghoram’ iti pā. ghoram||60||
rūkṣauṣadhair apy apatarpitebhya eteṣu rogeṣv api satsu dattaḥ|
nihatya vātaṃ jvalanaṃ pradīpya vijitya rogāṃś ca balaṃ karoti||64||

ab.seg: koṣātakety ādikāś catvāraḥ kaphe bastayaḥ| śārṅgeṣṭā guñjā| atra kvāthadaśaprasṛtena tathā kalkena kṣaudrādinā ca yady api mānam adhikaṃ bhavati, tathā'py evam eva dravyasaṃyogaṃ kṛtvā dvādaśaprasṛta eva bastir deyaḥ, tadadhikamānasya niṣiddhatvāt| paṭolety ādau paṭolādipippalyantais toyaṃ sādhayitvā pūrvavad dvitīyaḥ, kapharogiṇe dvipañcamūlyādibhis tṛtīyaḥ kartavyaḥ| kṣāraḥ yavakṣāraḥ| rāsnety ādau śampākaḥ caturaṅgulaḥ| tiktā kaṭurohiṇī| atra piṇḍītakakvātho 'py āvāpakalpo ‘…'vayavakalpaḥ’ iti pā. yena praviśati; piṇḍītakaḥ madanaḥ| rūkṣauṣadhair atyapatarpitebhyo 'py eteṣu kuṣṭhādirogeṣv ayaṃ datto balaṃ karotīti yojanā||56-64||

lg.l: dvipañcamūlaṃ ca palāṃśikāni kṣuṇṇāni dhautāni phalāni ‘palāni’ iti pā. cāṣṭau||65||
payojaladvyāḍhakavac chṛtaṃ ‘payojaladvyāḍhakapācitaṃ’ iti, ‘payojalārdhāḍhakapācitaṃ’ iti, ‘payojaladvyāḍhakayoḥ śṛtaṃ’ iti ca pā. tat kṣīrāvaśeṣaṃ sitavastrapūtam||66||
kalkair yavānyā madanaiś ca yuktaṃ nātyuṣṇaśītaṃ guḍasaindhavāktam||67||
kṣaudrasya tailasya ca sarpiṣaś ca tathaiva yuktaṃ prasṛtais tribhiś ca ‘prasṛtitrayeṇa’ iti pā.|
dadyān nirūhaṃ vidhinā vivijñaḥ sa sarvasaṃsargakṛtāmayaghnaḥ||68||

ab.seg: punarnavety ādikaḥ sarvavātādisaṃsargaviṣayaḥ| vṛścīraḥ śvetapunarnavā| dhānyāni phalāni ceti dhānyaphalāni| payojaladvyāḍhakavad iti samajalakṣīradviprasthayuktam||65-68||

lg.l: snigdhoṣṇa ekaḥ pavane samāṃso dvau svāduśītau payasā ca pitte|
trayaḥ samūtrāḥ kaṭukoṣṇatīkṣṇāḥ kaphe nirūhā na paraṃ vidheyāḥ||69||

ab.seg: uktānāṃ vātādiharabastīnāṃ saṅkhyākalpanāṃ viśiṣṭāṃ darśayann āha- snigdhoṣṇa ity ādi| eka iti eka eva puṭakaḥ| payasā ceti payoyuktau| kaṭukoṣṇatīkṣṇatvaṃ kaphaharadravyayogād eva jñeyam| na paraṃ vidheyā ity anena tantrāntaravihitaṃ caturthabastidānam atyarthaśarīrahiṃsakaṃ niṣedhayati; yathā suśrute- “dvitīyaṃ vā tṛtīyaṃ vā caturthaṃ vā yathārhataḥ| samyaṅnirūḍhaliṅge tu prāpte bastiṃ nivartayet” (su.ci.a.32) ity anenoktaṃ caturthadānam iti||69||

lg.l: rasena vāte pratibhojanaṃ syāt kṣīreṇa pitte tu kaphe ca yūṣaiḥ|
tathā'nuvāsyeṣu ca bilvatailaṃ syāj jīvanīyaṃ phalasādhitaṃ ca||70||
itīdam uktaṃ nikhilaṃ yathāvad bastipradānasya vidhānam agryam|
yo 'dhītya vidvān iha bastikarma karoti loke labhate sa siddhim||71||

ab.seg: samprati vātādibhedena pratibhojanaṃ viśiṣṭaṃ tathā'nuvāsanaṃ cāha- rasena vāte ity ādi| pratibhojanaṃ nirūhānantarabhojanam| vāte bilvatailānuvāsanaṃ, pitte jīvanīyasādhitaṃ, kaphe ca madanaphalasādhitam| atra bilvatailādīni vakṣyamāṇāni vyākhyānayanti; tena snehavyāpatsiddhau yad vakṣyati “daśamūlaṃ” (si.a.4) ity ādinā bilvatailaṃ, jīvanīyaṃ ca “jīvantī madanaṃ” (si.a.4) ity ādinā vakṣyamāṇayamakaṃ, tathā “madanair vā'mlasaṃyuktaiḥ” (si.a.4) ity ādinā vakṣyamāṇaṃ madanatailaṃ jñeyam||70-71||
ity agniveśakṛte tantre carakapratisaṃskṛte 'prāpte dṛḍhabalasampūrite siddhisthāne bastisūtrīyasiddhir nāma tṛtīyo 'dhyāyaḥ||3||
iti śrīcakrapāṇidattapraṇītāyām āyurvedadīpikāyāṃ carakatātparyaṭīkāyāṃ siddhisthāne bastisūtrīyasiddhir nāma tṛtīyodhyāyaḥ||3||
athātaḥ snehavyāpatsiddhiṃ ‘snehavyāpadikīṃ siddhiṃ’ iti pā. vyākhyāsyāmaḥ||1||
iti ha smāha bhagavān ātreyaḥ||2||

pūrvasiddhau ‘pūrvādhyāye’ iti pā. bilvatailādīny abhyaṅgasevānuvāsanārthaṃ nirdiṣṭāni, tadabhidhāyikā ceyaṃ siddhir ity anantaraṃ snehavyāpatsiddhir ucyate; snehānām ānuvāsanikānāṃ tadvyāpadāṃ ca bheṣajānām abhidhāyikā siddhiḥ||1-2||

adhyāyavaktavyam āha- snehabastīn ity ādi| bastiprayojyāḥ snehā etacchlokābhihitā ity arthaḥ; prapañcānabhidheyā ye tv apare 'trārthāḥ “snehabastiṃ nirūhaṃ ca” ity ādinā vaktavyāḥ, te na prapañcavācyā iti te na pratijñātāḥ||3||

lg.l: śatāvarīṃ sahacaraṃ kākanāsāṃ palāṃśikam ‘palonmitām’ iti pā.|
tailāḍhakaṃ samakṣīraṃ ‘pacettailāḍhakaṃ kṣīraiḥ’ iti pā. jīvanīyaiḥ palonmitaiḥ||6||

ab.seg: daśamūlam ity ādau bhūtīkaṃ kattṛṇaṃ yavānikā vā; kākanāsā vāyasīphalam, anye tu vāsāphalaṃ ‘kāyuyāṭuṭī’ iti khyātaṃ dravyāntaram evāhuḥ| etad daśamūlasthitabilvena bilvatailam iti vadanti||4-7||
ānūpānām ity ādau tadvad iti pūrvakvāthena sādhitā| śatāhvety ādi yogāntaram| saindhavenety api yogāntaram||8||

lg.l: jīvantīṃ madanaṃ medāṃ śrāvaṇīṃ madhukaṃ balām|
piṣṭvā tailaṃ ghṛtaṃ kṣīre sādhayet taccaturguṇe||10||
mūtraretorajodoṣān ‘putryaṃ retorajodoṣān harettadanuvāsanāt’ iti pā. haret tad anuvāsanam||11||
tailapādaṃ ‘tailapātraṃ’ iti pā. ghṛtaṃ siddhaṃ pittaghnam anuvāsanam||12||

ab.seg: jīvantīm ity ādinā yamakam anuvāsanam| etad yamakaṃ pūrvādhyāye jīvanīyasañjñayā vyāpadiṣṭam| lābhata iti yathālābham| candanādyaṃ jvaracikitsitoktam| tailaṃ pādaṃ yasmin tat tailapādam||9-12||

lg.l: saindhavaṃ madanaṃ kuṣṭhaṃ śatāhvāṃ niculaṃ vacām ‘valām’ iti pā.|
nāgaraṃ puṣkaraṃ medāṃ cavikāṃ citrakaṃ śaṭīm|
bilvājamode kṛṣṇāṃ ca dantīṃ rāsnāṃ ca peṣayet|
sādhyam eraṇḍajaṃ tailaṃ tailaṃ vā kapharoganut||15||
ānāham aśmarīṃ caiva hanyāt tad anuvāsanāt||16||
tailaṃ kaphaharair vā'pi kaphaghnaṃ kalpayed bhiṣak||17||

ab.seg: madanair vā'mlasaṃyuktair ity atra madanasya kalkatvam, kāñjikādīnām amlānāṃ dravatvam| etac ca madanatailam iti khyātam| bilvādyo gaṇaḥ daśamūlaṃ; daśamūlaṃ cātra kvāthakalkābhyām api deyam| uktaṃ hi- “kvāthakalkāv anirdeśe gaṇāt tasmāt samāvapet” iti| kaphaharair iti pūrvodhyāyoktakaphaharabheṣajaiḥ, kiṃ vā trikaṭukapañcakolādibhiḥ||13-17||

lg.l: eṣāṃ kvāthena vipacet tailam ebhiś ca kalkitaiḥ||19||
tat kuṣṭhāni krimīn mehān arśāṃsi grahaṇīgadam||21||
janayed aprajānāṃ ca prajāṃ strīṇāṃ tathā nṛṇām||24||

ab.seg: viḍaṅgety ādau ebhiś ca kalkitair iti vakṣyamāṇaiḥ| latā mañjiṣṭhā, gaurī haridrā| snehabastir balaprada iti etais tailaiḥ kṛtaḥ snehabastir ity arthaḥ||18-24||

lg.l: abhukte ca praṇītasya snehabasteḥ ṣaḍ āpadaḥ||25||

ab.seg: vātapittety ādinā snehabaster vyāpadaḥ prāha| etāś ca vyāpado mithyāyogena snehasya kriyamāṇā ucyante; pratijñātaṃ hi ‘mithyāpraṇihitānāṃ ca vyāpada’ iti, tena snehāyogātiyogajanyavyāpadām ihānavasara eva; anuvāsanāyogātiyogajanyāś ca vyāpadaḥ kalpanāsiddhāv evoktāḥ; tadbheṣajaṃ cātisnehite śodhanabastiḥ, asnehite punaḥ snehabastidānam eva jñeyam| etac ca “tasmān nirūḍhaḥ saṃsnehyo nirūhyaś cānuvāsitaḥ” ity ādinoktatvāt prasaṅgenehoktam ‘prabādhanenoktaṃ’ iti, ‘prabandhenoktaṃ’ iti ca pā.||25||

lg.l: śīto 'lpo vā'dhike vāte pitte 'tyuṣṇaḥ kaphe mṛduḥ|
dattas tair āvṛtaḥ sneho na yāty abhibhavād api ‘na yātyabhibhavādadhaḥ’ iti pā.|
abhukte 'nāvṛtatvāc ca yāty ūrdhvaṃ tasya lakṣaṇam||27||

ab.seg: yathākramaṃ ṣaḍvyāpadāṃ hetum āha- śīta ity ādi| gurur iti gurutvayuktaḥ ‘guruṇā yuktaḥ’ iti pā.| varcaḥsañcaye 'lpabala iti sañcite male sati alpabalo varcaḥsañcayapravartanākṣama ity arthaḥ| tair āvṛta iti padaṃ pratyekaṃ vātādiṣu pañcasu yojanīyam| abhibhavād apīti vātādinā''vṛtamārgatvān na yāti; tathā tena vātādinolbaṇenābhibhūtaguṇatvāc ca na āyāti| anāvṛtatvād iti annenordhvamārgasyāpihitatvāt| tasya lakṣaṇam iti yathākramaṃ vātādyāvṛtasya lakṣaṇaṃ vakṣyamāṇam aṅgamardādi| veṣṭanair iti pārśvaveṣṭanair eva| ete ca stambhādayo vātāvṛtasnehamahimnaiva jāyante, tena snehaprayogāt pūrvaṃ na bhavanty eva||26-28||

lg.l: snigdhāmlalavaṇoṣṇais taṃ rāsnāpītadrutailikaiḥ ‘rāsnāpītadrutilvakaiḥ’ iti pā.| ‘pītadruratra saralaḥ’ iti induḥ|
tābhyām eva ca tailābhyāṃ sāyaṃ bhukte 'nuvāsayet||30||
vidyāt pittāvṛtaṃ svādutiktais taṃ bastibhir haret||31||

ab.seg: rāsnātailaṃ “rāsnāsahasraniryūhe” (ci.a.28) ity ādinā vihitaṃ ‘abhihitaṃ’ iti pā. vātavyādhāvuktam| pītadrutailaṃ ca pītadru-sauvīrakādidraveṇa ‘pītadravyasauvīrakādidraveṇa’ iti pā. sādhyam iti bruvate| tābhyām iti rāsnāpītadrutailābhyām||29-31||
phalatailaṃ pūrvavyāhṛtam eva jñeyam||32-33||

lg.l: kaṭūnāṃ lavaṇānāṃ ca kvāthaiś cūrṇaiś ca pācanam|
vireko mṛdur atrāmavihitā ca kriyā hitā||35||

ab.seg: āmaliṅgair iti āmalakṣaṇair ālasyādibhiḥ| āmavihitā kriyeti “āmaṃ praduṣṭam annābhibhūtaṃ ‘alasībhūtaṃ’ iti trividhakukṣīye pā. punar ullikhet” (vi.a.2) ity ādinā vihitā'nusartavyā||34-35||

snehaṃ viḍāvṛtam ity ādau vartibhir iti phalavartibhiḥ, kecit tu ‘bastibhiḥ’ iti paṭhanti| śyāmābilvādīni ca śyāmā ca bilvādīni daśamūlāni ca śyāmābilvādīni; kiṃ vā, śyāmādīny apy atra kalpoktāni nava gṛhyante; tair nirūhasya tathā'nuvāsanasya ca sādhanam iha jñeyam| udāvartahareṇeti trimarmīyoktodāvartacikitsitena||36-37||

lg.l: dhāvaty ūrdhvaṃ tataḥ kaṇṭhād ūrdhvebhyaḥ khebhya ety api||38||
chardighnībhiḥ kriyābhiś ca tasya kāryaṃ nivartanam||40||

ab.seg: abhukte ity ādihetutrayaṃ snehabaster ūrdhvagamanakāraṇaṃ jñeyaṃ; pūrvaṃ ca yady apy abhojanadānam eva kāraṇaṃ pratiśrutaṃ, tathā'py ekakāryatayā cikitsitasāmānyāc ca śūnyapāyutvātipīḍane apy atra hetutvenokte; śūnyapāyutvaṃ cādhonirodhākartṛtayā sneham ūrdhvaṃ nayati| ūrdhvebhyaḥ khebhya iti mukhanāsādibhyaḥ| etīti nirgacchati| apiśabdān mukhādinirgamanasya kādācitkatvaṃ darśayati| tatsiddhataila iti mūtraśyāmādisādhitatailena yuktaḥ| sānuvāsana iti tatsiddhatailena cānuvāsanaṃ deyam| āgacchata iti āgamanasamaya eva stambhādi kartavyam| stambhaḥ vyajanaśītajalasekādinā; kaṇṭhagrahaḥ ūrdhvagamanapratiṣedhārthaṃ kaṇṭhapīḍanam| chardighnīḥ kriyāḥ chardiścikitsite “mano 'bhighāte tu mano 'nukūlāḥ” ity ādinā “sukha eva jetum” (ci.a.20) ity antenoktā ‘sugandhimālāgrahaṇādikā ihodantopayuktāḥ’ iti pā. ihābhipretā jñeyāḥ||38-40||

lg.l: sarve 'lpo vā''vṛto raukṣyād upekṣyaḥ sa vijānatā||41||

ab.seg: vātādyāvṛtasnehapravartanam abhidhāya apravartanīyasneham āha- yasya nopadravam ity ādi| nopadravaṃ kuryād iti aniḥsṛto 'pi stambharugādīn ūrdhvoktān na kuryāt| alpo vā''vṛta iti stokaniḥsṛtaḥ, stokaś ca vṛtaḥ| vṛtasyāpi stambhādyupadravākaraṇe hetum āha- raukṣyād iti| tadā'tyartharūkṣatayā śarīrasya tiṣṭhann api sneho na vyāpadam āvahatīty arthaḥ; upekṣya iti na tatra yathoktavātāvṛtasnehacikitsā kartavyety arthaḥ; anyatrāpy uktam- “ahorātrād api snehaḥ pratyāgacchan na dūṣyati| kuryād bastiguṇāṃś cāpi jīrṇas tv alpaguṇo bhavet” (su.ci.a.37) iti||41||

lg.l: bhuktavān mātrayā bhojyam anuvāsyas tryahāt tryahāt||42||
vyuṣitāya niśāṃ kalyam uṣṇaṃ vā kevalaṃ jalam||43||
snehājīrṇaṃ jarayati śleṣmāṇaṃ tad bhinatti ca|
vamane ca vireke ca nirūhe sānuvāsane|

ab.seg: utpannavyāpatpratīkāram abhidhāyāvyāpannānuvāsanānuguṇaṃ bhojanam āha- yuktasneham ity ādi| yuktasneham iti avyāpannasneham iti bhāvaḥ| upasevanaṃ ‘upasevanaṃ vyañjanam’ iti pā. bhojanam| tryahād iti ‘tryahādividhānaṃ’ iti pā. vidhānaṃ prāyikam| dhānyety ādau ṣaḍaṅgavidhinā toyaṃ sādhanīyam| kalyam iti prabhāte| snehājīrṇam iti snehasyājīrṇaṃ koṣṭhopalepakam aṃśam||42-45||

lg.l: rūkṣanityas tu dīptāgnir vyāyāmī ‘…rbhṛśaṃ vyāyāmapīḍitaḥ’ iti pā. mārutāmayī|
eṣāṃ cāśu jarāṃ sneho yāty ambu sikatāsv iva|
ato 'nyeṣāṃ tryahāt prāyaḥ snehaṃ pacati pāvakaḥ||47||

ab.seg: pratyahānuvāsanīyān āha- rūkṣanityas tv ity ādi| vaṅkṣaṇaśroṇigataś ca tathodāvṛttaś ca vāto yeṣāṃ te vaṅkṣaṇaśroṇyudāvṛttavātāḥ| arhā iti anuvāsanārhāḥ| uktaṃ cānyatra- “rūkṣasya bahuvātasya snehabastiṃ dine dine| dadyād vaidyas tato 'nyeṣām agnyābādhabhayāt tryahāt” (su.ci.a.37) iti| pratyahadānatryahadānopapattim āha- eṣām ity ādi| tryahāt snehaṃ pacatīti pakvāśayopalepakaṃ ‘koṣṭho hyupalepakasnehaṃ’ iti pā. snehaṃ bahir niḥsṛtenoṣmaṇā pacati; yady apy atrāgninordhvasthitena tādṛśaḥ sambandhaḥ snehasya nāsti, tathā'pi jāṭharasyaiva ‘jaṭharasya bahirniḥsṛtenaivoṣmaṇā’ iti pā. vimiśritair avayavais tatpāko vaktavyaḥ| prāyaḥśabdena pañcāhapākam api darśayati, tena pañcāhadānam apy anuvāsane mandāgniṃ prati prāguktaṃ jñeyam, uktaṃ hi- “paratas tryahe vā dvyahe 'nuvāsyo 'hani pañcame vā” (si.a.10) iti||46-47||

lg.l: na tv āmaṃ praṇayet snehaṃ sa hy abhiṣyandayed gudam|
sāvaśeṣaṃ ca kurvīta vāyuḥ śeṣe hi tiṣṭhati||48||
na caiva gudakaṇṭhābhyāṃ dadyāt sneham anantaram|
ubhayasmāt ‘saṅgataḥ sa hyubhayato vātāgnī dūṣayet samam’ iti pā. samaṃ gacchan vātam agniṃ ca dūṣayet||49||

ab.seg: āmam iti apakvam| praṇayed iti anuvāsanaṃ dadyāt| sāvaśeṣaṃ kurvīteti na niḥśeṣaṃ dadyāt| gudakaṇṭhābhyām iti anuvāsanapānābhyām| anantaram iti ekakālam| vātam agniṃ ca dūṣayed iti atra vātadūṣaṇam ajīrṇajanakatayā vātāvaraṇāc ca jñeyam||48-49||

lg.l: tasmān nirūḍhaḥ saṃsnehyo ‘snehyaḥ syāt’ iti pā. nirūhyaś cānuvāsitaḥ|

ab.seg: nirūhānuvāsanayoḥ parasparāvyavadhānadāne doṣam āha- snehavastiṃ nirūhaṃ vety ādi| ekam eviti parasparānantaritam| utkleśaḥ kaphapittotkleśaḥ| nirūhāt pavanād bhayam iti nirantaranirūheṇa śarīrasya śodhanātiyogāt pavanād bhayaṃ bhavati| nirūḍhaḥ saṃsnehya iti nirūheṇa srotaḥsu śodhiteṣu kaphapittajaye kṛte snehavastir abhyasyaḥ; tathā'nuvāsitaś ca samyaganuvāsanena hi snigdhaḥ san nirūhya eva| evaṃ prayujyamānasnehanirūhayos tridoṣahantṛtvaṃ snehena vātajayān nirūheṇa kaphapittajayād bhavatīty āha- snehaśodhanety ādi| śodhanam iha nirūho 'bhipretaḥ||50-51||

karmavyāyāmabhārādhvayā(pā)nastrīkarṣiteṣu ca|
durbale vātabhagne ‘vātarugṇe’ iti pā. ca mātrābastiḥ sadā mataḥ||52||

anuvāsanaviśeṣasya mātrābaster viṣayaṃ pramāṇaṃ guṇāṃś ca yathākramam āha- karmety ādi| karmātra kandukacālanādi ‘kuddālapātanādi’ iti pā., vyāyāmaḥ dhanurākarṣaṇādiḥ| vātabhagne vātena pīḍite| sadeti pratyaham| hrasvāyā iti ardhāhaḥpariṇamanīyāyāḥ; uktaṃ hi- “ahorātram ahaḥ kṛtsnaṃ dinārdhaṃ ca pratīkṣate| uttamā madhyamā hrasvā snehamātrā jarāṃ prati” (sū.a.13) iti| tantrāntare snehamātrātrayaṃ pramāṇair evoktaṃ; yathā- “ṣaṭpalī tu bhavej jyeṣṭhā, madhyamā tripalī bhavet| kanīyasī sārdhapalā tridhā mātrā'nuvāsane” iti| suśrutenāpi bastipramāṇam uktaṃ; yathā anuvāsane- “tasyāpi vikalpo 'rdhārdhamātrāvakṛṣṭo 'parihāryo mātrābastiḥ” (su.ci.a.35) iti| anena ca sārdhapalamāno mātrābastir ukto bhavati; tatra hi ṣaṭpalaḥ snehabastir uktaḥ, anuvāsanaṃ tu tripalam| sukhopacaryam iti ceṣṭāhāraniyamābhāvād eva||52-54||

tatra ślokau-
vātādīnāṃ śamāyoktāḥ pravarāḥ snehabastayaḥ|
teṣāṃ cājñaprayuktānāṃ vyāpadaḥ sacikitsitāḥ||55||

lg.l: prāgbhojyaṃ snehabaster yad dhruvaṃ ye 'rhās tryahāc ca ye

ab.seg: saṅgrahe bhojyagrahaṇena dhānyanāgarajalādy api saṅgrāhyam| dhruvaṃ ye 'rhā iti pratyaham anuvāsanīyāḥ| vidhiś cokta iti ‘na tv āmaṃ praṇayet’ ity ādigranthokto 'rthaḥ||55-56||
ity agniveśakṛte tantre carakapratisaṃskṛte 'prāpte dṛḍhabalasampūrite siddhisthāne snehavyāpatsiddhir nāma caturtho 'dhyāyaḥ||4||
iti śrīcakrapāṇidattaviracitāyām āyurvedadīpikāyāṃ carakatātparyaṭīkāyāṃ siddhisthāne snehavyāpatsiddhir nāma caturtho 'dhyāyaḥ||4||

div.head: netrabastivyāpatsiddhiḥ

ab.seg: athāto netrabastivyāpatsiddhiṃ ‘netravyāpadikīṃ siddhiṃ’ iti pā. vyākhyāsyāmaḥ||1||
iti ha smāha bhagavān ātreyaḥ||2||

lg.l: atha netrāṇi bastīṃś ca śṛṇu varjyāni karmasu|
netrasyājñapraṇītasya vyāpadaḥ ‘doṣāṃśca sacikitsitān’ iti pā. sacikitsitāḥ||3||

ab.seg: snehavyāpatsiddhyabhidhānaprasaṅgāt snehadānasādhananalikādivyāpatpratīkārārthā netrabastivyāpatsiddhir ucyate| netragatā tathā bastipuṭakagatā ca vyāpat tathā netrāsamyakpraṇidhānajanyā ca yā vyāpadas tāsāṃ siddhiḥ; tena netrabastivyāpatsiddhiḥ duṣṭanetrabastipuṭakayoś ca vyāpatsiddhiḥ tayoḥ sadoṣatvena jñātvā parivarjanam||1-3||

lg.l: hrasvaṃ dīrghaṃ tanu sthūlaṃ jīrṇaṃ śithilabandhanam|
pārśvacchidraṃ ‘pārśvāśritaṃ’ iti pā. tathā vakram aṣṭau netrāṇi varjayet||4||
gudapīḍā gatir jihmā teṣāṃ doṣā yathākramam||5||

ab.seg: tad evāha- hrasvam ity ādi| netradoṣakathane aṣṭāv itipadam anuktakarkaśatvādidoṣāṇām atraivāntarbhāvopadarśanārtham| karkaśatvasya ‘karkaśaśabdasya’ iti pā. jīrṇena kartṛtvasāmyād agrahaṇam ‘kartavyasāmyāt’ iti pā.| evam anyatrāpi saṅkhyāvacane prayojanam iha varṇanīyam| tanu kṛśam| aprāptyādi yathākramaṃ hrasvanetrādiṣu jñeyam| atigatiḥ dūrapraveśaḥ| kṣobhaḥ gudapraviṣṭasyetastato gamanam| gudapīḍeti pārśvacchidranirgatena bastidraveṇa yogād gudapīḍā| jihmeti kuṭilā||4-5||

lg.l: snigdhaḥ klinnaś ca tān aṣṭau bastīn karmasu varjayet||6||

ab.seg: viṣamaḥ viṣamasaṃsthānaḥ, sthulaḥ atipramāṇaḥ, jālikaḥ sūkṣmānekacchidraḥ, vātalaḥ vātaduṣṭaḥ, sa cātra vihitasnehādeḥ phenilatvādinā niścīyate| snigdhaḥ atisnigdhaḥ| klinnaḥ śīrṇāvayavaḥ| gativaiṣamyādayo yathākramaṃ viṣamādiṣv aṣṭau doṣāḥ| visratvam āmagandhatā, daurgrāhyaṃ ‘vai grāhyaṃ’ iti pā. durgrahatā, cyutiḥ hastād bhraṃśaḥ, adhāryatvaṃ baster iti klinnatvād dhi dhāraṇāyogyatvaṃ bastipuṭakasya||6-7||

savātety ādayaḥ praṇetṛdoṣajanitāḥ praṇetṛdoṣā ucyante| tatra savātatā anucchvāsya baddhe bastau tathā niḥśeṣaṃ ca datte bhavati| atidrutatvam api praṇayane nirgamanena| utkṣiptatvam ūrdhvakṣiptatvam| tiryagiti tiryakpraṇidhānam| ulluptatvam iha pīḍanadoṣo yaḥ pīḍanavicchedaṃ kṛtvā punaḥ pīḍyate sa jñeyaḥ| kampitatvaṃ netrasya| atīti atipraṇayanaṃ netrasya| bāhyagaṃ gude na praviṣṭam auṣadham| mandatvaṃ ca pakvāśayāprāptatvam, etad dhi mandapīḍanād bhavati| ativegaḥ dūrapraveśād bhavati, sa cātipīḍanakṛtaḥ||8||

lg.l: anucchvāsya ca baddhe vā datte niḥśeṣa eva vā|
praviśya kupito ‘kṣubhitaḥ’ iti pā. vāyuḥ śūlatodakaro bhavet||9||
tatrābhyaṅgo gude svedo vātaghnāny aśanāni ca|10|

div.ab: etadvyāpadāṃ cikitsitāni pratyekam āha- anucchvāsyety ādi| ete cānucchvāsanādayo yady api pūrvam eva niṣiddhāḥ “subaddham ucchvāsya ca nirvalīkaṃ” (si.a.3) ity ādinaiva, tathā'pi pramādāt tathāprayoge sati jātavyāpadāṃ cikitsābhidhānārtham asmin prakaraṇe punar uktāḥ||9||-

lg.l: drutaṃ praṇīte niṣkṛṣṭe sahasotkṣipta eva vā||10||
bhojanaṃ tatra vātaghnaṃ snehāḥ svedāḥ sabastayaḥ||11||

ab.seg: drutam ity ādi| utkṣiptam api samānavyāpattikaratayaikagranthenaiva paṭhyate| niṣkṛṣṭe sahaseti cchedaḥ, utkṣepas tv asahasā'pi vyāpattikara eva| baster mūtrāśayasya stambho bastistambhaḥ| sabastaya iti vātaharabastiyuktāḥ||10-11||

lg.l: netre tad ṛju niṣkṛṣya saṃśodhya ca praveśayet||12||

ab.seg: tiryakpraṇidhānadoṣe 'bhidhātavye nalikāmukharodhi dravyāntaraṃ tatsamānavyāpattikaratvād ucyate| tiryagvalyāvṛtadvāre baddhe vā'pīti tiryakpraṇihite netre valyāvṛtadvāre sati tathā bastidravyagatasūtradravyādinā vibaddhe netre bastidravyaṃ na yāti; tan netraṃ tiryakpraṇihitaṃ niṣkṛṣya ṛju praveśayet, baddhadvāraṃ ca saṃśodhya praveśayed iti yojyam||12||

lg.l: uraḥśirortim ūrvoś ca ‘uraḥśirorujaṃ sādamūrvośca’ iti pā. sadanaṃ janayed balī||13||
syād dāho davathuḥ śophaḥ kampanābhihate gude||14||

div.ab: antarā mukte madhye vicchede kṛte| gude pratihato 'nila iti pīḍanavicchedajanito vāyur gudāt pratyāhataḥ| bilvādi daśamūlaṃ; śyāmādi śyāmātrivṛdādivirecanadravyam||13-14||-

lg.l: tatra sarpiḥ picuḥ kṣīraṃ picchābastiś ca śasyate||16||

ab.seg: atimātrapraṇīteneti punaḥ punaḥ praṇītena; anye tu duṣpraveśanam atimātrapraṇītam āhuḥ ‘dūrapraveśanaṃ’ iti pā.; atipraṇayanaṃ yady api grathitakarṇikāyā upari na bhavati, tathā'pi karṇikāpīḍayā gudapīḍanād atipraveśo jñeyaḥ| picchābastiḥ vakṣyamāṇaḥ||15-16||

lg.l: na ‘na vā vahati’ iti, ‘na ca dhāvati’ iti ca pā. bhāvayati mandas tu bāhyas tv āśu nivartate|
snehas tatra punaḥ samyak praṇeyaḥ siddhim icchatā||17||
atiprapīḍitaḥ koṣṭhe tiṣṭhaty āyāti vā galam|
tatra bastir virekaś ca galapīḍādi karma ca||18||

ab.seg: na bhāvayatīti pakvāśayaṃ na prāpnoti| atipīḍane koṣṭhe vā tiṣṭhatīti pakṣaḥ mandād atipīḍanād vātāvaraṇāc ca jñeyaḥ; galagamanaṃ tu tīvrātipīḍanād anāvaraṇāc ca bhavati| iyaṃ ca vyāpat pūrvādhyāye āhāraṃ vinā dattānuvāsanaviṣayatayoktā, iha tu nirūhasyānuvāsanasya cātipīḍanajanyatayā bodhyata iti viśeṣaḥ| iha bastir vireko vā koṣṭhasthe 'pravartamāne, kaṇṭhapīḍanādi tu galagate jñeyam||17-18||

tatra ślokaḥ-
netrabastipraṇetṝṇāṃ doṣān etān sabheṣajān|
vetti yas tena matimān bastikarmāṇi kārayet||19||
saṅgrahe teneti yathoktabheṣajābhijñabhiṣajā||19||
ity agniveśakṛte tantre carakapratisaṃskṛte 'prāpte dṛḍhabalasampūrite siddhisthāne netrabastivyāpatsiddhir nāma pañcamo 'dhyāyaḥ||5||
iti śrīcakrapāṇidattapraṇītāyām āyurvedadīpikāyāṃ carakatātparyaṭīkāyāṃ siddhisthāne netrabastivyāpatsiddhir nāma pañcamo 'dhyāyaḥ||5||

div.head: vamanavirecanavyāpatsiddhiḥ

ab.seg: athāto vamanavirecanavyāpatsiddhiṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ| iti ha smāha bhagavān ātreyaḥ||2||

vyāpatsiddhyabhidhānaprasaṅgād vamanavirecanayor api vyāpatsiddhir ucyate, bastivyāpatsiddhis tu vamanavirecanapūrvakatvād basteḥ paścād abhidhīyate; tena bastivyāpatsiddhyabhidhānena baster iha karmabhyaḥ prādhānyam api dyotitaṃ; bastiprādhānyaṃ “tasmāc cikitsārdham iti bruvanti sarvāṃ cikitsām api bastim eke” (si.a.1) ity anenoktam| atra cānāgatavyāpaccikitsārthatvād vamanavirecanayoḥ ‘cānāgatavyāpaccikitsārthameva vamana…’ iti pā. samyagvidhyabhidhānaṃ tena notsūtratā vamanavirecanavidhyabhidhānasya||1-2||

athety ādau samyag iti vidhiviśeṣaṇam| ūrdhvānulomayor iti vamanavirecanayoḥ| doṣān iti vyāpadaḥ| śodhanayoś ca vidhir yady api kalpanāsiddhyupakalpanīyādau tatra tatrābhihitaḥ, tathā'py anuktaviśeṣapratipādanārtham abhidhānaṃ, tatprasaṅgāc ca tatrāpy ukto 'rtha ucyate, sarvathā'nuktābhidhānaṃ ‘nātisnigdhān virecayet’ ity ādi jñeyam||3||

lg.l: tadantare ‘antareṣu prāvṛḍādyā jñeyāḥ sādhāraṇāstrayaḥ’ iti pā. prāvṛḍādyās teṣāṃ sādhāraṇās trayaḥ||4||

ab.seg: autsargikaṃ saṃśodhanayogyaṃ kālaṃ darśayann āha- atyuṣṇety ādi| atyuṣṇety ādi grīṣmādiṣu yathāsaṅkhyaṃ jñeyam| tadantare iti grīṣmādīnāṃ madhye| prāvṛḍādyā iti prāvṛṭśaradvasantāḥ| teṣāṃ sādhāraṇā iti uṣṇavarṣaśītānāṃ sādhāraṇāḥ; anudbhūtoṣṇavarṣaśītā iti yāvat||4||

lg.l: tapasyaś ca madhuś caiva vasantaḥ śodhanaṃ prati||5||
etān ṛtūn ‘etānṛtūn vicintyaivaṃ dadyāt’ iti, ‘etānṛtūn vikalpyātha’ iti ca pā. vikalpyaivaṃ dadyāt saṃśodhanaṃ bhiṣak|

ab.seg: prāvṛḍādīn māsavibhāgena darśayann āha- prāvṛṭ śucinabhāv ity ādi| śucinabhau āṣāḍhaśrāvaṇau| ūrjasahau kārtikamārgaśīrṣau| tapasyaḥ phālgunaḥ| madhu caitraḥ| śodhanaṃ pratīti śodhane kartavye 'yaṃ yathoktaḥ prāvṛḍādiṛtuvibhāgo bhavati; svasthavṛttau rasotpattau vā tasyāśitīyokta eva varṣāśaraddhemantaśiśiravasantagrīṣmarūpaḥ ṛtukramo bhavati| etān ṛtūn iti prāvṛḍādīn ṛtūn| vikalpyaivam iti yathoktamāsavibhāgena vyavasthāpya saṃśodhanaṃ dadyāt| etaduktasaṃśodhanāṅgartukramavibhāgenaiva carakasaṃskāra'pi navegāndhāraṇīye “mādhavaprathame māsi” (sū.a.7) ity ādinā granthena caitraśrāvaṇāgrahāyaṇeṣu vamanādisaṃśodhanam uktaṃ, tathā rogabhiṣagjitīye (vi.a.8) ca śiśiraṃ parityajya prāvṛḍādinaiva ṛtukramaḥ saṃśodhanāṅgatayoktaḥ; tena, rasabalotpādacintāyāṃ svasthavṛttānuṣṭhāneṣu ca śiśirādikramo bhavati, saṃśodhanavyavasthāyāṃ tu prāvṛḍādir iti prāvṛḍādikramo 'yaṃ saṃśodhanānukūlatayā''cāryeṇa kalpito na pāramārthikaḥ| ye tu, prāvṛḍādikramaṃ gaṅgāyā dakṣiṇe kūle, uttare 'pi śiśirādikramaṃ vadanti, tanmate ‘śodhanaṃ prati’ iti grantho 'nupapannaḥ; tena, “bhūyo varṣati parjanyo gaṅgāyā dakṣiṇe jalam| tena varṣāprāvṛḍākhyau ṛtū teṣāṃ prakalpitau ‘prakīrtitau’ iti pā. ” ity ādinā granthena yadi nāma deśabhedenāpi ṛtukramaḥ pāramārthiko 'bhidhīyate, tathā'pi nāsāv ācāryasyehābhimataḥ, prapañcitaś cāyam arthaḥ sūtrasthāna eva| ayaṃ ca śodhanakālopadeśo 'nātyayike vyādhau jñeyaḥ, ātyayike tu ūṣmādipratikāraṃ kṛtvā atyuṣṇe 'pi kāle saṃśodhanapravṛttir bhavaty eva, ukto hy ayam artho rogabhiṣagjitīye- “ātyayike tu punaḥ karmaṇi kāmam ṛtuṃ vikalpya kṛtrimaguṇopadhānena” (vi.a.8) ity ādinā granthena||5-6||

lg.l: karmaṇāṃ vamanādīnām antareṣv antareṣu ‘…mantare cāntare punaḥ’ iti pā. ca|

ab.seg: karmaṇām ity ādau antareṣv iti vamanānantaraṃ virecane kartavye virecanānantaraṃ vā bastau kartavye snehasvedau yathoktavidhānena punaḥ kartavyau, na sakṛt prayuktenaiva snehasvedena pañcakarmāṇi kartavyānīty arthaḥ| snehaṃ cānte prayojayed iti saṃśodhanakarmaparisamāptau saṃśodhanajanitaglāniparihārārthaṃ saṃśamanīyasnehaṃ prayojayed ity arthaḥ||7||
nātisnigdhān iti anatisnigdhakāyān narān||8||

lg.l: snehotkliṣṭaśarīrāya rūkṣaṃ ‘dadyādrūkṣaṃ virecanam’ iti pā. dadyād virecanam||9||

ab.seg: avaśyakartavye virecane sati atisnigdhāsnigdhayoḥ samyagyogakārakaṃ virecanaṃ darśayann āha- nātīty ādi| snehavirecanamiti snigdhaṃ virecanam ity arthaḥ| anatisnigdhe snehavirecanam anatisnigdhatvena kriyamāṇavirecanāyogapratiṣedhārtham; atisnigdhasya ‘atisnigdhe cātiyogaḥ śakyate, tatpratiṣedhārthaṃ rūkṣavirecanam’ iti pā. snehavirecanaṃ snehanaprakarṣād ativegaṃ gacchan pracalitān api doṣān nihantuṃ na śaknoti, doṣās tu tena virecanena svasthānāt pracyāvitā bhūyaḥ srotaḥsu līyante, tatpratiṣedhārthaṃ rūkṣaṃ virecanaṃ samyagyogakārakaṃ dadyād ity ayam āśayaḥ||9||

samyagyogakārikāṃ saṃśodhanasāmagrīmāha- snehasvedopapannenety ādi| mātrāvad iti ‘alpamātraṃ mahāvegaṃ’ ity ādinā vakṣyamāṇam alpamātrāvattvaṃ jñeyam| ekāgramanaseti saṃśodhanaikacittena, kāmādivyagramanaso hi vegavighātād ayogaḥ syāt||10||

lg.l: snigdhāt pātrād yathā toyam ayatnena praṇudyate|
ārdraṃ kāṣṭhaṃ yathā vahnir viṣyandayati sarvataḥ|
tathā snigdhasya vai doṣān svedo viṣyandayet sthirān||12||
snehasvedais tathotkleśya śodhyate śodhanair malaḥ ‘kṣārotkliṣṭe yathā vastre malaḥ śudhdyati vāriṇā| snehasvedaistathotkliṣṭo doṣaḥ śuddhyati śodhanaiḥ’ iti pā.||13||

ab.seg: snehasvedayoḥ phalaṃ ‘snigdhāt pātrāt’ ity ādinā bhūridṛṣṭāntena darśayan snehasvedayor avaśyakartavyatāṃ sūcayati| ayatneneti alpāyāsena| praṇudyante iti ākṛṣyante| viṣyandayati sarvata iti sarvataḥ sthitaṃ dravam ākarṣati| agnidṛṣṭāntena snigdhagātrasya samyagdoṣaharaṇam ucyate, tṛtīyadṛṣṭāntena tu snehasvedayor militayoḥ phalam ucyate| kliṣṭam iti mlānam| utkleśyeti kṣārāgnisambandhāt samutkleśya||11-13||

lg.l: ajīrṇe vardhate glānir vibandhaś cāpi jāyate|

ab.seg: śodhanasamyagyogasāmagryabhidhāne proktasnehasvedayoḥ phalam abhidhāya, kramāgatasya jīrṇe pītam ity asya viparyaye doṣam āha- ajīrṇe vardhate glānir iti; ajīrṇāvasthāyāṃ pīte śodhane sati glānir mahatī bhavati| viparītaṃ pravartate iti vamanam adho yāti, virecanaṃ cordhvaṃ yāti||14||

lg.l: avikāri ca vyāpattau nātiglānikaraṃ ca yat|

ab.seg: mātrāvad iti yad uktaṃ tad vivṛṇoti- alpamātram ity ādi| alpamātraṃ mahāvegam iti alpamātratve saty api praśastamahāvegam| avikārīti vyāpattāv api īṣadvikārakāri| mātrāvad iti praśastamātrāvat| yady api ca sukhāsvādādayo mātrāyāḥ phalaṃ na bhavanti, tathā'pīha mātrāyāḥ praśastatvena dravyasaṃskārādiviśeṣādhīnā api te gṛhyante; sukhādyāśrayadravyagatatvam api hi mātrāyāḥ prāśastyam iha; kiṃ vā, evambhūte eva saṃśodhane etan mātrāvattvaṃ paribhāṣitaṃ jñeyam||15-16||

lg.l: vidhūya mānasān doṣān kāmādīn aśubhodayān ‘kāmakrodhabhayādikān iti pā.|

ab.seg: ekāgramanaseti yad uktaṃ tad vivṛṇoti- vidhūyety ādi||17||

lg.l: naraḥ śvo vamanaṃ pātā bhuñjīta kaphavardhanam|

div.ab: vamanavirecanayoḥ pūrvadine yathā bhoktavyaṃ tad āha- nara ity ādi| etat prāguktam api prakaraṇavaśād viśeṣābhidhitsayā'bhidhīyate| pāteti pātukāmaḥ| dravabhūyiṣṭham iti cchedaḥ| virecanaṃ pātā laghu aśītaṃ ca bhuñjīteti sambandhaḥ| evambhūtabhojanopapattim āha- utkliṣṭety ādi| utkliṣṭālpakaphatveneti vamanaṃ prati utkliṣṭakaphatvena, virecanaṃ prati tv alpakaphatveneti vibhāgaḥ||18||-

lg.l: ūrdhvaṃ kaphānuge pitte viṭpitte 'nukaphe tv adhaḥ|

ab.seg: vamanavirecanayoḥ śuddhiliṅgāni yady api prāguktāni, tathā'pīha śeṣauṣadhamalādiviśeṣābhidhānārthaṃ punaḥ pītauṣadhasyety ādinā tāny abhidhatte| kaphānuge pitte ūrdhvahṛtadoṣaṃ ‘ūrdhvakṛtadoṣaṃ’ iti pā. vadet, viṭpitte cānukaphe dṛśyamāne 'dhohṛtadoṣaṃ ‘adhaḥkṛtadoṣaṃ’ iti pā. vaded iti yojanā; etat kaphāntatvaṃ virecanasya, vamanasya ca pittāntatvaṃ pūrvam eva vyāhṛtam| etat pittāntatvaṃ kaphāntatvaṃ vā'samyakśuddhe 'pi doṣasyānupūrvyā'vasthānād bhavatīti kṛtvā lakṣaṇāntarāṇy api etayoḥ sāhacaryeṇāha- kārśyadaurbalye cet salāghave iti||19-20||

lg.l: vāmayet tu tataḥ śeṣam auṣadhaṃ na tv alāghave|
ālāghavāt tanutvāc ca kaphasyāpat paraṃ bhavet|22|

div.ab: virecanayoge sāvaśeṣa evauṣadhe śuddhilakṣaṇadarśane sati kartavyam āha- vāmayet tu tataḥ śeṣam auṣadham iti; śuddhilakṣaṇe jāte śeṣam auṣadham upalabhya virecanātiyogapratiṣedhārthaṃ vāmayed ity arthaḥ| na tv alāghave ity anena lāghavavyatiriktaśeṣaśuddhilakṣaṇadarśane saty api na virecanaśeṣauṣadhavamiḥ kartavyā| vamanauṣadhaprayoge kartavyam āha- staimitye ity ādi| vamanauṣadhaprayoge yāvat staimityānilasaṅgau vartete, tāvan nirudgāre 'pi bheṣaje sati vamanaṃ kārayitavyam| etad vamanāvadhim āha- ālāghavāt tanutvāc ca kaphasyeti| pramādāl lāghavatanutvayoḥ parataḥ kriyamāṇavamanasya doṣam āha- āpat paraṃ bhaved iti; āpad iti atiyogalakṣaṇā| anye tu, staimitye ity ādinā'pi virecanauṣadhasyaivāvasthikaṃ vamanam ucyate ity āhuḥ||21||-

lg.l: vamite vardhate vahniḥ śamaṃ doṣā vrajanti hi||22||
tāni dṛṣṭvā tu peyādikramaṃ kuryān na laṅghanam||23||

ab.seg: yathoktavamanaphalam āha- vamite vardhate ity ādinā| samyagjīrṇaliṅgāny alakṣayann iti saṃśodhanabheṣajasya vakṣyamāṇasamyagjīrṇaliṅgāny alakṣayan| tānīti jīrṇauṣadhaliṅgāni||22-23||

lg.l: saṃśodhanābhyāṃ śuddhasya hṛtadoṣasya ‘laṅghitasya ca’ iti pā. dehinaḥ|
yāty agnir mandatāṃ ‘yātyagniraṇutāṃ’ iti pā. tasmāt kramaṃ peyādim ācaret||24||

ab.seg: śuddhasya peyādikramopapattim āha- saṃśodhanābhyām ity ādi| yady api nirūḍhasyāpy agnimāndyaṃ bhavati, tathā'pi nirūḍhasya tādṛg agnimāndyaṃ na bhavati yena peyādikramaḥ kriyate, ato nirūhavyudāsārthaṃ saṃśodhanābhyām iti dvivacanaṃ kṛtam| yā tu samyagviriktalakṣaṇe “ūrjo 'gniḥ” (si.a.1) ity anenāgnivṛddhir uktā, sā ca virecanauṣadhakṣobhātisaṅgāt kṛtā'gnimāndyāpekṣayā'gnivṛddhiḥ ‘virecanauṣadhajanyāśayakṣobhakṛtāgnimāndyāpekṣayaudaryāgnivṛddhiḥ’ iti śivadāsasenaḥ; teneha yāty agnir mandatām iti vacanena samaṃ na virodhaḥ||24||
tarpaṇādiviṣayam āha- kaphapitte ity ādi| viśuddhe 'lpam iti asamyagviśuddhe| tarpaṇādikrame ca peyāyāḥ sthāne svacchatarpaṇaṃ, vilepyāḥ sthāne ca ghanatarpaṇaṃ deyam||25||

lg.l: klamo dāho 'ṅgasadanaṃ bhramo mūrcchā ‘dāho'ṅgamardaśca bhramo mūrcchā'rucistathā’ iti pā. śirorujā|

ab.seg: jīrṇauṣadhaliṅgāny āha- anuloma ity ādi| ūrjaḥ balam| indriyaśuddhiḥ indriyapāṭavam| udgārasya cauṣadhagandhādivirahitvam eva śuddhiḥ||26-27||

lg.l: akāle 'lpātimātraṃ ca purāṇaṃ na ca bhāvitam|

ab.seg: yādṛśam auṣadhaṃ vyāpadyate tad āha- akāle ity ādi| alpaṃ vā atimātraṃ vā'lpātimātram| na ca bhāvitamiti svarasais tulyavīryair vā'bhāvitam||28||

lg.l: ādhmānaṃ parikartiś ca srāvo hṛdgātrayor grahaḥ|
ayogād atiyogāc ca daśaitā vyāpado matāḥ|

ab.seg: saṃśodhanāyogātiyogajanyā āviṣkṛtā vyāpadaḥ prāha- ādhmānam ity ādi| (ādhmānādayaś cāmī ayaṃ pāṭhaḥ kvacitpustake na paṭhyate nāvaśyam ayogātiyogānte bhavanti, tenopadravabhūtatvāt pṛthag uktāḥ|) etā vyāpadaḥ preṣyādivaiguṇyād utpannā ayogād atiyogāc ca bhavantīti vākyārthaḥ| tatrādhmānam ayogād bhavati, parikartikā tv atiyogāt, srāvo 'yogāt, hṛdgraho 'py ayogād eva, tathā'ṅgagraho 'yogāc ca bhavati, jīvādānam atiyogāt; vibhraṃśas tu gudabhraṃśa-sañjñābhraṃśa-kaṇḍvādilakṣaṇabhraṃśabhedāt trividho vaktavyaḥ; gudabhraṃśa-sañjñābhraṃśāv atiyogajanyau, śeṣas tu vibhraṃśo 'yogajanyaḥ; upadravo 'py ayogajanya eva, klamo 'py ayogajaḥ| eteṣāṃ cāyogātiyogajanyatvavibhāga uttaragranthe sphuṭo bhaviṣyati| yady api cāyogātiyogamithyāyogās tatra tatra kāraṇatvenoktāḥ, tathā'pīha vamanavirecanayor mithyāyogaṃ necchati; yato doṣāṇāṃ caturvidhaiva pravṛttir bhavati, yat- atipravṛtiḥ, asamyakpravṛttir vā, apravṛttiḥ, alpapravṛttir vā; tatrāpy apravṛttyalpavṛttī ayogagṛhīte eva; yā'pi cātra prātilomyena pravṛttiḥ, sā'pi doṣasyāpekṣitasyāpravartakatvād ayogagṛhītataiva; vakṣyati hi “ayogaḥ prātilomyena na cālpaṃ vā pravartanam” iti||29-30||

lg.l: ayogaḥ prātilomyena na cālpaṃ vā pravartanam||31||
śleṣmotkliṣṭena durgandham ahṛdyam ati vā bahu|
virecanam ajīrṇe ca pītam ūrdhvaṃ pravartate||32||
tīkṣṇaṃ pītaṃ sthitaṃ kṣubdhaṃ vamanaṃ syād virecanam||33||
prātilomyena doṣāṇāṃ haraṇāt te hy akṛtsnaśaḥ|
ayogasañjñe, kṛcchreṇa yāti doṣo na vā'lpaśaḥ||34||

ab.seg: yogātiyogāyogasvarūpam āha- yoga ity ādi| ativartanam iti saṃśodhyātiriktapravartanam| prātilomyeneti vamanasya virecanena, virecanasya vamanena pravartanam; etac ca prātilomyapravartanaṃ ‘yadā gacchati cālpaśaḥ’ iti, ‘navā gacchati cālpaśaḥ’ iti ca pā. prāyo vivakṣitadoṣāpravartakatayaivāyoganikṣiptam| na cālpaṃ vā pravartanam iti sarvathā'pravartanam alpaṃ vā pravartanam iti| sthitam iti jhaṭiti ūrdhvaṃ gacchat ‘sthitaṃ’ iti pā.| etatprātilomyapravṛttyā yathā'yogatvaṃ tad āha- prātilomyenety ādi| prātilomyenākṛtsnaharaṇāt ayogasañjñe te iti yojyam| prātilomyaharaṇe 'kṛsnadoṣaharaṇam eva darśayann āha- kṛcchreṇety ādi| pratilomaharaṇe kṛtsno doṣo na yāti, alpaśo vā yātīti bhāvaḥ; tenākṛtsnadoṣaharaṇaṃ pratilomaharaṇe upapannam iti bhāvaḥ| ‘kṛcchreṇa yad āgacchati cālpaśa’ iti pāṭhe, yacchabdo hetau; pūrvatra pāṭhe vā śabdo hetau||31-34||

lg.l: pītauṣadho na śuddhaś cej jīrṇe tasmin punaḥ pibet|
auṣadhaṃ na tv ajīrṇe 'nyad bhayaṃ syād atiyogataḥ||35||
koṣṭhasya gurutāṃ jñātvā laghutvaṃ balam eva ca|
ayoge mṛdu vā dadyād auṣadhaṃ tīkṣṇam eva vā||36||

ab.seg: ādhmānādīnām ayogātiyogau kāraṇatvenoktau, tena kāraṇayor ayogātiyogayoḥ prathamaṃ hetuliṅgacikitsitāni prāha- pītauṣadha ity ādi| jīrṇe iti auṣadhe jīrṇe| punaḥ pibed iti tadahar eva| bhayaṃ syād atiyogata iti pūrvājīrṇauṣadhanavīnauṣadhābhyām atiyogaḥ syāt| mṛdu vā dadyād ity ādau gurukoṣṭhe balavati tīkṣṇaṃ, laghukoṣṭhe durbale ca mṛdu dadyād iti vyavasthā||35-36||

lg.l: vamanaṃ na tu duśchardaṃ duṣkoṣṭhaṃ ‘duśchardyāṃ mṛdukoṣṭhe’ iti pā. na virecanam|
pāyayetauṣadhaṃ bhūyo hanyāt pītaṃ punar hi tau||37||

ab.seg: punarvamanavirecanādānaviṣayau prāha- vamanaṃ na tv ity ādi| punaḥ ‘punaḥ pītaṃ bhūyo hanyādityarthaḥ’ iti pā. pītaṃ tu hanyād ity arthaḥ||37||

lg.l: doṣān utkliśya nirhartum aśaktaṃ janayed gadān||38||
vibhraṃśaṃ śvayathuṃ hikkāṃ tamaso darśanaṃ bhṛśam ‘tṛṣāṃ’ iti pā.|

ab.seg: stokapravṛttirūpam ayogaṃ kāraṇabhedenāha- asnigdhety ādi| asnigdhasyeti asamyaksnigdhasya| rūkṣasyeti na manāg api snigdhasya| anavam iti jīrṇatayā mandavīryam| nirhartum iti niḥśeṣeṇa hartum| vibhraṃśam iti viparītapravṛttisāmarthyam||38-39||

lg.l: śītair vā stabdham āme vā doṣān utkliśya nāharet||40||
tān eva janayed rogān ayogaḥ sarva eva saḥ|
vijñāya matimāṃs tatra yathoktāṃ kārayet kriyām||41||
pāyayeta punar jīrṇe samūtrair vā nirūhayet||42||
snigdhaṃ vātaharaiḥ snehaiḥ punas tīkṣṇena śodhayet|
na cātitīkṣṇena tato hy atiyogas tu jāyate||44||

ab.seg: aparam ayogam āha- snigdhasvinnasya cety ādi| jīrṇam iti alpatvād dīptāgnitvāc ca jīrṇam| āme iti apakve doṣe, ‘pītaṃ’ iti śeṣaḥ| ete 'trāyogalakṣaṇatrayeṇa ye pratipāditā gadā na te bhinnasāmagrījanyā bhinnacikitsā vā, tena na pūrvam ayogajanyavyāpattiprastāve paṭhitāḥ; evam atiyogalakṣaṇatayā vakṣyamāṇagadeṣv api vācyam| yathoktam iti ‘pītauṣadho na śuddhaś cet’ ity ādinoktaṃ; kiṃ vā'gre ‘taṃ taila’ ity ādigranthenoktam| pāyayeteti saṃśodhanaṃ pāyayeta| dhānvair iti dhanvamṛgapakṣimāṃsarasaiḥ||40-44||

lg.l: balasvarakṣayaṃ dāhaṃ kaṇṭhaśoṣaṃ bhramaṃ ‘klamaṃ’ iti pā. tṛṣām|
kuryāc ca madhurais tatra śeṣam auṣadham ullikhet||46||
vamane tu virekaḥ syād vireke vamanaṃ punaḥ ‘mṛdu’ iti pā.|
śuṅgābhir vā vaṭādīnāṃ siddhāṃ peyāṃ samākṣikām|
varcaḥsāṅgrāhikaiḥ siddhaṃ kṣīraṃ bhojyaṃ ca dāpayet||50||
jāṅgalair vā rasair bhojyaṃ picchābastiś ca śasyate|

ab.seg: atiyogasya hetvādikam āha- atitīkṣṇam ity ādi| iyaṃ ca sāmagrī virecanātiyogasyaiva ghaṭate; yato mṛdukoṣṭhe bubhukṣite ca viṭpittakaphaharaṇakrameṇa ca saivātiyujyate ‘tadevātiyujyate’ iti pā.; vamanātiyogasāmagrī cānenodāharaṇenonneyā; kiṃ vā, atitīkṣṇam iti padenaiva vamanasyāpy atitīkṣṇatvam atiyogakāraṇam uktaṃ, viṭpittakaphaharaṇaṃ yathāyogyatayā krameṇa virecane vamane ca boddhavyam| śeṣam auṣadham ullikhed iti tādātvikī cikitsā| mṛdv itipadaṃ vamanena virecanena ca sambadhyate| vaṭādīnām iti nyagrodhodumbarāśvatthakapītanānām| varcaḥsaṅgrāhikāḥ ṣaḍvirecanaśatāśritīyoktāḥ priyaṅgvanantādayaḥ||45-51||

lg.l: pibet kaphaharair manthaṃ ‘phalarasairmanthaṃ’ iti pā. saghṛtakṣaudraśarkaram||52||
phalāny amlāni khādeyus tasya cānye 'grato narāḥ|
yavāgūṃ tanukāṃ dadyāt ‘tanvīṃ dadyādyavāgūṃ ca’ iti pā. snehasvedau ca buddhimān||56||

ab.seg: purato 'mlaphalakhādanaṃ mukhasrāvaṇena jihvāstabdhatvaṃ hantum ‘hanyāt’ iti pā.| atiyoge niḥsṛtām iti jihvāviśeṣaṇam||52-56||

lg.l: vamitaś ca viriktaś ca mandāgniś ca vilaṅghitaḥ|
agniprāṇavivṛddhyarthaṃ kramaṃ peyādikaṃ bhajet ‘peyādimācaret’ iti pā.||57||

ab.seg: atiyoge 'pi yathā peyādikramo bhavati tad āha- vamitaś cety ādi| atiharaṇād ativamito 'tiviriktaś ceti boddhavyam||57||

lg.l: sodāvartasya cotkliśya doṣān mārgān nirudhya ca||58||

ab.seg: ayogātiyogayor ādhmānādivyāpadāṃ yathākramaṃ hetuliṅgacikitsādi nirdiśann āha- bahudoṣasyety ādi| etāś ca vyāpado nāvaśyam atiyogāyogayor bhavanti, upadravabhūtatvāt ‘upadravarūpatvāt’ iti pā.; ata evopakalpanīye- “atiyogāyoganimittān imān upadravān vidyāt”- “ādhmānaṃ parikartikā”(sū.a.15) ity ādinā granthena etā daśa vyāpadaḥ pratipāditāḥ||58-60||

lg.l: pītaṃ gatvā gudaṃ sāmam āśu doṣaṃ nirasya ca|
laṅghanaṃ pācanaṃ ‘dīpanaṃ’ iti pā. sāme rūkṣoṣṇaṃ laghubhojanam|
bṛṃhaṇīyo vidhiḥ sarvaḥ kṣāmasya madhuras tathā||63||

ab.seg: parikartikām āha- snigdhenety ādi| pītaṃ gatvā gudam ity ādi virecanātiyogajanyaparikartikāyāṃ saṅgataṃ, na vamanātiyogajanyaparikartikāyām; upakalpanīye ca sākṣād vamanāyogātiyogajanyatayaivādhmānādaya uktāḥ, tenānukto 'pi vamanavyāpattau parikarto 'nenodāharaṇena ‘anilodāharaṇena’ iti, ‘'nehodāharaṇena’ iti ca pā. kalpanīyaḥ; tantrāntare 'py uktaṃ- ‘yā tu parikartikā virecane, tad vamane kaṇṭhakarṣaṇaṃ; yo 'dhaḥparisrāvo virecane, sa vamane kaphaprasekaḥ” (su.ci.a.34) iti; tad anayā diśā ādhmānādīni vamanavirecanayor ayogātiyogajanyatayā vyākhyātānīty eke| āśu doṣaṃ nirasyeti vamanātiyogajanyeyaṃ vyāpat| atra laṅghanādikriyā atiyoge saty apy āmapācanāya jñeyā| kṣāmeṇa mṛdukoṣṭhenety ādisamprāptijanitasya kṣāmapuruṣaprabhavasya laṅghanapācanādyam upakrāntam eva||61-63||

lg.l: āme jīrṇe 'nubandhaś cet kṣārāmlaṃ laghu śasyate|
dadhy amlaṃ bhojane ‘dadhyannaṃ bhojanaṃ’ iti pā. pāne saṃyuktaṃ dāḍimatvacā||65||
kaṣāyamadhuraṃ śītaṃ ‘bastiṃ’ iti pā. picchābastim athāpi vā|

ab.seg: āmāvasthākartavyam āha- āme jīrṇa ity ādi| kṣārāmlaṃ laghu śasyata iti atīsāre yad uktaṃ- “cāṅgerīkoladadhyamlanāgarakṣārasaṃyutam| ghṛtaṃ” (ci.a.19) iti; laghumātraṃ ca śasyata iti jñeyam| puṣpakāsīsam ity atra puṣpaśabdena kecit sāṅgrāhikāni dhātakīkusumādīni grāhayanti||64-67||

lg.l: alpaṃ tu bahudoṣasya doṣam utkliśya bheṣajam|
alpālpaṃ srāvayet kaṇḍūṃ śophaṃ kuṣṭhāni gauravam||68||
parisrāvaḥ sa, taṃ doṣaṃ śamayed vāmayed api||69||
snehitaṃ vā punas tīkṣṇaṃ pāyayet virecanam|

ab.seg: alpam ity ādinā parisrāvam āha| śamayed vāmayed apīty ādau alpadoṣe śamanaṃ, bahudoṣe ūrdhvagatadoṣe tu vamanam iti vyavasthā| vāmayed apīty atrāpi snehitaṃ punar iti sambadhyate| cūrṇāsavāriṣṭā grahaṇyarśaścikitsādiṣu jñeyāḥ||68-70||

lg.l: kupitā hṛdayaṃ gatvā ghoraṃ kurvanti hṛdgraham||71||
na gacched vibhramaṃ tatra vāmayed āśu taṃ bhiṣak|
kāyāgniṃ ca balaṃ cāsya krameṇotthāpayet tataḥ ‘krameṇābhipravardhayet’ iti pā.||74||

ab.seg: pītauṣadhasyety ādinā hṛdgraham āha| na gacched vibhramaṃ tatreti hṛdgrahapīḍito 'yaṃ mriyamāṇo vā'yam iti bhrāntiṃ na gacched ity arthaḥ| vamanaṃ cātra mūrcchite duḥśakaprayogaṃ, tena mūrcchārambha eva vamanaṃ kārayitavyaṃ; kiṃ vā mūrcchāyām apy aṅgulīpraveśādinā vamanaṃ kārayitavyam| pittamūrcchārtam iti pittaprabaladoṣajanitamūrcchārtam| ativamata iti vamanāyātipravāhaṇaṃ kurvataḥ| pittakaphe 'nyatheti pitte kaphe vā hṛdayapīḍākare snigdhāmlalavaṇaviparītaṃ rūkṣatiktakaṭukādikramaṃ kuryāt||71-75||

lg.l: ruddho 'ti ‘ruddho'tīva viśuddhasya’ iti pā. vā viśuddhasya gṛhṇāty aṅgāni mārutaḥ||76||
tatra vātaharaṃ sarvaṃ snehasvedādi kārayet ‘śasyate’ iti pā.||77||

ab.seg: pītauṣadhasyety ādinā aṅgagrahaṇam ayogajam atiyogajaṃ cāha| kaphena vā ruddho doṣaḥ punar aṅgāni nigṛhṇāti; śuddhasya vā mārutaḥ kupito 'ṅgāni pratigṛhṇāti stambhādibhiḥ||76-77||

lg.l: doṣān hṛtvā vinirmathya jīvaṃ harati śoṇitam||78||
tenānnaṃ miśritaṃ dadyād vāyasāya śune 'pi vā|
bhuṅkte tac ced vadej jīvaṃ na bhuṅkte pittam ādiśet||79||
śuklaṃ vā bhāvitaṃ vastram āvānaṃ koṣṇavāriṇā|
prakṣālitaṃ vivarṇaṃ syāt pitte ‘pittaṃ śuddhaṃ tu śoṇitam’ iti pā. śuddhaṃ tu śoṇite||80||
tasya pittaharīṃ sarvām atiyoge ca yā hitā ‘matā’ iti pā.||81||
pibej jīvābhisandhānaṃ jīvaṃ tad dhy āśu gacchati ‘pāyayetāśu sandhānaṃ jīvo jīvena gacchati’ iti pā.||82||
tad eva darbhamṛditaṃ raktaṃ bastiṃ pradāpayet|

ab.seg: atitīkṣṇam ity ādinā jīvādānamāha| laghudoṣasyeti svalpadoṣasya| vinirmathyeti śoṇitam eva kṣobhayitvā ‘kṣodayitvā’ iti pā.| jīvam iti jīvanahetudhāturūpaṃ śoṇitam| śoṇitaṃ kiñcid raktapittakṣobhād bhavati, kiñcic ca jīvaśoṇitaṃ bhavati; tadviśeṣaparīkṣārtham āha- tenānnam ity ādi| pittam ādiśed iti śoṇitagataṃ pittam ādiśed raktapittam iti yāvat| āvānam iti śuṣkam| pitte iti raktapitte sati kṣālitaṃ vastraṃ vivarṇaṃ bhavati, jīvaśoṇite tu sati śuddhaṃ vastraṃ bhavati| parīkṣā ca cikitsābhedārtham eva; raktapitte raktapittaharī kriyā, jīvaśoṇitaṃ tu dṛṣṭvā ‘tṛṣṇāmūrcchāmadārtasya’ ity ādinoktā kartavyā| atiyoge ca yā hiteti atraiva ‘pariṣekāvagāhādyaiḥ suśītaiḥ stambhayec ca tam’ ity ādinoktā jñeyā| jīvaṃ tad dhy āśu gacchatīti asṛkprabhāvād āśv eva śoṇitarūpatāṃ yāti sadyaskam asṛk| śyāmety ādau śyāmā priyaṅguḥ||78-84||

lg.l: gudaṃ bhraṣṭaṃ kaṣāyaiś ca stambhayitvā praveśayet|
vamanaṃ bheṣajāntaṃ vā doṣān utkliśya nāvahet||86||
tadā kurvanti kaṇḍvādīn doṣāḥ prakupitā gadān|
sa vibhraṃśo matastatra syād yathāvyādhi bheṣajam||87||

ab.seg: gudaṃ bhraṣṭam ity ādinā gudabhraṃśarūpaṃ vibhraṃśam āha| kaṣāyair iti kaṣāyarasaiḥ| sāmety ādinā sañjñāvibhraṃśarūpavibhraṃśacikitsām āha| sāma sāntvanam| gāndharvaśabdo gītam| etau ca vibhraṃśāv atiyogajanyau| yadety ādinā tṛtīyam ayogajanyavibhraṃśam āha| viḍantam avatiṣṭhata iti malamātram apahṛtyāvatiṣṭhate| bheṣajāntam iti bheṣajamātraṃ vamanenāvatiṣṭhate| nāvahed iti nāpaharati| etadvyāpadaś ca vibhraṃśasañjñā pāribhāṣikī| yathāvyādhibheṣajam iti kaṇḍvādiviparītaṃ bheṣajam||85-87||

lg.l: pītaṃ snigdhena sasnehaṃ tad doṣair mārdavād vṛtam|
na vāhayati doṣāṃs tu svasthānāt stambhayec cyutān||88||
tīkṣṇaṃ bastiṃ virekaṃ vā so 'rho laṅghitapācitaḥ||89||

ab.seg: pītaṃ snigdhenety ādinā stambham āha| mārdavād vṛtam iti bheṣajasya mṛdutayā doṣair vṛtam| svasthānāc cyutān stambhayed iti yojanīyam| so 'rha iti laṅghanapācanānantaraṃ tīkṣṇaṃ bastiṃ virekaṃ vā tīkṣṇam arhatīty arthaḥ||88-89||

rūkṣam ity ādinā upadravān āha| yady apy ādhmānādayo 'py amī upadravā eva, tathā'pi teṣāṃ sañjñāntareṇaiva gṛhītatvāc chūlādaya eva upadravaśabdābhihitāḥ| śūlādayaś cāmī pradhānāny uttarakālabhāvitvād anupadravarūpā apy upadravaśabdenocyante; yathā- “dhūmaḥ kuryād upadravān” (sū.a.5) iti; kiṃ vā, ayogākhyasya vyādher amī upadravā iti jñeyam||90-91||

lg.l: pittaṃ vātaṃ ca saṃrudhya satandrāgauravaṃ klamam||92||
daurbalyaṃ cāṅgasādaṃ ca kuryād āśu tad ullikhet|
laṅghanaṃ pācanaṃ cātra ‘kāle’ iti pā. snigdhaṃ tīkṣṇaṃ ca śodhanam||93||

ab.seg: snigdhasyety ādinā klamam āha| kaphaṃ pittaṃ cotkliśya vātaṃ ca tābhyām eva saṃrudhya bheṣajaṃ tandrādiyuktaṃ klamaṃ kuryāt| tad ullikhed iti tad bheṣajaṃ kaphapittaṃ collikhed ity arthaḥ||92-93||

tatra ślokau-
ity etā vyāpadaḥ proktāḥ sarūpāḥ sacikitsitāḥ|
vamanasya virekasya kṛtasyākuśalair nṛṇām ‘virecanasyākuśalairdattasya vamanasya ca’ iti pā.||94||

lg.l: etā ‘dhīmān vijñāya tāstasmādavasthāścaiva tattvataḥ’ iti pā. vijñāya matimān avasthāś caiva tattvataḥ|
dadyāt ‘kuryāt’ iti pā. saṃśodhanaṃ samyag ārogyārthī ‘samyagārogyārthaṃ’ iti pā. nṛṇāṃ sadā||95||

ab.seg: ity etā ity ādinā adhyāyārthasaṅgrahaṃ darśayitvā vyāpadutpādahetum āha| dadyāt saṃśodhanaṃ samyag iti tathā saṃśodhanaṃ dadyād yathā vyāpado notpadyanta evety arthaḥ||94-95||
ity agniveśakṛte tantre carakapratisaṃskṛte 'prāpte dṛḍhabalasampūrite siddhisthāne vamanavirecanavyāpatsiddhir nāma ṣaṣṭho 'dhyāyaḥ||6||
iti śrīcakrapāṇidattaviracitāyām āyurvedadīpikāyāṃ carakatātparyaṭīkāyāṃ siddhisthāne vamanavirecanavyāpatsiddhi(saṃśodhanavyāpatsiddhi)rnāma ṣaṣṭho 'dhyāyaḥ||6||
athāto bastivyāpatsiddhiṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ||1||
iti ha smāha bhagavān ātreyaḥ||2||
vamanavirecanānantarabhāvitvād basteḥ saṃśodhanavyāpatsiddher anantaraṃ bastivyāpatsiddhir ucyate; atra bastiśabdo nirūha eva vartate, tadvyāpadām evātra vaktavyatvāt||1-2||

lg.l: kā cikitsā iti praśnāñ chrutvā tān abravīd guruḥ||4||
pravāhikā śiroṅgārtiḥ parikartaḥ ‘parikartiḥ’ iti pā. parisravaḥ||5||
āsām ekaikaśo rūpaṃ cikitsāṃ ca nibodhata||6||

ab.seg: kāḥ katīty ādi pañca praśnāḥ| nātiyogāv ity ādinā ādyapraśnasyottaram| nātiyogāv iti ayogātiyogau| etaddvādaśavyāpadāṃ ca vivaraṇa eva sphuṭārtho bhaviṣyati| asamyagyogasambhavā iti nirūhasyāyogātiyogamithyāyogarūpāsamyagyogasambhavāḥ| anena ca samutthānapraśnasya sāmānyakāraṇābhidhānenottaraṃ dattaṃ bhavati| atra bastiprayogasyāsamyagyogena nirūhakāryadoṣaharaṇasyātiyogāyogau vyāpattirūpau janyete klamādayo 'pi cātiyogāyogajātā eva viśiṣṭahetulakṣaṇacikitsitatayā ihāpi pṛthag ucyante, yathā saṃśodhane ādhmānādayo 'yogātiyogajātā api pṛthag uktāḥ| kecit ‘nātiyogāt klamādhmāne’ ity ādi, tathā ‘daśaitā vyāpado basteḥ’ ity ādi paṭhanti; tatra pūrvādhyāyoktavyākhyānād artho neyaḥ ‘artha unneyaḥ’ iti pā.; kintu pūrva eva pāṭho nirvyūhaḥ| āsām ity ādau rūpaśabdenaiva prati prati vakṣyamāṇahetuviśeṣo 'varuddho jñeyaḥ, yena hetur api hi vyāsagamakatayā rūpam eva||3-6||

lg.l: bastiḥ saṅkṣobhya taṃ doṣaṃ durbalatvād anirharan|
surādimūtravān ‘surāmūtrādinā’ iti pā. bastiḥ saprākpeṣyas tam ānayet||11||

ab.seg: gurukoṣṭhe iti krūrakoṣṭhe malapūrṇakoṣṭhe vā| alpaśabdo mātrāntaiḥ pratyekaṃ sambadhyate| uṣṇāyāḥ pramathyāyā iti atīsāroktapramathyānāṃ yā pramathyā uṣṇā tasyāḥ prayogaḥ; pramathyeti pācanakaṣāyasyāyurvedasamayasiddhasañjñeti pratipāditam evātīsāre| kālaṃ jñātveti virecanayogyāvasthāṃ jñātvā| surādimūtravān ity atra ādiśabdena sauvīrakatuṣodakādīnāṃ grahaṇam| saprākpeṣya iti bastisūtrīyoktabalādibastyuktakalkayuktaḥ| tam ānayed iti ayogakārakaṃ vibaddhaṃ bastiṃ harati||7-11||

lg.l: tasya liṅgaṃ cikitsā ca śodhanābhyāṃ samā bhavet||12||
pṛśniparṇīṃ sthirāṃ padmaṃ kāśmaryaṃ madhukaṃ balām|
piṣṭvā drākṣāṃ madhūkaṃ ‘madhukotpalam’ iti pā. ca kṣīre taṇḍuladhāvane||13||
vinīya saghṛtaṃ bastiṃ dadyād dāhe 'tiyogaje ‘…ddāhātiyogine’ iti pā.||14||

ab.seg: ayogam abhidhāyātiyogam āha- snigdhasvinne ity ādi| atiyujyate iti atiyogakārako bhavati| śodhanābhyāṃ samā bhaved iti vamanavirecanātiyogoktaliṅgacikitsitābhyāṃ samā bhavet| bastyatiyogaje dāhe viśiṣṭacikitsām āha- pṛśniparṇīm ity ādi| atra kṣīrādiṣu pañcadraveṣu kalkasya vilayanam| drākṣādiprasādāḥ śītakaṣāyavidhikṛtā jñeyāḥ||12-14||

lg.l: āmaśeṣe ‘āmadoṣe’ iti pā. nirūheṇa mṛdunā ‘mūrcchayatyanilaṃ mārgaṃ ruṇaddhyagniṃ hinasti ca’ iti pā. doṣa īritaḥ|
mārgaṃ ruṇaddhi vātasya hanty agniṃ mūrcchayaty api||15||
klamaṃ vidāhaṃ ‘sadāhaṃ’ iti pā. hṛcchūlaṃ mohaveṣṭanagauravam|
kuryāt svedair virūkṣais taṃ pācanaiś cāpy upācaret||16||
peyāḥ prasannayā vā syur ariṣṭenāsavena vā||18||
dāru trikaṭukaṃ ‘trikaṇṭakaṃ’ iti pā. pathyāṃ palāśaṃ citrakaṃ śaṭīm|
piṣṭvā kuṣṭhaṃ ca mūtreṇa pibet kṣārāṃś ca dīpanān||19||
bastim asya vidadhyāc ca samūtraṃ dāśamūlikam|

ab.seg: āmaśeṣe ity ādinā klamam āha| āmaśeṣe sati dattena nirūheṇa doṣa īrita iti yojyam| doṣaśabdena cātra pittakaphāv āmasahitau mārgāvarakāv ucyete| mūrcchayatīti mārgāvarodhāt kopayati| mārgaṃ ruṇaddhīti dehe srotāṃsi ruṇaddhi| ye tu, doṣaśabdeneha kaphamātraṃ grāhayanti, tanmate sadāhatvaṃ klamasyāpy anupapannam| vacety ādau mūrcchitā iti āloḍitāḥ| kṣārāṃś ca dīpanān iti grahaṇīcikitsādyuktān| dāśamūlikam iti “dvipañcamūlasya raso 'mlayuktaḥ” (si.a.3) ity ādinoktaṃ; kiṃ vā daśamūlakvāthakṛtam| mādhutailikaḥ vakṣyamāṇaḥ||15-20||

lg.l: bastir doṣāvṛto ruddhamārgo rundhyāt ‘bastirdoṣāvṛtastūrdhvamadho rundhyāt’ iti pā. samīraṇam||21||
ruṇaddhi hṛdayaṃ śūlair itaś cetaś ca dhāvati|
karāṅguṣṭhanibhāṃ vartiṃ yavamadhyāṃ nidhāpayet ‘praveśayet’ iti pā.||24||

ab.seg: alpavīrya ity ādinā ādhmānam āha| ruddhamārga iti nivāritādhomārgaḥ; sa cānilaṃ ruṇaddhi, anilaś ca ruddhamārgatayā ādhmānaṃ karotīti| marmapīḍanam ity ādhmānaviśeṣaṇam| ruṇaddhi hṛdayaṃ śūlair iti śūlair hṛdayaṃ vyāpnoti| śyāmāphalādibhir iti śyāmādibhir navabhiḥ, phalādibhiś ca ṣaḍbhiḥ kalpasthānoktaiḥ| dhūmaśabdeneha gṛhadhūmagrahaṇam| guḍaś cātra ‘guḍasyātra pṛthak palam’ iti pā. tāvanmātro bhavati yāvatā vartiḥ kartuṃ yujyate| karāṅguṣṭhety atra karagrahaṇaṃ pādāṅguṣṭhaniṣedhārtham| athavety ādinoktadvitīyavartāv api vartitvasampattyarthaṃ guḍo deyaḥ| bilvādibhiś ca nirūha iti “bilvamūlatrivṛddāruyavakolakulatthavān” ity ādinoktaḥ| saralety ādau siddham ity atra ‘tailaṃ’ iti śeṣaḥ||21-26||

lg.l: kuryād dhikkāṃ, hitaṃ tasmai hikkāghnaṃ bṛṃhaṇaṃ ca yat||27||
kṛṣṇālavaṇayor akṣaṃ pibed uṣṇāmbunā yutam ‘uṣṇāmbunā'kṣaḥ pippalyā hito lavaṇasaṃyutaḥ’ iti pā.|

ab.seg: mṛdv ity ādinā hikkām āha| atinirharann iti atiyogena doṣān nirharan| hikkāghnam iti hikkācikitsoktaṃ bheṣajam| hikkāyāṃ ca yady api “prasaktacchardiniṣṭhīvikākāsaśvāsahikkārtānām ūrdhvībhūto vāyur ūrdhvaṃ bastiṃ nayet” (si.a.2) ity anena bastir niṣiddhaḥ, tathā'pīha viśiṣṭahikkāyām anuvāsanasya hitatvāt, “balāsthirādi” ity ādinoktam anuvāsanam anavadyam| vātanud iti padaṃ liṅgavipariṇāmena dhūmādibhiś ca sambadhyate; tena vātahitānām evātra dhūmādīnāṃ prayogaḥ||27-29||

lg.l: atitīkṣṇaḥ savāto vā na vā samyak prapīḍitaḥ|
śṛtair bastir hitaḥ siddhaṃ vātaghnaiś cānuvāsanam||31||

ab.seg: atitīkṣṇa ity ādinā hṛtprāptim āha| savātatvaṃ baster niḥśeṣadānādinā jñeyam| asamyakpīḍitatvam eva hṛtprāptijanakatayā jñeyam| lavaṇaskandhaḥ rogabhiṣagjitīyoktaḥ| vātaghnair iti daśamūlādibhiḥ||30-31||

lg.l: siñcet pārśvodaraṃ cādhaḥ pramṛjyād vījayec ca tam||33||
keśeṣv ālambya cākāśe ‘cākeśaṃ dhunuyānnāmayedbhṛśam’ iti pā. dhunuyāt trāsayec ca tam|
ulkābhir evam anyaiś ca bhītasyādhaḥ ‘bastiṃ tasyānayedadhaḥ’ iti pā. pravartate|
vastrapāṇigrahaiḥ kaṇṭhaṃ rundhyān na mriyate yathā||35||
apānaḥ pavano bastiṃ tam āśv evāpakarṣati||36||
auṣṇyāt taikṣyāt saratvāc ca bastiṃ so 'syānulomayet||37||
śiraḥsthe nāvanaṃ dhūmaḥ pracchādyaṃ sarṣapaiḥ śiraḥ||39||

ab.seg: vātamūtrety ādinordhvatām āha| datte iti bastau datte| tasyordhvaṃ gacchato baster mūrcchārūpaṃ vikāraṃ dṛṣṭvā mukhasecanādi kartavyam| ākāśe dhunuyād iti niravalambaṃ dhunuyāt| trāsayec ca gokharādibhir iti jñeyam| evam anyair iti anuktair api trāsanaprakāraiḥ| kaṇṭhāvarodho yathā kartavyas tad āha- na mriyate yatheti| kaṇṭhoparodhaprayojanam āha- prāṇodānanirodhād dhi prasiddhataramārgavān ity ādi| kaṇṭhapragraheṇa prāṇodānanirodhāt prasiddhataramārgavān apāno bhavati, gudapravartanasvarūpo bhavatīty arthaḥ; tataś ca bastim ūrdhvakṣiptam adho nayati; prāṇodānanirodhena tu prāṇodānābhyāṃ pīḍito 'pānaḥ svamārgagāmī bhavatīti jñeyam| kecit tu ‘yāvat prāṇoparodhād dhi’ iti paṭhanti, tatra prāṇoparodhaṃ yāvat kaṇṭhapīḍanaṃ kartavyam ity arthaḥ| kramukaṃ pūgaphalam| śiraḥstha iti bastyekadeśe śirasi sthite sati| pracchādyam iti ālepanīyam||32-39||

lg.l: utkliśyālpaṃ hared doṣaṃ janayec ca pravāhikām||40||
vidadhyāl laṅghayitvā tu vṛttiṃ kuryād viriktavat||42||

ab.seg: snigdhasvinnety ādinā pravāhikām āha| pravāhikām atīsāroktalakṣaṇām uktāṃ janayati| śodhanīyānulomikān ity atra śodhanīyān iti trivṛdādiśodhanadravyayuktān; ānulomikān iti anulomanakṣīrekṣurasayuktān| vṛttim iti peyādikramam||40-42||

lg.l: durbale krūrakoṣṭhe ca tīvradoṣe tanur mṛduḥ|
mārgair gātrāṇi ‘mārgairgātrāṇyanusarannūrdhvaṃ mūrdhni vidhāvati’ iti pā. sandhāvann ūrdhvaṃ mūrdhni ‘mūrdhanyupāhitaḥ’ iti pā. vihanyate|
grīvāṃ manye ca gṛhṇāti ‘saṃstabhya’ iti pā. śiraḥ kaṇṭhaṃ bhinatti ca||44||
kuryād abhyañjanaṃ tailalavaṇena ‘tailalavaṇenāvagāhayet’ iti pā. yathāvidhi||45||
yuñjyāt pradhamanair nasyair dhūmair asya ‘dhūmairāsyavirecanaiḥ’ iti pā. virecayet|
tīkṣṇānulomikenātha snigdhaṃ bhukte 'nuvāsayet ‘virecanairnirūhaiśca bastibhiścānulomikaiḥ’ iti pā.||46||

ab.seg: durbale ity ādinā śirortim āha| tanuḥ aghanaḥ| tadvihata iti nirūhabastiprakopitaḥ| ūrdhvaṃ mūrdhni vihanyate iti ūrdhvam anusaran mūrdhni vihanyate; ye tu ‘ūrdhvaṃ vidhāvati’ iti paṭhanti, tanmate upary upari dhāvatīty arthaḥ| asya virecayed iti atra ‘śira’ iti śeṣaḥ, ‘anu virecayet’ iti vā pāṭhaḥ| tīkṣṇānulomike 'nne bhukte sati anuvāsayed iti yojyam; kiṃ vā tīkṣṇānulomikenaivānuvāsanaṃ sādhyam ity arthaḥ||43-46||

lg.l: snehasvedair anāpādya ‘susnigdhasvinnadehasya yasya bastirvidhīyate| atitīkṣṇo guruścaiva’ iti, ‘virecanairnirūhaiśca bastibhiścānulomikaiḥ| atitīkṣṇo guruścaiva’ iti ca pā. gurus tīkṣṇo 'timātrayā|

yavān ‘yavakolakulatthānāṃ pañcamūladvayasya ca| jaladroṇe samutkvāthya kaṣāyaṃ saindhavena tam|| bilvatailena saṃyojya bastiṃ dadyādvikāravit| taṃ nirūhasamāśvastaṃ’ iti pā. kulatthān kolāni pañcamūle tathobhaye|

yaṣṭīmadhukatailena bilvatailena vā bhiṣak ‘snehasvedairanāpādya gurustīkṣṇo'timātrayā| yasya bastiḥ prayujyeta nātimātraṃ sa yujyate| stabdhodāvṛtakoṣṭhasya ruddhaḥ srotaḥsu mārutaḥ| prapanno'ṅgarujaṃ kuryāttaṃ tailalavaṇānvitam| uṣṇambuprastarakvāthaiḥ svedaiḥ samupapādayet|| sabilvatailalavaṇo nirūhastasya śasyate| tailāvagāhasvinnasya kārayedanuvāsanam’ iti pā.||53||

ab.seg: snehasvedair ity ādinā aṅgārtim āha| anāpādyeti snehasvedaiḥ śarīraṃ nopapādya| so 'timātraṃ pravartayet ‘doṣān’ iti śeṣaḥ| tataḥ stabdhodāvṛtakoṣṭhasya rujāṃ karoti| bhuktavato yady apy anuvāsanaṃ sarvatra bhavati, tathā'pi bhuktavata iti vacanena bhojanānantaram evānuvāsanaṃ darśayati||47-53||

lg.l: bastir doṣān nirasyāśu ‘vastirdoṣānnihatyāśu’ iti pā. janayet parikartikām||54||
vibandho 'lpālpam utthānaṃ ‘'lpasamutthānaṃ gudanirlekhanaṃ’ iti pā. bastinirlekhanād bhavet||55||

ab.seg: mṛdv ity ādinā parikartikām āha| bastinirlekhanād iti vāyunā ca tīkṣṇena bastikarṣaṇāt| vyaktāmla iti bastiviśeṣaṇam||54-57||

lg.l: pittaroge 'mla ‘pittarakte’ iti pā. uṣṇo vā tīkṣṇo vā lavaṇo 'thavā|
bastir likhati pāyuṃ tu kṣiṇoti vidahaty api||58||
sa vidagdhaḥ sravaty asraṃ pittaṃ cānekavarṇavat|
sāryate bahuvegena ‘bahudhā hyativegena’ iti pā. mohaṃ gacchati cāsakṛt||59||
sarpiṣā yojitaṃ śītaṃ bastim asmai pradāpayet||60||
gude sekāḥ pradehāś ca śītāḥ syur madhurāś ca ye|

ab.seg: pittaroge ity ādinā parisrāvam āha| kṣiṇotīti hinasti| eṣa kalpa iti ārdraśālmalīvṛntoktakṣīrasaṃskārakalpaḥ| suvarcalamiti suniṣaṇṇakam āhuḥ| karbudāraḥ kāñcanāraḥ||58-62||

samprati tatra tatra bastīnāṃ mṛdutvaṃ tīkṣṇatvaṃ ca vihitaṃ; tena tadvijñānārthaṃ mārdavatīkṣṇatvakārakadravyagaṇam āha- tīkṣṇatvam ity ādi| pīluḥ auttarapathikaṃ phalaṃ; pīlusthāne kecid bilvaṃ paṭhanti| prāptakālam iti uktāvastham||63||

lg.l: vīryeṇa bastir ādatte khastho 'rko bhūrasān iva||64||

ab.seg: bastiprabhāvam āha- āpādety ādi| pakvāśaye sthita iti pakvāśayagata eva| ādatte vīryeṇeti śaktyā svabhāvasambaddhayā| evambhūtavīryaṃ bastāv eva; tena pācanādiprayogāṇāṃ na bastivat tadahar eva sakaladehagatadoṣavijetṛtvaṃ bhavati| khastha iti ākāśagataḥ| suśrute tūktaṃ- “vīryeṇa bastir ādatte doṣān āpādamastakāt| pakvāśayastho 'mbarago bhūmer arko rasān iva” (su.ci.a.35) iti||64||

lg.l: yadvat kusumbhasammiśrāt toyād rāgaṃ haret paṭaḥ|
tadvad dravīkṛtād dehān nirūho nirharen malān||65||

ab.seg: samprati basteḥ śarīre malaprasādasahite 'pi yathā malāṃśamātrahārakatvaṃ bhavati, tad dṛṣṭāntena darśayann āha- yadvad ity ādi| dravīkṛtād iti snehasvedābhyāṃ vilāyitāt| malān iti doṣān purīṣaṃ ca||65||

tatra ślokaḥ-
ity etā vyāpadaḥ proktā basteḥ sākṛtibheṣajāḥ|
buddhvā kārtsnyena tān bastīn niyuñjan nāparādhyati||66||
ity etā ity ādisaṅgrahaḥ| yasmād etā vyāpado bastiduṣprayogajanyā bhavanti, tasmāt kārtsnyena bastīn buddhvā niyuñjan nāparādhyati, bastivyāpadaṃ nāsādayatīty arthaḥ||66||
ity agniveśakṛte tantre carakapratisaṃskṛte 'prāpte dṛḍhabalasampūrite siddhisthāne bastivyāpatsiddhir nāma ‘bastivyāpadikī siddhirnāma’ iti pā. saptamo 'dhyāyaḥ||7||
iti śrīcakrapāṇidattaviracitāyām āyurvedadīpikāyāṃ carakatātparyaṭīkāyāṃ siddhisthāne bastivyāpatsiddhir nāma saptamo 'dhyāyaḥ||7||

div.head: prāsṛtayogīyā siddhiḥ

ab.seg: athātaḥ prāsṛtayogīyāṃ ‘prāsṛtayogikīṃ’ iti pā. siddhiṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ||1||
iti ha smāha bhagavān ātreyaḥ||2||

samprati bastivyāpatpraśamakabastyabhidhāyakatayaiva prāsṛtayogīyā siddhir ucyate| prasṛtopalakṣitā ye yogāḥ tān adhikṛtya kṛtā siddhiḥ; tena prasṛtālakṣitā ‘prasṛtopalakṣitāḥ’ iti pā. apy atra yogā vaktavyā eva||1-2||

lg.l: athemān sukumārāṇāṃ nirūhān snehanān ‘śodhanān’ iti pā. mṛdūn|
karmaṇā viplutānāṃ ca vakṣyāmi prasṛtaiḥ pṛthak||3||

ab.seg: imān iti agre vakṣyamāṇān| tenādhyāyaśeṣavaktavyānāṃ nāvaśyaṃ prasṛtopalakṣitavidhānam| sukumārāṇām iti tanvādiguṇasambaddhaṃ bhavati||3||

lg.l: kṣīrād dvau prasṛtau kāryau madhutailaghṛtāt trayaḥ|
bilvādimūlakvāthād dvau kaulatthād dvau sa vātanut||5||

ab.seg: prasṛtaṃ paladvayam| madhutailaghṛtāt traya iti militāt| atra ca yathoktair eva dravyair bastir deyaḥ; tena netarabastinyāyenānuktakalkādikalpanā; yatra niyatamānadravyavibhāgena bastyabhidhānaṃ, tatra sāmānyabastidravyamānānavakāśaḥ; yatra tv ekadeśakathanaṃ, tatra nirūhayogitayoktadravyamānādhikāraḥ; saindhavapraveśas tv atyājya eva| bilvādimūlaṃ daśamūlam| sa vātanud iti sa bastir vātaṃ hantīti||4-6||

lg.l: prasṛto ‘prasṛtau hapuṣākṣaudrānnirūhaḥ’ iti pā. hapuṣākarṣo nirūhaḥ śukrakṛt param||7||

ab.seg: hapuṣākarṣaḥ||7||

div.ab: paṭolety ādau ambhasaḥ iti kvāthāt| sarṣapakalkita iti atra yady api kalkamānaṃ noktaṃ, tathā'pi dvādaśaprasṛte nirūhe dvipalakalkasya vihitatvād iha pañcaprasṛte tadanusārāt ṣaḍbhāgonaṃ palaṃ bhavati; evam anyatrāpy anuktamānakalkavyavasthā||8||-

lg.l: kaṣāyāt ‘kaṣāyāḥ’ iti pā. prasṛtāḥ pañca tailād eko vimathya tān|

ab.seg: viḍaṅgety ādau phalaṃ madanaphalam| ākhuparṇī dantī||10||

lg.l: prasṛtāḥ sarṣapaiḥ kalkair viṭsaṅgānāhabhedanaḥ ‘piṣṭai…’ iti pā.||12||

ab.seg: payasyety ādau yady api payasyādīnāṃ kvātho na śrūyate, tathā'pi dravāntaraiḥ samam ekaikaprasṛtavidhānāt pratyekaṃ payasyādikvāthasya prasṛtamānatvam| vṛṣatvakṛd iti śukravṛddhikṛt||11-12||

lg.l: kalkaḥ ‘kalkobastistu sānāhe mūtrakṛcchre paro mataḥ’ iti pā. syān mūtrakṛcchre tu sānāhe bastir uttamaḥ|
ete salavaṇāḥ koṣṇā nirūhāḥ prasṛtair nava||14||

ab.seg: śvadaṃṣṭrety ādau śvadaṃṣṭrādidravyatrayakvāthasya pratyekaṃ prasṛtamānatvam, evaṃ tailasurāsavaprasṛtābhyāṃ saha pañcaprasṛtāḥ pūraṇīyāḥ; surākṛta āsavaḥ surāsavaḥ||13-14||

lg.l: tīkṣṇair vikarṣite svādu pratyāsthāpanam iṣyate ‘pratyāsthāpanameva vā’ iti pā.||15||

ab.seg: etaduktamṛdubastiprayogānām ante kartavyam āha- mṛdv ity ādi| svādu pratyāsthāpanam iṣyata ity atra svādu drākṣādidravyakṛtam| kecit tadahar eva pratyāsthāpanam icchanti| āsthāpanaṃ lakṣyīkṛtya dīyata iti pratyāsthāpanam||15||

lg.l: vātopasṛṣṭasyoṣṇaiḥ syur gudadāhādayo ‘…rgadā dāhādayo yadi’ iti pā. yadi|
tad dhi pittaśakṛdvātān hṛtvā dāhādikāñ jayet|
śuddhaś cāpi pibec chītāṃ yavāgūṃ śarkarāyutām||17||

ab.seg: vātopasṛṣṭasyety ādau uṣṇair iti bastiviśeṣaṇam| dāhādayo dāhamohatṛḍādayo vātapittajanyāḥ| drākṣāmbunā trivṛtpānasya dāhādikārake pitte vāte ca hitatvaṃ darśayann āha- tad dhīty ādi||16-17||

lg.l: māṣayūṣeṇa kulmāṣān piben madhv athavā ‘pibeddadhyathavā’ iti pā. surām||18||

ab.seg: kulmāṣā iti ardhasvinnayavādimayā ‘ardhasvinnayavādipiṣṭamayāḥ’ iti pā. bhakṣyāḥ||18||

lg.l: sāmaṃ ‘sāmaṃ cedatisāryeta pūti śūlairarocakī’ iti pā. cet kuṇapaṃ śūlair upaviśed arocakī|

ab.seg: bastimithyāprayogodīritānām atīsārabhedānāṃ cikitsitam āha- sāmaṃ ced ity ādi| sāmaṃ yathā syāt ‘bhavati’ iti pā. tathopaviśed iti; tena malādivyatiriktāmamātropaveśarūpo 'yam atīsāraḥ kevalāmaśakṛdvātaraktapittakaphajanyānām iha ṣaṇṇāmatīsārāṇāṃ vaktavyānāṃ prathama ukto bhavati| kuṇapam iti śavagandham| śūlaiḥ ‘yukta’ iti śeṣaḥ| ghanaṃ mustakam||19||

lg.l: pakvaṃ ‘pakvastatra’ iti pā., tatra svavargīyair bastiḥ śreṣṭhaṃ bhiṣagjitam||20||

ab.seg: kevalaśakṛdādijanyāṃś cātisārān āha- śakṛdvātam ity ādi| pakvam iti nirāmam| āmaśabdenehāgnidaurbalyād avipakvāhārarasa eva koṣṭhopalepaka āmo gṛhyate; yad uktam anyatra- “āmāśayasthaḥ kāyāgner daurbalyād avipācitaḥ| ādya āhāradhātur yaḥ sa āma iti sañjñitaḥ” iti| svavargīyair iti purīṣasaṅgrahaṇavātaghnaśoṇitāsthāpanapittakaphaharabheṣajavargaiḥ; kiṃ vā uttaratra pratyekaṃ śakṛdādivakṣyamāṇabheṣajaiḥ||20||

lg.l: ṣaṇṇām eṣāṃ dvisaṃsargāt triṃśad bhedā bhavanti tu|
kevalaiḥ saha ṣaṭtriṃśad vidyāt sopadravān api||21||

ab.seg: atīsārabhedān āha- ṣaṇṇām ity ādi| eṣām iti etadabhihitānām| anye tu bastivibhraṃśajāḥ ṣaṭsaṅkhyā bhavantīti vadanti; pūrvavyākhyānam eva sādhu||21||
upadravān eṣām āha- śūlety ādi||22||

lg.l: tatrāme 'ntarapānaṃ ‘tatrāme vamanaṃ kāryaṃ’ iti pā. syāt vyoṣāmlalavaṇair yutam|
pācanaṃ śasyate bastir āme hi pratiṣidhyate||23||

ab.seg: yathoktātīsāreṣu cikitsām āha- tatrāme ity ādi| antarapānaṃ pācanam āhuḥ| pācanam ity anena ceha pūrvaṃ ‘sa ghanātiviṣā’ ity ādy uktaṃ pācanaṃ gṛhyate| vyoṣāmlalavaṇair yutam iti vyoṣāmlalavaṇayogena kṛtam||23||

div.ab: vātaghnair ity ādau vātaghnaṃ daśamūlaṃ; grāhivargaś ca ṣaḍvirecanaśatāśritīyokta eva| atra jatūkarṇaḥ- “śakṛti śophaghnagrāhibhir bastiḥ” ity āha; śophaghnaṃ ca daśamūlam eva|24|

ab.seg: svādvamlalavaṇaiḥ śastaḥ snehabastir iti svādvamlalavaṇadravyasādhitasnehakṛtam anuvāsanam ity arthaḥ| samīraṇe iti kevalavātātīsāre||24||
rakte rakteneti sarakte 'tīsāryamāṇe raktena bastir deyaḥ| pitte tv iti pitte 'tīsāryamāṇe kaṣāyādikṛto bastir eva||25||

lg.l: śakṛtā vāyunā vā''me tena varcasy athānile|
pittenāme 'sṛjā vā'pi tayor āmena vā punaḥ|
vātena viśi pitte vā viṭpittābhyāṃ ‘viṭpittāsraiḥ’ iti pā. tathā'nile|
kaphena viśi pitte vā kaphe viṭpittaśoṇitaiḥ|
syād bastir vyoṣatiktāmlaḥ saṃsṛṣṭe vāyunā kaphe|
bastir vātena pitte ‘rakte’ iti pā. tu kāryaḥ svādvamlatiktakaḥ||33||

ab.seg: saṃsarge cikitsām āha- śakṛtety ādi| śakṛtā''me pradhāne saṃsṛṣṭe, tathā vāyunā vā''me saṃsṛṣṭe; tenety āmenāpradhānena varcasi anile ‘anilena’ iti pā. ca pṛthak saṃsṛṣṭe, atra teneti pūrvavad vyākhyeyam| atra saṃsṛṣṭeṣu ‘saṃsargeṣu’ iti pā. tṛtīyānirdiṣṭam alpamānatayā'pradhānaṃ, saptamīnirdiṣṭaṃ bahumānatvāt pradhānaṃ jñeyam| tayor iti pittāsṛjoḥ| saṃsṛṣṭayor iti ekamānena yuktayoḥ| kaphe vyoṣakaṣāyalavaṇair yutam ity antaṃ yāvat ‘antarapānaṃ’ ity anuvartate| vātena viśīty ādau madhurāmlakaṣāyo bastir iti madhurādidravyakvāthādikṛto bastir deya ity arthaḥ| śakṛcchoṇitayor ity ādau anyonyasaṃsarge sati śakṛtā śoṇite śoṇitena vā śakṛti saṃsṛṣṭe; evaṃ pittaśakṛtoḥ raktapittayoś ca dvividhaḥ saṃsargo vyākhyeyaḥ| viṭpittaśoṇitair iti pratyekaṃ viḍādibhiḥ kaphe saṃsṛṣṭe| kaphavimūrcchite iti kaphenāpradhānena saṃsṛṣṭe ity arthaḥ||26-33||

anuktasaṃsargacikitsāṃ sūtrayann āha- tricatur ity ādi| tricatuḥpañcasaṃsargān iti āmādīnāṃ trika-catuṣka-pañcakarūpān saṃsargān| evam eva vikalpayed iti pradhānādimelakena vikalpayet, tathā bheṣajam api teṣāṃ yathoktabheṣajānusāreṇa kalpayed ity arthaḥ| ete ca bhedā likhyamānā atibahuprabhedatayā granthagauravam āpādayanti, svayaṃ ca buddhimatā sukaravibhāgā eveti na likhyante| evamādisaṃsargakṛtaṃ rogabhedam anyatrāpi buddhyā kartavyatayā'tidiśann āha- sarvarogeṣv api smṛteti| iyaṃ vyavasthā sarvarogeṣv eva yathāsambhavam ācāryānumatety arthaḥ| tatra grahaṇīgade yatra tu ṣaḍ apy āmādayaḥ sambhavanti, tatraivaṃ saṃsargāḥ prakalpyante; yatra ca trayo doṣāḥ sambhavanti, śoṇitena vā samaṃ catvāraḥ, tatra teṣām eva parasparasaṃsargo bheṣajavibhāgārthaṃ ‘bhiṣajā yogabhedārthaṃ’ iti pā. kalpanīyaḥ||34||

lg.l: yugapat ṣaḍrasaṃ ṣaṇṇāṃ saṃsarge pācanaṃ bhavet ‘pibet’ iti pā.|
nirāmāṇāṃ tu pañcānāṃ bastiḥ ṣāḍrasiko mataḥ||35||

ab.seg: āmādiṣaṭkasamudayarūpasaṃsarge kāryam āha- yugapad ity ādi| yugapad iti ekadaiva militānāṃ ṣaṇṇām iti yāvat| ṣaḍrasam iti militaṣaḍrasakṛtam| nirāmāṇām iti āmavarjitānāṃ śakṛdādīnāṃ pañcānām| ṣāḍrasika iti ṣaḍrasamelakena kṛtaḥ||35||

lg.l: śaṅkhaṃ sarjarasaṃ lākṣāṃ kardamaṃ ca palāṃśikam||36||
piṣṭvā taiḥ sarpiṣaḥ prasthaṃ kṣīradviguṇitaṃ pacet|
masūrāśvatthaśuṅgaiś ca yavāgūḥ syāj jale śṛtaiḥ||38||
sthirādīnāṃ balādīnām ikṣvādīnām athāpi ‘vaṭādīnā…’ iti pā. vā|
kvātheṣu samasūrāṇāṃ yavāgvaḥ syuḥ pṛthak pṛthak||40||

ab.seg: sarvātīsārasādhāraṇaṃ bheṣajam āha- udumbarety ādi| ‘raktaśālibhiḥ’ ity atra ‘raktamūlibhiḥ’ iti pāṭhe ‘raktamūlī raktairaṇḍam’ ity apare| jale śṛtair iti ṣaḍaṅgavidhānena jale śṛtaiḥ| bālodumbaram udumbaraśalāṭu| bhaved iti yavāgūr bhavet| ikṣvādīnām iti tṛṇapañcamūlapaṭhitānāṃ śaravarjitānām ikṣukuśakāśaśālimūlānām| śālyāditaṇḍulair iti raktaśālikalamāditaṇḍulaiḥ| dadhyādibhir atra jalasthānīyair yavāgūḥ sādhanīyā||36-42||

bhavanti cātra ślokāḥ-
snigdhāmlalavaṇamadhuraṃ pānaṃ bastiś ca mārute koṣṇaḥ|
śītaṃ tiktakaṣāyaṃ madhuraṃ pitte ca rakte ca||43||

lg.l: atisāraṃ pratyuktaṃ miśraṃ dvandvādiyogajeṣv api ‘dvandvāmajeṣvapi ca’ iti pā. ca|

ab.seg: prapañcoktaṃ bheṣajaṃ saṅgraheṇābhidadhāti- bhavanti cātrety ādi| pānam iti pācanapānam| bastiś ceti snigdhāmlalavaṇamadhura eva bastiḥ| mārute iti mārutātisāre; evam anyatrāpi pitte ity ādau pittādijātisāre iti jñeyam| saṅgrāhi vātanud ity atra ‘bheṣajaṃ’ iti śeṣaḥ; tac ca bheṣajaṃ yathoktabastyādirūpam eva| pācanam āme pānam iti pācanaghanātiviṣādidravyakṛtaṃ pānam ity arthaḥ| picchābastayo 'sṛgbastayaś ceti picchāsṛgbastayaḥ| uktam iti sākṣād atideśena ca trikādisaṃsarge proktam| miśram iti etad eva pratyekaṃ miśrīkṛtam| dvandvādiyogajeṣv iti tricatuṣkādisaṃsargaje 'tisāre| tatrodrekādiviśeṣād iti saṃsarga eva balābalaviśeṣād upakramasyāpi viśeṣo bhavati| etad eva balāpekṣaṃ bahudurbalā'pratyanīkaṃ bastyekabheṣajam iti śeṣaḥ(?)||43-45||

tatra ślokaḥ-
prāsṛtikāḥ savyāpatkriyā nirūhās tathā'tisārahitāḥ|
rasakalpaghṛtayavāgvaś coktā ‘rasakalkaghṛtayavāgvaḥ’ iti pā. guruṇā prasṛtasiddhau||46||

prāsṛtikā ity ādyadhyāyārthasaṅgrahaḥ| savyāpatkriyā iti vyāpadaś ca mṛdubastikṛtajāḍyādikā uktāḥ, tathā kriyāś ca tāsām eva vyāpadām uktāḥ| nirūhāś cātisāracikitsite proktāḥ| rasakalpaś cātīsāreṣu rasoddeśacikitsayā kṛtaḥ| ghṛtaṃ codumbarety ādinoktam||46||
ity agniveśakṛte tantre carakapratisaṃskṛte 'prāpte dṛḍhabalasampūrite siddhisthāne prāsṛtayogīyasiddhir nāmāṣṭamo 'dhyāyaḥ ‘prāsṛtayogikī’ iti pā.||8||
iti śrīcakrapāṇidattapraṇītāyām āyurvedadīpikāyāṃ carakatātparyaṭīkāyāṃ siddhisthāne prāsṛtayogīyasiddhir nāmāṣṭamo 'dhyāyaḥ||8||

div.head: trimarmīyā siddhiḥ

ab.seg: athātas trimarmīyāṃ siddhiṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ||1||
iti ha smāha bhagavān ātreyaḥ||2||
